DESICCATE.Name: Desiccate
DESICCATE.Description: Prevents Water- or Grass-type moves during sandstorm.

HULLHUNGER.Name: Hull Hunger

HYPERSPEED.Name: Hyper Speed

ILLUMINANCE.Name: Illuminance
ILLUMINANCE.Description: Boosts Sp. Atk by 30% in moonglow.

KILLJOY.Name: Killjoy

LETEMHAVEIT.Name: Let 'Em Have It

STONESYMBOL.Description: During sandstorm, immune to non-volatile status conditions and stat reductions.

STORMBRINGER.Name: Stormbringer
STORMBRINGER.Description: Summons rainstorm for four turns when hit by an attack.

STORMTOTEM.Name: Storm Totem
STORMTOTEM.Description: Upon entry, summons a Turbulent Sky on this Pokémon's side for six turns.

STORMTRAIL.Name: Storm Trail
STORMTRAIL.Description: Pokémon that swap in for this have their Speed raised.

STRAIGHTAHEAD.Name: Straight Ahead
STRAIGHTAHEAD.Description: This Pokémon's moves deal 20% more damage and ignore abilities that would affect them. Its moves can't be redirected.

STRATAGEM.Name: Stratagem
STRATAGEM.Description: At the end of each turn, if it has no item, gets a random gem that matches the type of one of its attacking moves.

STRESSFUL.Name: Stressful
STRESSFUL.Description: Makes foes stressed and unable to use their items.

STRIKECORONA.Name: Strike Corona
STRIKECORONA.Description: Doubles Defense, but this Pokémon can't use status moves.

STRIKETWICE.Name: Strikes Twice
STRIKETWICE.Description: In rainstorm, each of its hits is followed by an extra hit at 25% power.

STUBBORN.Name: Stubborn
STUBBORN.Description: Prevents its stats from being lowered by more than one step at a time.

STUPEFYING.Name: Stupefying
STUPEFYING.Description: Ignores Abilities that would affect its moves. Dizzies opponents that it hits below half health.

STYGIANNIGHT.Name: Stygian Night
STYGIANNIGHT.Description: Changes the weather to Blood Moon, which heralds the Full Blood Moon. Lingers for three turns after leaving.

STYLISH.Name: Stylish
STYLISH.Description: This Pokémon benefits twice as much from style points.

SUDDENCHILL.Name: Sudden Chill
SUDDENCHILL.Description: Boosts Sp. Def by 20%. When this Pokémon takes its second special hit from the same attacker, they become frostbitten.

SUDDENTURN.Name: Sudden Turn
SUDDENTURN.Description: Uses Rapid Spin if an attack lowers its HP below half.

SUGARCOATED.Name: Sugarcoated
SUGARCOATED.Description: If an attack lowers its HP below half, the attacker enters a sugar rush for four turns.

SUMMERSZENITH.Name: Summer's Zenith
SUMMERSZENITH.Description: After knocking out any Pokémon, summons sunshine for four turns.

SUNBURNING.Name: Sun Burning
SUNBURNING.Description: At the end of each turn in sunshine, each Pokémon not immune to sunshine has their Defense and Sp. Def lowered.

SUNCHASER.Name: Sun Chaser
SUNCHASER.Description: Boosts this Pokémon's Speed by 50% and reduces recoil taken by 50% in sunshine.

SUNEATER.Name: Sun Eater
SUNEATER.Description: Summons eclipse for four turns when hit by an attack.

SUPERCONDUCTOR.Name: Superconductor
SUPERCONDUCTOR.Description: Doubles the speed of allied Pokémon.

SURVIVALIST.Name: Survivalist
SURVIVALIST.Description: It avoids hazards and can't be knocked out with one hit.

SWARMINSTINCT.Name: Swarm Instinct
SWARMINSTINCT.Description: When an ally switches in, this Pokémon's Speed is increased.

SWIFTSTOMPS.Name: Swift Stomps
SWIFTSTOMPS.Description: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled while using kicking moves.

SWORDBREAKER.Name: Sword Breaker
SWORDBREAKER.Description: If an attack lowers this Pokémon's HP below half, the attacker becomes fractured.

SWORDHORNSTYLE.Name: Sword-Horn Style
SWORDHORNSTYLE.Description: After attacking the same foe twice, they become numbed, and a Sanctuary is set on this Pokémon's side for three turns.

SWORDPLAY.Name: Swordplay
SWORDPLAY.Description: Boosts the power of slice moves by 30%.

SWORDSMITHING.Name: Sword-Smithing
SWORDSMITHING.Description: Immune to Steel-type moves and boosts Attack and Sp. Atk when hit by one.

TAIGATREKKER.Name: Taiga Trekker
TAIGATREKKER.Description: During hail, boosts Speed and Grass-type damage by 50%.

TANGLINGVINES.Name: Tangling Vines
TANGLINGVINES.Description: When hit, the attacker's Speed is reduced, and this Pokémon's next attack against them is boosted by 30%.

TEMPORALDISTORTION.Name: Temporal Distortion
TEMPORALDISTORTION.Description: Every three turns it gets to move twice.

TENDERIZE.Name: Tenderize
TENDERIZE.Description: At the end of each round, lowers other numbed Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def by two steps.

TENEBROUSCANTER.Name: Tenebrous Canter
TENEBROUSCANTER.Description: After knocking out any Pokémon, summons eclipse for four turns.

TERRITORIAL.Name: Territorial
TERRITORIAL.Description: Boosts damage by 20% if there is a weather. Immune to weather downsides.

TESLACOILS.Name: Tesla Coils
TESLACOILS.Description: Becomes energized upon entry, doubling the power of its next Electric-type attack.

THERMOSTASIS.Name: Thermostasis
THERMOSTASIS.Description: Heals 1/16th HP every turn. Takes half damage from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

THIEFSDIVERSION.Name: Thief's Diversion
THIEFSDIVERSION.Description: By sacrificing a held item this Pokémon didn't start with, it can negate one attack against it.

THROWNIN.Name: Thrown In
THROWNIN.Description: When another party member uses Fling, they swap out for Pyukumuku.

THUNDERSTRUCK.Name: Thunderstruck
THUNDERSTRUCK.Description: Becomes energized when hit by an attack, doubling the power of its next Electric-type attack.

TIMEINTERLOPER.Name: Time Interloper
TIMEINTERLOPER.Description: Its attacks have priority, deal 25% less damage and become special.

TIMESKIP.Name: Time Skip
TIMESKIP.Description: Every two turns, starting with the first, another turn happens where no one moves.

TOILANDTROUBLE.Name: Toil and Trouble
TOILANDTROUBLE.Description: Foes suffer 50% more move damage reduction from burn, frostbite, and numb.

TOLLTHEBELLS.Name: Toll the Bells
TOLLTHEBELLS.Description: Upon entry during eclipse, heals the lowest HP ally or self by 33%.

TOOTHANDCLAW.Name: Tooth and Claw
TOOTHANDCLAW.Description: Non-biting attacks deal 50% more damage if this Pokémon used a biting move last turn.

TORPORSAP.Name: Torpor Sap
TORPORSAP.Description: Restores its HP by 50% of the damage it deals to sleeping targets.

TOUGH.Name: Tough
TOUGH.Description: Takes half damage from Fighting- and Rock-type moves.

TOXICATTITUDE.Name: Toxic Attitude
TOXICATTITUDE.Description: Powers up Poison-type moves of itself and its allies by 50%.

TOXINTAX.Name: Toxin Tax
TOXINTAX.Description: Heals based on the damage other battlers take from being poisoned.

TRAPPER.Name: Trapper
TRAPPER.Description: Takes 30% less damage from Pokémon that are trapped.

TRAUMATIZING.Name: Traumatizing
TRAUMATIZING.Description: Foes whose stats are lowered by this Pokémon keep those lowered stats even after switching.

TREASURETRACKER.Name: Treasure Tracker
TREASURETRACKER.Description: Increase the money rewarded by trainers from battles in which it participates by 50%.

TREMORSENSE.Name: Tremor Sense
TREMORSENSE.Description: Whenever a grounded foe attacks, this Pokémon gains priority against them on the next turn.

TRENCHCARVER.Name: Trench Carver
TRENCHCARVER.Description: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled while using recoil moves.

TUNEDOUT.Name: Tuned Out
TUNEDOUT.Description: Boosts the power of sound moves by 30%. Sound moves ignore the target's modified Defense and Sp. Def.

ULTRAADAPTED.Name: Ultra Adapted
ULTRAADAPTED.Description: Powers up moves of the same type by 50%.

ULTRABUSTER.Name: Ultra Buster
ULTRABUSTER.Description: Boosts the power of punch and pulse moves by 50%.

UMBRALTENACITY.Name: Umbral Tenacity
UMBRALTENACITY.Description: During moonglow, take 35% less damage from attacks that aren't Steel-type.

UMBRALWAKE.Name: Umbral Wake
UMBRALWAKE.Description: After knocking out any Pokémon, summons moonglow for four turns.

UNAFRAID.Name: Unafraid
UNAFRAID.Description: Takes half damage from Dark- and Bug-type moves.

UNASSUMING.Name: Unassuming
UNASSUMING.Description: Before using a status move against a single foe, lowers their Defense by two steps.

UNBREAKABLE.Name: Unbreakable
UNBREAKABLE.Description: Prevents half the self-damage from recoil and self-destructing.

UNCANNYLUCK.Name: Uncanny Luck
UNCANNYLUCK.Description: If an attacker would activate a random added effect on this Pokémon, that effect is placed on the attacker instead.

UNCONVENTIONAL.Name: Unconventional
UNCONVENTIONAL.Description: Moves that use stats other than the default deal 50% more damage.

UNDYINGRAGE.Name: Undying Rage
UNDYINGRAGE.Description: If this Pokémon would faint while rampaging, it faints when the rampage ends instead. Its rampages last an additional turn.

UNFAZED.Name: Unfazed
UNFAZED.Description: Takes 20% less damage from neutrally effective attacks.

VANDAL.Name: Vandal
VANDAL.Description: Deals 30% more damage to targets that have an item. After attacking a foe, destroys their clothing items.

VENGEANCE.Name: Vengeance
VENGEANCE.Description: After an attack reduces its HP below half, deals 1/4th of the attacker's HP back to the attacker.

VENOMDETTA.Name: Venomdetta
VENOMDETTA.Description: Immune to Poison-type moves and raises Attack and Sp. Atk if hit by one.

VENOMGORGER.Name: Venom Gorger
VENOMGORGER.Description: Whenever a foe's poison worsens, this Pokémon heals for 25% max HP.

VERDANT.Name: Verdant
VERDANT.Description: Powers up Grass-type moves of itself and its allies by 50%.

VERSATILEARTIST.Name: Versatile Artist
VERSATILEARTIST.Description: Gains the opposite side's last used move as a 5th move.

VICIOUSCYCLE.Name: Vicious Cycle
VICIOUSCYCLE.Description: This Pokémon's Dragon-type attacks become spread and drain 33% HP.

VICTORYMOLT.Name: Victory Molt
VICTORYMOLT.Description: Heals non-volatile status conditions and resets stat changes after knocking out any Pokémon.

VITALRHYTHM.Name: Vital Rhythm
VITALRHYTHM.Description: At the end of each turn, itself and each ally heals for 1/16th of their HP.

VOIDWARRANTY.Name: Void Warranty
VOIDWARRANTY.Description: Changes into another form of your choosing when its HP is lowered below half.

WALLNINJA.Name: Wall Ninja
WALLNINJA.Description: This Pokémon's random crit moves are always critical if there is an active Room.

WANINGWILLPOWER.Name: Waning Willpower
WANINGWILLPOWER.Description: During the Full Moon, this Pokémon saps the enemy Pokémon of their vitality, leeching them.

WARDING.Name: Warding
WARDING.Description: Negates enemy status moves that target this Pokémon or create hazards around it.

WARMUP.Name: Warm Up
WARMUP.Description: Boosts this Pokémon's Attack by 30% in sunshine.

WATERFALLCONDITIONING.Name: Waterfall Conditioning
WATERFALLCONDITIONING.Description: Boosts Speed by 50% in rainstorm. Can't miss during rainstorm.

WEATHERED.Name: Weathered
WEATHERED.Description: Immune to weather downsides, and takes 20% less damage from attacks during weather.

WELLROUNDED.Name: Well Rounded
WELLROUNDED.Description: Powers up all tagged moves by 20%.

WELLSUITED.Name: Well Suited
WELLSUITED.Description: Takes 50% less damage from not-very-effective or barely-effective attacks.

WHITEKNIGHT.Name: White Knight
WHITEKNIGHT.Description: Draws in moves from foes with base power 100 or more. Takes 15% less move damage.

WIBBLEWOBBLE.Name: Wibble Wobble
WIBBLEWOBBLE.Description: Uses Power Split upon entry or when hit by a move.

WILDTOTEM.Name: Wild Totem
WILDTOTEM.Description: Upon entry, summons a Primal Forest on this Pokémon's side for six turns.

WILLAURA.Name: Will Aura
WILLAURA.Description: Upon entry, creates a Willful Room for four turns, reducing all hits by 30 damage.

WINTERINSULATION.Name: Winter Insulation
WINTERINSULATION.Description: During hail, immune to Fire- and Electric-type moves.

WINTERSWAGES.Name: Winter's Wages
WINTERSWAGES.Description: Restores HP based on damage taken by others from hail.

WISEHUNTER.Name: Wise Hunter
WISEHUNTER.Description: After knocking out any Pokémon, raises its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def.

WISHMAKER.Name: Wish Maker
WISHMAKER.Description: The random added effects of moves by all battlers always activate.

WISHOFAUTUMN.Name: Wish of Autumn
WISHOFAUTUMN.Description: Upon entry, summons Autumn Harvests on this Pokémon's side for four turns.

WISHOFSPRING.Name: Wish of Spring
WISHOFSPRING.Description: Upon entry, summons Spring Plantings on this Pokémon's side for four turns.

WISHOFSUMMER.Name: Wish of Summer
WISHOFSUMMER.Description: Upon entry, summons Summer Festivals on this Pokémon's side for four turns.

WISHOFWINTER.Name: Wish of Winter
WISHOFWINTER.Description: Upon entry, summons Winter Hunts on this Pokémon's side for four turns.

WORLDQUAKE.Name: Worldquake
WORLDQUAKE.Description: Ground-type moves deal 50% more damage in eclipse.

WRATHINSTINCT.Name: Wrath Instinct
WRATHINSTINCT.Description: Uses Dragon Dance if an attack lowers its HP below half.

WREAKHAVOC.Name: Wreak Havoc
WREAKHAVOC.Description: Boosts the power of rampaging moves by 30%, and makes them physical or special based on which would be more effective.

PRIMEVALBOULDERNEST.Name: Primeval Boulder Nest
PRIMEVALBOULDERNEST.Description: Lays a hazard of levitating stones around the opponent when its HP is lowered below 75% HP.

PRIMEVALBREAKTHROUGH.Name: Primeval Break Through
PRIMEVALBREAKTHROUGH.Description: This Pokémon's moves deal 20% more damage, ignore immunities due to typing and deal half damage to protected targets.

PRIMEVALDISGUISE.Name: Primeval Disguise
PRIMEVALDISGUISE.Description: This Pokémon starts as a very convincing Pikachu!

PRIMEVALFLOURISHING.Name: Primeval Flourishing
PRIMEVALFLOURISHING.Description: At the end of each turn, grows one size larger and all of its stats are raised. If damaged three times in a turn, reverts back.

PRIMEVALIMPOSTER.Name: Primeval Imposter
PRIMEVALIMPOSTER.Description: Transforms into the entire enemy team, except buffed!

PRIMEVALMEGALAUNCHER.Name: Primeval Mega Launcher
PRIMEVALMEGALAUNCHER.Description: Pulse moves deal 50% more damage, and deal 10% of their damage again on the next turn.

PRIMEVALREGENERATOR.Name: Primeval Regenerator
PRIMEVALREGENERATOR.Description: Heals for 1/4th of its HP at the end of every turn.

PRIMEVALSWORDBREAKER.Name: Primeval Sword-Breaker
PRIMEVALSWORDBREAKER.Description: If this Pokémon takes over 120 damage from an attack, the attacker becomes fractured.

BECOME_CHAMPION.Name: Crowning Achievement
BECOME_CHAMPION.Description: Be officially crowned Champion of Makya.

CREDITS_BELOW_10_HOURS.Name: Pace Setter
CREDITS_BELOW_10_HOURS.Description: Reach the credits with 10 or fewer hours on your save file.

DEFEAT_ZAIN_PRIZCA_WEST_SHINY_SKITTY.Name: Ultimate Flex
DEFEAT_ZAIN_PRIZCA_WEST_SHINY_SKITTY.Description: Defeat Zain in Prizca West with a shiny Skitty in your party.

DECLINE_MAVIS_PHONE_CALL.Name: Please Leave a Message at the Tone
DECLINE_MAVIS_PHONE_CALL.Description: Decline Mavis' phone call at the end of the game.

PERFECT_CURSED_CATACOMBS_YEZERA.Name: I'm Not Trapped Here With You
PERFECT_CURSED_CATACOMBS_YEZERA.Description: Perfectly defeat Yezera in the Catacombs with the Tarot Amulet activated.

DEFEAT_GYM_BELOW_CAP.Name: Handicap
DEFEAT_GYM_BELOW_CAP.Description: Defeat a gym leader while at a level cap below that of the leader's team.

PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_1.Name: Last Call
PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_1.Description: Perfect Lambert, the first gym leader, at level cap 15 or below with the Tarot Amulet activated.

PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_2.Name: No Pain No Gain
PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_2.Description: Perfect Eko, the second gym leader, at level cap 20 or below with the Tarot Amulet activated.

PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_3.Name: Demoted
PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_3.Description: Perfect Helena, the third gym leader, at level cap 25 or below with the Tarot Amulet activated.

PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_4.Name: Make Like a Tree
PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_4.Description: Perfect Rafael, the fourth gym leader, at level cap 30 or below with the Tarot Amulet activated.

PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_5.Name: Enemy of my Enemies
PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_5.Description: Perfect Bence and Zoé, the fifth gym leaders, at level cap 40 or below with the Tarot Amulet activated.

PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_6.Name: Artist's Block
PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_6.Description: Perfect Noel, the sixth gym leader, at level cap 45 or below with the Tarot Amulet activated.

PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_7.Name: You Get Nothing!
PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_7.Description: Perfect Victoire, the seventh gym leader, at level cap 55 or below with the Tarot Amulet activated.

PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_8.Name: Dread Not
PERFECT_CURSED_GYM_8.Description: Perfect Samorn, the eighth gym leader, at level cap 60 or below with the Tarot Amulet activated.

DEFEAT_ALL_CHAMBER_AVATARS.Name: Clay Army
DEFEAT_ALL_CHAMBER_AVATARS.Description: Defeat all 8 Team Chasm-created avatars within the locked chambers.

DEFEAT_AVATAR_CALYREX.Name: Regicide
DEFEAT_AVATAR_CALYREX.Description: Destroy the avatars of Spectrier, Glastrier, and Calyrex in the Crown Chamber.

DEFEAT_AVATAR_RAYQUAZA.Name: Ozone Depletion
DEFEAT_AVATAR_RAYQUAZA.Description: Destroy the avatar of Rayquaza in the Tempest Realm.

CAPTURE_LEGENDARY_BASIC_BALL.Name: Back to Basics
CAPTURE_LEGENDARY_BASIC_BALL.Description: Capture a legendary Pokémon in a regular Poké Ball (thrown normally or created by the Ball Launcher.)

CAPTURE_WITH_ALL_AESTHETIC_BALLS.Name: Having a Ball
CAPTURE_WITH_ALL_AESTHETIC_BALLS.Description: Capture at least one Pokémon in a Premier Ball, a Cherish Ball, and a Royal Ball.

CAPTURE_WITH_ALL_FAILURE_EFFECT_BALLS.Name: Failed to Fail
CAPTURE_WITH_ALL_FAILURE_EFFECT_BALLS.Description: Capture at least one Pokémon in a Potion Ball, a Slice Ball, a Leech Ball, and a Disable Ball.

FILL_ENTIRE_POKESTATE_PLOT.Name: Full House
FILL_ENTIRE_POKESTATE_PLOT.Description: Visit a PokÉstate plot that has 30 Pokémon in it.

REACH_PRIZCA_WEST_BEFORE_TERRAKION.Name: Detour
REACH_PRIZCA_WEST_BEFORE_TERRAKION.Description: Reach Prizca West without defeating the Avatar of Terrakion.

DEFEAT_MASTER_VANYA_FULL_GENDERLESS_TEAM.Name: Gender Schmender
DEFEAT_MASTER_VANYA_FULL_GENDERLESS_TEAM.Description: Defeat Pokémon Master Vanya with a full team of genderless Pokémon.

BELLA_BOUNTY_SUPERBOSS.Name: The Final Straw
BELLA_BOUNTY_SUPERBOSS.Description: Defeat Another Possible Rafael in the Path of Paradise.

WIN_BATTLE_MONUMENT.Name: Monumental
WIN_BATTLE_MONUMENT.Description: Complete a full attempt of the Battle Monument (5 battles won).

WIN_BATTLE_MONUMENT_ALL_SAME_GENERATION.Name: Limited Time
WIN_BATTLE_MONUMENT_ALL_SAME_GENERATION.Description: Complete a full attempt of the Battle Monument (5 battles won) with a Team whose members were all introduced in the same generation (Pokémon introduced in Tectonic count as a generation.)

WIN_BATTLE_MONUMENT_NO_TRIBE_OVERLAP.Name: Motley Crew
WIN_BATTLE_MONUMENT_NO_TRIBE_OVERLAP.Description: Complete a full attempt of the Battle Monument (5 battles won) with a Team whose members share no tribes in common.

ACHIEVE_TRIBAL_BONUS.Name: Clannish
ACHIEVE_TRIBAL_BONUS.Description: Start a battle while having an active Tribal bonus.

BATTLE_ACTIVE_MANY_HAZARDS.Name: Hazardous
BATTLE_ACTIVE_MANY_HAZARDS.Description: At the end of a turn, have four or more hazards active on the opponent's side.

BATTLE_ACTIVE_WEATHER_ROOM_SCREEN.Name: Worldbuilder
BATTLE_ACTIVE_WEATHER_ROOM_SCREEN.Description: At the end of a turn, have a Weather, a Room, and a Screen (on your side) active at the same time.

DEAL_LARGE_DAMAGE_1.Name: Isn't That Grand
DEAL_LARGE_DAMAGE_1.Description: Deal 1,000 or more damage in one hit.

DEAL_LARGE_DAMAGE_2.Name: Overkill
DEAL_LARGE_DAMAGE_2.Description: Deal 10,000 or more damage in one hit.

HOLD_LOTS_OF_MONEY.Name: No Inheritance Needed
HOLD_LOTS_OF_MONEY.Description: Hold 500,000 or more money at once.

STORE_LOTS_OF_EXP.Name: Banking on It
STORE_LOTS_OF_EXP.Description: Have more than 1,000,000 experience stored in the EXP-EZ Dispenser at once.

WIN_FISHING_CONTEST.Name: Hook Line and Sinker
WIN_FISHING_CONTEST.Description: Achieve the top prize at Aquatopia Menagerie's Ocean Fishing Contest.

REPEL.Name: Repel
REPEL.Description: An item that prevents wild Pokémon from appearing for 100 steps after its use.

STINKBOMB.Name: Stink Bomb
STINKBOMB.Description: Rare contraband. Any average solo trainer will flee from the stench of its explosion.

STEALTHSPRAY.Name: Stealth Spray
STEALTHSPRAY.Description: Rare contraband. Use it to become invisible to average solo trainers for 15 steps.

FIRESTONE.Name: Fire Stone
FIRESTONE.Description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is colored orange.

THUNDERSTONE.Name: Thunder Stone
THUNDERSTONE.Description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a thunderbolt pattern.

WATERSTONE.Name: Water Stone
WATERSTONE.Description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a clear, light blue.

LEAFSTONE.Name: Leaf Stone
LEAFSTONE.Description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a leaf pattern.

MOONSTONE.Name: Moon Stone
MOONSTONE.Description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as black as the night sky.

SUNSTONE.Name: Sun Stone
SUNSTONE.Description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as red as the sun.

DUSKSTONE.Name: Dusk Stone
DUSKSTONE.Description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as dark as dark can be.

DAWNSTONE.Name: Dawn Stone
DAWNSTONE.Description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It sparkles like eyes.

SHINYSTONE.Name: Shiny Stone
SHINYSTONE.Description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It shines with a dazzling light.

ICESTONE.Name: Ice Stone
ICESTONE.Description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a snowflake pattern.

PRISMSTONE.Name: Prism Stone
PRISMSTONE.Description: A many-colored stone that makes a lot of Pokémon evolve. Can be used in place of any evolution stone.

DIAMONDTIARA.Name: Diamond Tiara
DIAMONDTIARA.Description: A glimmering tiara made of diamonds. It makes a certain Pokémon evolve.

KNIGHTHELMET.Name: Knight Helmet
KNIGHTHELMET.Description: A shining helmet. It makes a certain Pokémon evolve.

NINJASCARF.Name: Ninja Scarf
NINJASCARF.Description: A cool scarf. It makes a certain Pokémon evolve.

ALOLANWREATH.Name: Alolan Wreath
ALOLANWREATH.Description: A beautiful floral wreath from Alola that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve.

GALARICAWREATH.Name: Galarica Wreath
GALARICAWREATH.Description: A wreath made from woven Galarica Twigs. It makes certain species of Pokémon evolve.

SWEETAPPLE.Name: Sweet Apple
SWEETAPPLE.Description: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It's exceptionally sweet.

TARTAPPLE.Name: Tart Apple
TARTAPPLE.Description: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It's exceptionally tart.

SYRUPYAPPLE.Name: Syrupy Apple
SYRUPYAPPLE.Description: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It's exceptionally syrupy.

HELIXFOSSIL.Name: Helix Fossil
HELIXFOSSIL.Description: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It resembles Omanyte.

DOMEFOSSIL.Name: Dome Fossil
DOMEFOSSIL.Description: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It resembles Kabuto.

OLDAMBER.Name: Old Amber
OLDAMBER.Description: A piece of amber that contains the genes of an Aerodactyl. It is clear with a reddish tint.

ROOTFOSSIL.Name: Root Fossil
ROOTFOSSIL.Description: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It resembles Lileep.

CLAWFOSSIL.Name: Claw Fossil
CLAWFOSSIL.Description: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It resembles Anorith.

SKULLFOSSIL.Name: Skull Fossil
SKULLFOSSIL.Description: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that lived on the land. It resembles Cranidos.

ARMORFOSSIL.Name: Armor Fossil
ARMORFOSSIL.Description: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that lived on the land. It resembles Shieldon.

COVERFOSSIL.Name: Cover Fossil
COVERFOSSIL.Description: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea in ancient times. It resembles Tirtouga.

PLUMEFOSSIL.Name: Plume Fossil
PLUMEFOSSIL.Description: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that flew in the sky in ancient times. It resembles Archen.

JAWFOSSIL.Name: Jaw Fossil
JAWFOSSIL.Description: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It resembles Tyrunt.

SAILFOSSIL.Name: Sail Fossil
SAILFOSSIL.Description: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It resembles Amaura.

ELDRITCHFOSSIL.Name: Eldritch Fossil
ELDRITCHFOSSIL.Description: A fossil from a strange Pokémon that once lived on the land. It resembles Makyan Omanyte.

ALIENFOSSIL.Name: Alien Fossil
ALIENFOSSIL.Description: A fossil from a strange Pokémon that once lived on the land. It resembles Makyan Kabuto.

HONEY.Name: Honey
HONEY.Description: A sweet honey with a sweeter aroma. It can be sold to shops for $750.

PRETTYFEATHER.Name: Pretty Feather
PRETTYFEATHER.Description: A beautiful feather. It can be sold to shops for $1,500.

NOBLEFEATHER.Name: Noble Feather
NOBLEFEATHER.Description: A beautiful metal feather. It can be sold to shops for $7,500.

BIGMUSHROOM.Name: Big Mushroom

PEARL.Name: Pearl
PEARL.Description: A somewhat-small pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold to shops for $1,000.

BIGPEARL.Name: Big Pearl
BIGPEARL.Description: A quite-large pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold to shops for $4,000.

PEARLSTRING.Name: Pearl String
PEARLSTRING.Description: Very large pearls that sparkle in a pretty silver color. It can be sold to shops for $10,000.

STARDUST.Name: Stardust
STARDUST.Description: Lovely, red-colored sand with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold to shops for $1,500.

STARPIECE.Name: Star Piece
STARPIECE.Description: A shard of a pretty gem that sparkles in a red color. It can be sold to shops for $6,000.

COMETSHARD.Name: Comet Shard
COMETSHARD.Description: A shard which fell to the ground when a comet approached. It can be sold to shops for $12,500.

NUGGET.Name: Gold Nugget
NUGGET.Description: A nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold to shops for $5,000.

BIGNUGGET.Name: Big Nugget
BIGNUGGET.Description: A big nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold to shops for $20,000.

SLOWPOKETAIL.Name: Slowpoke Tail
SLOWPOKETAIL.Description: A very tasty tail of something. It can be sold to shops for $4,000.

RAREBONE.Name: Rare Bone
RAREBONE.Description: A bone that is extremely valuable for Pokémon archaeology. It can be sold to shops for $2,500.

RELICCOPPER.Name: Relic Copper
RELICCOPPER.Description: A copper coin used in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. It can be sold to shops for $1,000.

RELICSILVER.Name: Relic Silver
RELICSILVER.Description: A silver coin used in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. It can be sold to shops for $5,000.

RELICGOLD.Name: Relic Gold
RELICGOLD.Description: A gold coin used in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. It can be sold to shops for $10,000.

RELICVASE.Name: Relic Vase
RELICVASE.Description: A vase made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. It can be sold to shops for $30,000.

RELICBAND.Name: Relic Band
RELICBAND.Description: A bracelet made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. It can be sold to shops for $80,000.

RELICSTATUE.Name: Relic Statue
RELICSTATUE.Description: A stone figure made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. Can be sold for $150,000.

RELICCROWN.Name: Relic Crown
RELICCROWN.Description: A crown made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. Can be sold for $300,000.

AIRBALLOON.Name: Air Balloon
AIRBALLOON.Description: Held item that makes the holder immune to Ground-type moves. Bursts once hit with any attack.

EVIOLITE.Name: Eviolite
EVIOLITE.Description: When held by a Pokémon who can still evolve, reduces move damage taken by 33%. Prevents evolution.

POWERLOCK.Name: Power Lock
POWERLOCK.Description: A held item. In battles, it sets the holder's base Attack stat to 120.

ENERGYLOCK.Name: Energy Lock
ENERGYLOCK.Description: A held item. In battles, it sets the holder's base Sp. Atk stat to 120.

FLOATSTONE.Name: Float Stone
FLOATSTONE.Description: A very light stone. It halves the weight of a Pokémon when held.

ASSAULTVEST.Name: Assault Vest
ASSAULTVEST.Description: A held item. It raises Sp. Def by 50% but prevents the use of status moves.

STRIKEVEST.Name: Strike Vest
STRIKEVEST.Description: A held item. It raises Defense by 50% but prevents the use of status moves.

WEAKNESSPOLICY.Name: Weakness Policy
WEAKNESSPOLICY.Description: A held item. Its Attack and Sp. Atk raise by four steps if hit by a move it's weak to.

ADRENALINEORB.Name: Adrenaline Orb
ADRENALINEORB.Description: When held, it boosts Speed by two steps when intimidated, fascinated, or frustrated once per battle.

ROCKYHELMET.Name: Rocky Helmet
ROCKYHELMET.Description: Damages attackers for 1/8th of their HP when they hit the holder with physical attacks.

HIVISJACKET.Name: Hi-Viz Jacket
HIVISJACKET.Description: Damages attackers for 1/8th of their HP when they hit the holder with special attacks.

EJECTBUTTON.Name: Eject Button
EJECTBUTTON.Description: If the holder is hit by an attack, it will switch with another Pokémon in your party.

REDCARD.Name: Red Card
REDCARD.Description: A card with a mysterious power. When the holder is struck by a foe, the attacker is removed from battle.

SHEDSHELL.Name: Shed Shell
SHEDSHELL.Description: A held item. This discarded carapace lets the holder switch out of battle without fail.

LUCKYEGG.Name: Lucky Egg
LUCKYEGG.Description: A held item. It is an egg filled with happiness that earns 50% extra Exp. Points in battle.

AMULETCOIN.Name: Amulet Coin
AMULETCOIN.Description: A held item. If the wielder enters a battle, money and coins generated in that battle are increased by 50%.

SOOTHEBELL.Name: Soothe Bell
SOOTHEBELL.Description: A held item. The comforting chime of this bell makes it gain happiness twice as fast.

CLEANSETAG.Name: Cleanse Tag
CLEANSETAG.Description: A held item. It prevents wild Pokémon encounters if the holder is the first one in the party.

CHOICEBAND.Name: Choice Band
CHOICEBAND.Description: Held item which ups Attack by 40%, but allows the use of only one move.

CHOICESPECS.Name: Choice Specs
CHOICESPECS.Description: Held item which ups Sp. Atk by 40%, but allows the use of only one move.

CHOICESCARF.Name: Choice Scarf
CHOICESCARF.Description: Held item which boosts Speed by 40% but allows the use of only one move.

LUMBERAXE.Name: Lumber Axe
LUMBERAXE.Description: Held item which boosts move damage by 25%, but lowers the user's Speed by 15%.

HEATROCK.Name: Heat Rock
HEATROCK.Description: A held item. When the holder summons sunshine, it lasts 50% longer.

DAMPROCK.Name: Damp Rock
DAMPROCK.Description: A held item. When the holder summons rainstorm, it lasts 50% longer.

SMOOTHROCK.Name: Smooth Rock
SMOOTHROCK.Description: A held item. When the holder summons a sandstorm, it lasts 50% longer.

ICYROCK.Name: Icy Rock
ICYROCK.Description: A held item. When the holder summons hail, it lasts 50% longer.

PINPOINTROCK.Name: Pin-Point Rock
PINPOINTROCK.Description: A held item. When the holder summons eclipse, it lasts 50% longer.

MIRROREDROCK.Name: Mirrored Rock
MIRROREDROCK.Description: A held item. When the holder summons moonglow, it lasts 50% longer.

LIGHTCLAY.Name: Light Clay
LIGHTCLAY.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Protective screens will be effective for 3 more turns.

REINFORCINGROD.Name: Reinforcing Rod
REINFORCINGROD.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles the duration of Rooms created by the holder.

GRIPCLAW.Name: Grip Claw
GRIPCLAW.Description: A held item that doubles the duration of binding moves and abilities.

LOADEDDICE.Name: Loaded Dice
LOADEDDICE.Description: A held item. It makes multi-hit attacks consistently hit 4 or 5 times.

FRAGILELOCKET.Name: Fragile Locket
FRAGILELOCKET.Description: A held item. The user gets both of its legal abilities, but its stats are cut by 10%.

TECHNIQUEBOOSTER.Name: Technique Booster
TECHNIQUEBOOSTER.Description: A held item. Signature attacks made by the holder are boosted by 40%.

BIGROOT.Name: Big Root
BIGROOT.Description: A held item. The holder recovers 30% more HP from draining moves, Aqua Ring, and leech.

BLACKSLUDGE.Name: Black Sludge
BLACKSLUDGE.Description: Item that restores the HP of Poison-types by 1/16th. Inflicts 1/8th damage on other types.

LEFTOVERS.Name: Leftovers
LEFTOVERS.Description: A held item. The holder's HP is restored by 1/16th at the end of each turn.

SHELLBELL.Name: Shell Bell
SHELLBELL.Description: A held item. The holder restores 1/5th HP of the damage it deals with moves.

WATERBALLOON.Name: Water Balloon
WATERBALLOON.Description: A held item. At half health, the holder breaks the balloon and gains an Aqua Ring, healing 10% HP per turn.

MENTALHERB.Name: Mental Herb
MENTALHERB.Description: A held item. It snaps the holder out of a variety of mental warping effects.

WHITEHERB.Name: White Herb
WHITEHERB.Description: A held item. It restores any lowered stat in battle.

BLACKHERB.Name: Black Herb
BLACKHERB.Description: A held item. Lowered stats on the holder are also applied to foes.

AGILITYHERB.Name: Agility Herb
AGILITYHERB.Description: A held item. Doubles the Speed of the holder's move once per battle.

STRENGTHHERB.Name: Strength Herb
STRENGTHHERB.Description: A held item. Boosts the power of a special move by 15% and makes it physical, once per battle.

INTELLECTHERB.Name: Intellect Herb
INTELLECTHERB.Description: A held item. Boosts the power of a physical move by 15% and makes it special, once per battle.

POWERHERB.Name: Power Herb
POWERHERB.Description: A held item. It allows the immediate use of a move that charges up first.

ENERGYHERB.Name: Energy Herb
ENERGYHERB.Description: A held item. It allows user to skip the recharging turn of an exhausting move.

MIRRORHERB.Name: Mirror Herb
MIRRORHERB.Description: A held item. When a foe raises their stats, the herb is consumed to copy the increase.

PARADOXHERB.Name: Paradox Herb
PARADOXHERB.Description: A held item. When a foe raises their stats, the herb is consumed to reset their stats.

LUCKHERB.Name: Luck Herb
LUCKHERB.Description: A held item. Ensures a random additional effect activates once per battle.

SKILLHERB.Name: Skill Herb
SKILLHERB.Description: A held item. Ensures a less than full accuracy move lands once per battle.

LIFEORB.Name: Life Orb
LIFEORB.Description: A held item. It boosts the power of moves by 30%, but at the cost of 10% HP on each hit.

EXPERTBELT.Name: Expert Belt
EXPERTBELT.Description: A well-worn belt that boosts the holder's supereffective moves by 20%.

METRONOME.Name: Metronome
METRONOME.Description: A held item. Boosts a move used consecutively by 20% more each time. This resets if another move is used.

MUSCLEBAND.Name: Muscle Band
MUSCLEBAND.Description: A held item. It is a headband that boosts the power of physical moves by 15%.

WISEGLASSES.Name: Wise Glasses
WISEGLASSES.Description: A held item. It is a thick pair of glasses that boosts the power of special moves by 15%.

SEVENLEAGUEBOOTS.Name: 7-League Boots
SEVENLEAGUEBOOTS.Description: A held item. They are boots that boost Speed by 10%.

SCOPELENS.Name: Scope Lens
SCOPELENS.Description: A held item. Doubles the holder's critical-hit chance.

WIDELENS.Name: Wide Lens
WIDELENS.Description: A held item. It is a magnifying lens that boosts the Accuracy of moves by 35%.

LAGGINGTAIL.Name: Lagging Tail
LAGGINGTAIL.Description: Held item which forces the holder to move last in its priority bracket.

FOCUSSASH.Name: Focus Sash
FOCUSSASH.Description: A held item. If it has full HP, the holder will endure one potential KO attack, leaving 1 HP.

FLAMEORB.Name: Flame Orb
FLAMEORB.Description: A held item. A bizarre orb that inflicts burn on the holder at the end of a turn.

FROSTORB.Name: Frost Orb
FROSTORB.Description: A held item. A bizarre orb that inflicts frostbite on the holder at the end of a turn.

POISONORB.Name: Poison Orb
POISONORB.Description: A held item. A bizarre orb that inflicts poison on the holder at the end of a turn.

STICKYBARB.Name: Sticky Barb
STICKYBARB.Description: A held item that damages the holder on every turn. It may latch on to Pokémon that attacks the holder.

EJECTPACK.Name: Eject Pack
EJECTPACK.Description: A held item. When the holder's stats are lowered, it will be switched out of battle.

HEAVYDUTYBOOTS.Name: Heavy-Duty Boots
HEAVYDUTYBOOTS.Description: These boots prevent the effects of hazards set on the battlefield.

THROATSPRAY.Name: Throat Spray
THROATSPRAY.Description: Raises Sp. Atk by two steps when the Pokémon uses a sound move the first time each battle.

WHETSTONE.Name: Whetstone
WHETSTONE.Description: Raises Attack by two steps when the Pokémon uses a slice move the first time each battle.

PINWHEEL.Name: Pinwheel
PINWHEEL.Description: Raises Speed by two steps when the Pokémon uses a wind move the first time each battle.

INSOLES.Name: Insoles
INSOLES.Description: Raises Speed by two steps when the Pokémon uses a kicking move the first time each battle.

PROTEINSHAKE.Name: Protein Shake
PROTEINSHAKE.Description: Consumed to heal for one third of max HP when the Pokémon uses a punching move. This can overheal.

STRESSBALL.Name: Stress Ball
STRESSBALL.Description: Consumed to heal for one third of max HP when the Pokémon uses a pulse move. This can overheal.

WHITENINGPASTE.Name: Whitening Paste
WHITENINGPASTE.Description: Blinds all foes when the Pokémon uses a biting move the first time each battle.

FLASHBULB.Name: Flash Bulb
FLASHBULB.Description: Blinds all foes when the Pokémon uses a light move the first time each battle.

UTILITYUMBRELLA.Name: Utility Umbrella
UTILITYUMBRELLA.Description: A held item. The holder is protected from the negative effects of weather.

CRYSTALVEIL.Name: Crystal Veil
CRYSTALVEIL.Description: A held item. It changes the holder's type in battle. You can change which type between battles.

MEMORYSET.Name: Memory Set
MEMORYSET.Description: A set of memory discs, one for each type. If held by a Silvally, you can change its type between battles.

PRISMATICPLATE.Name: Prismatic Plate
PRISMATICPLATE.Description: A tablet that boosts same-type moves by 20%. If held by Arceus, you can change its type between battles.

WILDCARD.Name: Wild Card
WILDCARD.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It counts as a member of every tribe.

PROXYFIST.Name: Proxy Fist
PROXYFIST.Description: A held item. The holder doesn't trigger items, abilities, or effects of targets it hits.

COVERTCLOAK.Name: Covert Cloak
COVERTCLOAK.Description: A held item. Moves used against the holder deal 10% less move damage and can't trigger random added effects.

COURAGEBADGE.Name: Courage Badge
COURAGEBADGE.Description: A held item. The holder is protected from flinching.

CLEARAMULET.Name: Clear Amulet
CLEARAMULET.Description: A held item. The holder is protected from stat drops (except when self-inflicted).

ADAMANTCRYSTAL.Name: Adamant Crystal
ADAMANTCRYSTAL.Description: When used on Dialga, this large, glowing gem wells with power and allows the Pokémon to change form.

LUSTROUSGLOBE.Name: Lustrous Globe
LUSTROUSGLOBE.Description: When used on Palkia, this large, glowing orb wells with power and allows the Pokémon to change form.

GRISEOUSCORE.Name: Griseous Core
GRISEOUSCORE.Description: When used on Giratina, this large, glowing gem wells with power and allows the Pokémon to change form.

DOUSEDRIVE.Name: Douse Drive
DOUSEDRIVE.Description: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Techno Blast to a Water-type move.

SHOCKDRIVE.Name: Shock Drive
SHOCKDRIVE.Description: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Techno Blast to an Electric-type move.

BURNDRIVE.Name: Burn Drive
BURNDRIVE.Description: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Techno Blast to a Fire-type move.

CHILLDRIVE.Name: Chill Drive
CHILLDRIVE.Description: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Techno Blast to an Ice-type move.

EVERSTONE.Name: Everstone
EVERSTONE.Description: A held item. The Pokémon holding this peculiar stone is prevented from evolving.

IRONBALL.Name: Iron Ball
IRONBALL.Description: Held item that halves Speed. It makes Flying-type and levitating holders susceptible to Ground moves.

CHARCOAL.Name: Charcoal
CHARCOAL.Description: A combustible fuel that boosts the holder's Fire-type moves by 20%.

MYSTICWATER.Name: Mystic Water
MYSTICWATER.Description: A teardrop-shaped gem that boosts the holder's Water-type moves by 20%.

MAGNET.Name: Magnet
MAGNET.Description: A powerful magnet that boosts the holder's Electric-type moves by 20%.

MIRACLESEED.Name: Miracle Seed
MIRACLESEED.Description: A seed imbued with life that boosts the holder's Grass-type moves by 20%.

NEVERMELTICE.Name: Never-Melt Ice
NEVERMELTICE.Description: A piece of ice that repels heat and boosts Ice-type moves by 20%.

BLACKBELT.Name: Black Belt
BLACKBELT.Description: A belt that boosts determination and Fighting-type moves by 20%.

POISONBARB.Name: Poison Barb
POISONBARB.Description: A small, poisonous barb that boosts the holder's Poison-type moves by 20%.

SOFTSAND.Name: Soft Sand
SOFTSAND.Description: A loose, silky sand that boosts the holder's Ground-type moves by 20%.

SHARPBEAK.Name: Sharp Beak
SHARPBEAK.Description: A long, sharp beak that boosts the holder's Flying-type moves by 20%.

TWISTEDSPOON.Name: Twisted Spoon
TWISTEDSPOON.Description: A spoon imbued with telekinetic power that boosts Psychic-type moves by 20%.

SILVERPOWDER.Name: Silver Powder
SILVERPOWDER.Description: A shiny, silver powder that boosts the holder's Bug-type moves by 20%.

HARDSTONE.Name: Hard Stone
HARDSTONE.Description: An unbreakable stone that boosts the holder's Rock-type moves by 20%.

SPELLTAG.Name: Spell Tag
SPELLTAG.Description: A sinister, eerie tag that boosts the holder's Ghost-type moves by 20%.

DRAGONFANG.Name: Dragon Fang
DRAGONFANG.Description: A hard and sharp fang that boosts the holder's Dragon-type moves by 20%.

BLACKGLASSES.Name: Black Glasses
BLACKGLASSES.Description: A shady-looking pair of glasses that boosts the holder's Dark-type moves by 20%.

METALCOAT.Name: Metal Coat
METALCOAT.Description: A special metallic film that boosts the holder's Steel-type moves by 20%.

SILKSCARF.Name: Silk Scarf
SILKSCARF.Description: A sumptuous scarf that boosts the holder's Normal-type moves by 20%.

FAIRYFEATHER.Name: Fairy Feather
FAIRYFEATHER.Description: A gleaming feather that boosts the holder's Fairy-type moves by 20%.

FIREGEM.Name: Fire Gem
FIREGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of fire. Boosts the power of a Fire-type move by 50% once per battle.

WATERGEM.Name: Water Gem
WATERGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of water. Boosts the power of a Water-type move by 50% once per battle.

ELECTRICGEM.Name: Electric Gem
ELECTRICGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of electricity. Boosts the power of an Electric-type move by 50% once per battle.

GRASSGEM.Name: Grass Gem
GRASSGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of nature. Boosts the power of a Grass-type move by 50% once per battle.

ICEGEM.Name: Ice Gem
ICEGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of ice. Boosts the power of an Ice-type move by 50% once per battle.

FIGHTINGGEM.Name: Fighting Gem
FIGHTINGGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of combat. Boosts the power of a Fighting-type move by 50% once per battle.

POISONGEM.Name: Poison Gem
POISONGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of poison. Boosts the power of a Poison-type move by 50% once per battle.

GROUNDGEM.Name: Ground Gem
GROUNDGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of land. Boosts the power of a Ground-type move by 50% once per battle.

FLYINGGEM.Name: Flying Gem
FLYINGGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of air. Boosts the power of a Flying-type move by 50% once per battle.

PSYCHICGEM.Name: Psychic Gem
PSYCHICGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of the mind. Boosts the power of a Psychic-type move by 50% once per battle.

BUGGEM.Name: Bug Gem
BUGGEM.Description: A gem with an insect-like essence. Boosts the power of a Bug-type move by 50% once per battle.

ROCKGEM.Name: Rock Gem
ROCKGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of rock. Boosts the power of a Rock-type move by 50% once per battle.

GHOSTGEM.Name: Ghost Gem
GHOSTGEM.Description: A gem with a spectral essence. Boosts the power of a Ghost-type move by 50% once per battle.

DRAGONGEM.Name: Dragon Gem
DRAGONGEM.Description: A gem with a draconic essence. Boosts the power of a Dragon-type move by 50% once per battle.

DARKGEM.Name: Dark Gem
DARKGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of darkness. Boosts the power of a Dark-type move by 50% once per battle.

STEELGEM.Name: Steel Gem
STEELGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of steel. Boosts the power of a Steel-type move by 50% once per battle.

NORMALGEM.Name: Normal Gem
NORMALGEM.Description: A gem with an ordinary essence. Boosts the power of a Normal-type move by 50% once per battle.

FAIRYGEM.Name: Fairy Gem
FAIRYGEM.Description: A gem with an essence of the fey. Boosts the power of a Fairy-type move by 50% once per battle.

POTION.Name: Potion
POTION.Description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon, fainted or able, by 40 points.

SUPERPOTION.Name: Super Potion
SUPERPOTION.Description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon, fainted or able, by 80 points.

HYPERPOTION.Name: Hyper Potion
HYPERPOTION.Description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon, fainted or able, by 120 points.

MAXPOTION.Name: Max Potion
MAXPOTION.Description: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It completely restores the HP of a single Pokémon, fainted or able.

FULLRESTORE.Name: Full Restore
FULLRESTORE.Description: A medicine that fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of a single Pokémon, fainted or able.

SACREDASH.Name: Sacred Ash
SACREDASH.Description: It revives all fainted Pokémon. In doing so, it also fully restores their HP.

LAVACOOKIE.Name: Lava Cookie
LAVACOOKIE.Description: Lavaridge Town's local specialty. It heals all the status problems of one Pokémon.

OLDGATEAU.Name: Old Gateau
OLDGATEAU.Description: Old Chateau's hidden specialty. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

CASTELIACONE.Name: Casteliacone
CASTELIACONE.Description: Castelia City's specialty, soft-serve ice cream. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

BERRYJUICE.Name: Berry Juice
BERRYJUICE.Description: A 100% pure juice made of Berries. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

RAGECANDYBAR.Name: Rage Candy Bar
RAGECANDYBAR.Description: Mahogany Town's famous candy. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.

SWEETHEART.Name: Sweet Heart
SWEETHEART.Description: Very sweet chocolate. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 40 points and makes it happier.

FRESHWATER.Name: Fresh Water
FRESHWATER.Description: Water with a high mineral content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

SODAPOP.Name: Soda Pop
SODAPOP.Description: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 100 points.

LEMONADE.Name: Lemonade
LEMONADE.Description: A very sweet drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 150 points.

MOOMOOMILK.Name: Moomoo Milk
MOOMOOMILK.Description: Nutritious milk. It fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of a single Pokémon.

RARECANDY.Name: Rare Candy
RARECANDY.Description: A candy that is packed with energy. It raises the level of a single Pokémon by one.

VANILLATULUMBA.Name: Vanilla Tulumba
VANILLATULUMBA.Description: Fried dough dipped in vanilla syrup. Heals a single Pokémon by 100 HP, and grants it 4000 Experience points.

SAFARIBALL.Name: Safari Ball
SAFARIBALL.Description: A special Poké Ball that is used only in the Safari Zone. It is decorated in a camouflage pattern.

SPORTBALL.Name: Sport Ball
SPORTBALL.Description: A special Poké Ball for the Bug-Catching Contest.

BALLLAUNCHER.Name: Ball Launcher
BALLLAUNCHER.Description: A device which creates then launches regular Poké Balls, never running out.

POKEBALL.Name: Poké Ball
POKEBALL.Description: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It is thrown like a ball at the target. It is designed as a capsule system.

GREATBALL.Name: Great Ball
GREATBALL.Description: A good, high-performance Ball with 1.5x strength compared to a regular ball.

ULTRABALL.Name: Ultra Ball
ULTRABALL.Description: An ultra-performance Ball with 2x the strength of a regular ball.

SLICEBALL.Name: Slice Ball
SLICEBALL.Description: A sharp Poké Ball that damages the Pokémon for 1/4th of its HP if it fails to catch it.

POTIONBALL.Name: Potion Ball
POTIONBALL.Description: A medicinal Poké Ball that heals the Pokémon for 1/4th of its HP if it fails to catch it.

LEECHBALL.Name: Leech Ball
LEECHBALL.Description: A parasitic Poké Ball that leeches the Pokémon if it fails to catch it.

DISABLEBALL.Name: Disable Ball
DISABLEBALL.Description: A disorienting Poké Ball that disables the Pokémon's last used move for 10 turns if it fails to catch it.

HEALBALL.Name: Heal Ball
HEALBALL.Description: A remedial Poké Ball that restores the caught Pokémon's HP and eliminates any status problem.

FRIENDBALL.Name: Friend Ball
FRIENDBALL.Description: A Poké Ball that makes caught Pokémon more friendly.

LUXURYBALL.Name: Luxury Ball
LUXURYBALL.Description: A comfortable Poké Ball that makes a caught wild Pokémon gain happiness twice as quickly.

TIMERBALL.Name: Timer Ball
TIMERBALL.Description: A somewhat different Ball that becomes up to 4x better the more turns there are in a battle.

QUICKBALL.Name: Quick Ball
QUICKBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball which has 3x strength on the first turn of a wild encounter.

NESTBALL.Name: Nest Ball
NESTBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works better the lower the Pokémon's level is below your level cap.

REPEATBALL.Name: Repeat Ball
REPEATBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works at 3.5x strength on Pokémon species that were previously caught.

HEAVYBALL.Name: Heavy Ball
HEAVYBALL.Description: A Poké Ball whose strength varies with the Pokémon's weight.

FASTBALL.Name: Fast Ball
FASTBALL.Description: A Poké Ball with 4x strength against Pokémon species with 100 or more base Speed.

DREAMBALL.Name: Dream Ball
DREAMBALL.Description: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon while they're asleep.

BEASTBALL.Name: Beast Ball
BEASTBALL.Description: A special Poké Ball with 5x strength against Ultra Beasts.

PREMIERBALL.Name: Premier Ball
PREMIERBALL.Description: A somewhat rare Poké Ball that has been specially made to commemorate an event of some sort.

CHERISHBALL.Name: Cherish Ball
CHERISHBALL.Description: A quite rare Poké Ball that has been specially crafted to commemorate an occasion of some sort.

ROYALBALL.Name: Royal Ball
ROYALBALL.Description: A ball whose striking appearance makes it popular despite its poor performance.

MASTERBALL.Name: Master Ball
MASTERBALL.Description: The best Ball with the ultimate level of performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

RADIANTBALL.Name: Radiant Ball
RADIANTBALL.Description: A ball with a mythical quality. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail, and turn that Pokémon shiny.

ARCBALL.Name: Arc Ball
ARCBALL.Description: The Poke ball that contains Arceus. Unable to be replicated by humans, so how did you see this description.

CHERIBERRY.Name: Cheri Berry
CHERIBERRY.Description: A held item that can cure numbing.

CHESTOBERRY.Name: Chesto Berry
CHESTOBERRY.Description: A held item that can cure sleep.

PECHABERRY.Name: Pecha Berry
PECHABERRY.Description: A held item that can cure poison.

RAWSTBERRY.Name: Rawst Berry
RAWSTBERRY.Description: A held item that can cure burn.

ASPEARBERRY.Name: Aspear Berry
ASPEARBERRY.Description: A held item that can cure frostbite.

PERSIMBERRY.Name: Persim Berry
PERSIMBERRY.Description: A held item that can cure dizzy.

SPELONBERRY.Name: Spelon Berry
SPELONBERRY.Description: A held item that can cure leeched.

BELUEBERRY.Name: Belue Berry
BELUEBERRY.Description: A held item that can cure waterlogged.

LEPPABERRY.Name: Leppa Berry
LEPPABERRY.Description: A held item that can restore a move's PP by 10.

LUMBERRY.Name: Lum Berry
LUMBERRY.Description: A held item that can cure any status problem.

SITRUSBERRY.Name: Sitrus Berry
SITRUSBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it heals its HP by 25% at half health.

CADOBERRY.Name: Cado Berry
CADOBERRY.Description: It may be held by a Pokémon to heal the user by 33% in a pinch (below 25% HP).

OCCABERRY.Name: Occa Berry
OCCABERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Fire-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

PASSHOBERRY.Name: Passho Berry
PASSHOBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Water-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

WACANBERRY.Name: Wacan Berry
WACANBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Electric-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

RINDOBERRY.Name: Rindo Berry
RINDOBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Grass-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

YACHEBERRY.Name: Yache Berry
YACHEBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Ice-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

CHOPLEBERRY.Name: Chople Berry
CHOPLEBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Fighting-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

KEBIABERRY.Name: Kebia Berry
KEBIABERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Poison-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

SHUCABERRY.Name: Shuca Berry
SHUCABERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Ground-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

COBABERRY.Name: Coba Berry
COBABERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Flying-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

PAYAPABERRY.Name: Payapa Berry
PAYAPABERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Psychic-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

TANGABERRY.Name: Tanga Berry
TANGABERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Bug-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

CHARTIBERRY.Name: Charti Berry
CHARTIBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Rock-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

KASIBBERRY.Name: Kasib Berry
KASIBBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Ghost-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

HABANBERRY.Name: Haban Berry
HABANBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Dragon-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

COLBURBERRY.Name: Colbur Berry
COLBURBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Dark-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

BABIRIBERRY.Name: Babiri Berry
BABIRIBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Steel-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

ROSELIBERRY.Name: Roseli Berry
ROSELIBERRY.Description: Weakens a supereffective Fairy-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

CHILANBERRY.Name: Chilan Berry
CHILANBERRY.Description: Weakens a Normal-type attack against the holding Pokémon by 50%.

LIECHIBERRY.Name: Liechi Berry
LIECHIBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Attack by two steps in a pinch.

GANLONBERRY.Name: Ganlon Berry
GANLONBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Defense by three steps in a pinch.

SALACBERRY.Name: Salac Berry
SALACBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Speed by two steps in a pinch.

PETAYABERRY.Name: Petaya Berry
PETAYABERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Sp. Atk by two steps in a pinch.

APICOTBERRY.Name: Apicot Berry
APICOTBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Sp. Def by three steps in a pinch.

LANSATBERRY.Name: Lansat Berry
LANSATBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its critical-hit ratio in a pinch.

STARFBERRY.Name: Starf Berry
STARFBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it raises one of its stats by three steps in a pinch.

ENIGMABERRY.Name: Enigma Berry
ENIGMABERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it heals its HP by 33% if it is hit by any supereffective attack.

MICLEBERRY.Name: Micle Berry
MICLEBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it raises its Accuracy by four steps in a pinch.

CUSTAPBERRY.Name: Custap Berry
CUSTAPBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it gets to move first just once in a pinch.

JABOCABERRY.Name: Jaboca Berry
JABOCABERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon and a physical attack hits it, the attacker takes 25% HP damage.

ROWAPBERRY.Name: Rowap Berry
ROWAPBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon and a special attack hits it, the attacker takes 25% HP damage.

KEEBERRY.Name: Kee Berry
KEEBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon and a physical attack hits it, raises the holder's Defense by three steps.

MARANGABERRY.Name: Maranga Berry
MARANGABERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon and a special attack hits it, raises the holder's Sp. Def by three steps.

BICYCLE.Name: Bicycle
BICYCLE.Description: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.

TOWNMAP.Name: Region Map
TOWNMAP.Description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

GRACIDEA.Name: Gracidea
GRACIDEA.Description: A flower that conveys gratitude. Use it to transform Shaymin into or out of Sky form.

DNASPLICERS.Name: DNA Splicers
DNASPLICERS.Description: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokémon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.

REVEALGLASS.Name: Reveal Glass
REVEALGLASS.Description: A glass that reveals the truth. It is a mysterious glass that returns a Pokémon back to its original shape.

SHINYCHARM.Name: Shiny Charm
SHINYCHARM.Description: A shiny charm which doubles the chance of finding a Shiny Pokémon.

SWEETTOOTH.Name: Sweet Tooth
SWEETTOOTH.Description: A charm in the shape of a tooth. It increases the EXP. gained from EXP Candy by 15%.

SOOTHECHARM.Name: Soothe Charm
SOOTHECHARM.Description: A comforting charm which doubles the happiness your Pokémon gain from being close to you.

REDORB.Name: Red Orb
REDORB.Description: A shiny red orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It's known to be connected with the Hoenn region.

BLUEORB.Name: Blue Orb
BLUEORB.Description: A shiny blue orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It's known to be connected with the Hoenn region.

LIGHTSTONE.Name: Light Stone
LIGHTSTONE.Description: Reshiram's body, in stone form. An expert in ancient relics may be able to transform it.

DARKSTONE.Name: Dark Stone
DARKSTONE.Description: Zekrom's body, in stone form. An expert in ancient relics may be able to transform it.

LUMIOSEGALETTE.Name: Lumiose Galette
LUMIOSEGALETTE.Description: A popular treat in Lumiose City. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.

SHALOURSABLE.Name: Shalour Sable
SHALOURSABLE.Description: Shalour City's famous shortbread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.

BIGMALASADA.Name: Big Malasada
BIGMALASADA.Description: The Alola region's specialty--fried bread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.

ABILITYCAPSULE.Name: Ability Capsule
ABILITYCAPSULE.Description: A capsule that allows a Pokémon with two Abilities to switch between these Abilities when it is used.

PRISONBOTTLE.Name: Prison Bottle
PRISONBOTTLE.Description: A bottle believed to have been used to seal away the power of a certain Pokémon long, long ago.

NSOLARIZER.Name: N-Solarizer
NSOLARIZER.Description: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Solgaleo.

NLUNARIZER.Name: N-Lunarizer
NLUNARIZER.Description: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Lunala.

ZYGARDECUBE.Name: Zygarde Cube
ZYGARDECUBE.Description: An item holding Zygarde's Cores and Cells. You can use it to change Zygarde's form.

EXPCANDYXS.Name: Exp. Candy XS
EXPCANDYXS.Description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon 250 Exp. Points.

EXPCANDYS.Name: Exp. Candy S
EXPCANDYS.Description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon 1000 Exp. Points.

EXPCANDYM.Name: Exp. Candy M
EXPCANDYM.Description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon 4,000 Exp. Points.

EXPCANDYL.Name: Exp. Candy L
EXPCANDYL.Description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon 16,000 Exp. Points.

EXPCANDYXL.Name: Exp. Candy XL
EXPCANDYXL.Description: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon 64,000 Exp. Points.

FOSSILIZEDBIRD.Name: Fossilized Bird
FOSSILIZEDBIRD.Description: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once soared through the sky. Is it Arctozolt or Dracozolt...?

FOSSILIZEDFISH.Name: Fossilized Fish
FOSSILIZEDFISH.Description: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. Is it Arctovish or Dracovish...?

FOSSILIZEDDRAKE.Name: Fossilized Drake
FOSSILIZEDDRAKE.Description: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once roamed the land. Is it Dracozolt or Dracovish...?

FOSSILIZEDDINO.Name: Fossilized Dino
FOSSILIZEDDINO.Description: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. Is it Arctozolt or Arctovish...?

RUSTEDSHIELD.Name: Rusted Shield
RUSTEDSHIELD.Description: Used by a hero to halt a terrible disaster. The wielder takes 10% less move damage.

RUSTEDSWORD.Name: Rusted Sword
RUSTEDSWORD.Description: Used by a hero to halt a terrible disaster. The wielder deals 10% more move damage.

REINSOFUNITY.Name: Reins of Unity
REINSOFUNITY.Description: Reins that people presented to the king. They enable Calyrex to connect with its beloved steed.

EXPCHARM.Name: EXP Charm
EXPCHARM.Description: A charm that increases the EXP. Pokémon earn by 10%. A machine-like object is inside the charm.

CATCHINGCHARM.Name: Catching Charm
CATCHINGCHARM.Description: A charm that doubles the chance of getting a critical catch.

GRASSTOKEN.Name: Grass Token
GRASSTOKEN.Description: A token which can be exchanged for a Grass-type at the Starter Store in Novo Town.

WATERTOKEN.Name: Water Token
WATERTOKEN.Description: A token which can be exchanged for a Water-type at the Starter Store in Novo Town.

ORIGINORE.Name: Origin Ore
ORIGINORE.Description: A peculiar ore that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. Associated with Arceus.

FIRETOKEN.Name: Fire Token
FIRETOKEN.Description: A token which can be exchanged for a Fire-type at the Starter Store in Novo Town.

DRATINIEGG.Name: Dratini Egg
DRATINIEGG.Description: An abandoned Dratini egg that is cold and calm. Only an expert would be able to hatch it.

BAGONEGG.Name: Bagon Egg
BAGONEGG.Description: An abandoned Bagon egg that is cold and calm. Only an expert would be able to hatch it.

GIBLEEGG.Name: Gible Egg
GIBLEEGG.Description: An abandoned Gible egg that is cold and calm. Only an expert would be able to hatch it.

DEINOEGG.Name: Deino Egg
DEINOEGG.Description: An abandoned Deino egg that is cold and calm. Only an expert would be able to hatch it.

GOOMYEGG.Name: Goomy Egg
GOOMYEGG.Description: An abandoned Goomy egg that is cold and calm. Only an expert would be able to hatch it.

JANGMOOEGG.Name: Jangmo-o Egg
JANGMOOEGG.Description: An abandoned Jangmo-o egg that is cold and calm. Only an expert would be able to hatch it.

DREEPYEGG.Name: Dreepy Egg
DREEPYEGG.Description: An abandoned Dreepy egg that is cold and calm. Only an expert would be able to hatch it.

EEVEETICKET.Name: Eevee Ticket
EEVEETICKET.Description: A ticket that can be exchanged for an Eevee at the Skeevy Eevee Pub.

AIDKIT.Name: Aid Kit
AIDKIT.Description: Heals your whole team a limited number of times. Restocked at PokeCenters and after resting.

KITEXPANSION.Name: Kit Expansion
KITEXPANSION.Description: A pack for holding medicine. If you use it, your Aid Kit will gain a max charge.

MEDICALUPGRADE.Name: Medical Upgrade
MEDICALUPGRADE.Description: A suite of medicines. If you use it, your Aid Kit will heal more efficiently.

DYNAMITESTICK.Name: Dynamite Stick
DYNAMITESTICK.Description: A stick of dynamite, perfectly suited to destroying small bits of rock.

FIGMENT.Name: Figment
FIGMENT.Description: A wisp of ideas with infinite potential. Use it on a Pokémon to teach any one of their legal moves.

SACCHARITEPICK.Name: Saccharite Pick
SACCHARITEPICK.Description: A food grade mining tool. Allows you to extract EXP. Candy from saccharite deposits.

SURFBOARD.Name: Surf Board
SURFBOARD.Description: A surf board, allowing you to surf on water.

CHASMIDCARD.Name: Chasm ID Card
CHASMIDCARD.Description: An ID card which unlocks Team Chasm gates and doors, giving access to dangers and rewards.

CLIMBINGGEAR.Name: Climbing Gear
CLIMBINGGEAR.Description: A set of climbing gear, allowing you to climb on white rocks.

FLORASCEPTRE.Name: Flora Sceptre
FLORASCEPTRE.Description: An ancient kingly rod. You can use it to make certain plants grow.

ABRAPORTER.Name: Abraporter
ABRAPORTER.Description: A teleporter which brings you to your last safe spot using the power of Abras.

REMATERIALIZER.Name: Rematerializer
REMATERIALIZER.Description: A 3D printer which automatically copies consumed held items after battles.

EXPEZDISPENSER.Name: EXP-EZ Dispenser
EXPEZDISPENSER.Description: A machine that stores EXP Candy and excess EXP. Use it on your Pokémon to feed them candy.

UNIVERSALFORMALIZER.Name: Universal Formalizer
UNIVERSALFORMALIZER.Description: Use on a Pokémon to switch it into another one of its forms.

SPANNINGBAND.Name: Spanning Bands
SPANNINGBAND.Description: An ancient pair of interlocking ceramic rings. Unlocks the ability to teleport between Avatar Totems.

POCKETTOTEM.Name: Pocket Totem
POCKETTOTEM.Description: A miniature Avatar Totem. Use it to teleport to any unlocked Avatar Totems throughout Makya.

BOXLINK.Name: Box Link
BOXLINK.Description: An advanced transporter which allows you to access your Pokémon Storage to withdraw or deposit Pokémon.

STYLINGKIT.Name: Styling Kit
STYLINGKIT.Description: A suite of training tools which allows you to modify your Pokémon's style points.

TAROTAMULET.Name: Tarot Amulet
TAROTAMULET.Description: If reversed, gym leaders and story fights will become harder through unique curses.

TAROTAMULET_ACTIVE.Name: Tarot Amulet
TAROTAMULET_ACTIVE.Description: If reversed, gym leaders and story fights will become harder through unique curses.

NOISEMACHINE.Name: Noise Machine
NOISEMACHINE.Description: A small, versatile machine that can be used to repel wild Pokémon, or draw them near.

POKEMONLURE.Name: Pokémon Lure
POKEMONLURE.Description: A fragrance that increases the chance of wild double battles, and attracts uncaught Pokémon.

POKEXRAY.Name: Poké X-Ray
POKEXRAY.Description: A high tech surveillance device. Use it to scout out the teams of nearby trainers or mid-battle.

POKEXRAY2.Name: Poké X-Ray 2
POKEXRAY2.Description: Used to scout the teams of nearby trainers and the behaviour of nearby Avatars. Can also be used mid-battle.

CELLBOOSTER.Name: Cell Booster
CELLBOOSTER.Description: Condensed essence of life. Holding it allows you to run, bike, and surf faster. Can be toggled on or off.

RUSTEDCOMPASS.Name: Rusted Compass
RUSTEDCOMPASS.Description: A small compass. Relic of a heroic age. It can be used to find lootable items nearby.

MAGNETICGAUNTLET.Name: Magnetic Gauntlet
MAGNETICGAUNTLET.Description: An electrified glove with a claw-like shape. Recovers the first failed Poké Ball thrown in a wild battle.

CHROMACLARION.Name: Chroma Clarion
CHROMACLARION.Description: An ancient horn. Sound it to start a 3v3 wild battle. Foes will be higher level and likely to have rare moves.

HOUSEDEED1.Name: House Deed
HOUSEDEED1.Description: Proof of ownership for the house you bought in Prizca East.

GLEAMPOWDER.Name: Gleam Powder
GLEAMPOWDER.Description: A small vial of gleaming powder. Can be used once to ensure the next wild Pokémon you find is shiny.

VIRALHELIX.Name: Viral Helix
VIRALHELIX.Description: Infinitely mutating alien DNA. It allows a Pokémon with two abilities to switch abilities when used.

PERFORMANCEANALYZER.Name: Performance Analyzer
PERFORMANCEANALYZER.Description: A hi-tech recording device which creates a Battle Report by analyzing the results of momentous battles.

PERFORMANCEANALYZER2.Name: Performance Analyzer 2
PERFORMANCEANALYZER2.Description: An upgraded, hi-tech recording device. It increases experience earned from battles by 10%.

BATTLEREPORT.Name: Battle Report
BATTLEREPORT.Description: A detailed report on how to improve as a trainer. If you decide to read it, your level cap will be raised by 5.

MILKBONETREAT.Name: Milk Bone Treat
MILKBONETREAT.Description: It would be a delicious treat if you were a Pokémon.

OMNIDRIVE.Name: OmniDrive
OMNIDRIVE.Description: A mysterious data storage device. Plug it into any PC to unlock The Omnitutor.

ANCIENTSEAWATER.Name: Ancient Sea Water
ANCIENTSEAWATER.Description: A vial of shimmering ocean water. It makes a certain Pokémon evolve.

CUPOFCOFFEE.Name: Cup of Coffee
CUPOFCOFFEE.Description: It's a cup filled with warm coffee. You probably shouldn't be keeping this in your backpack.

LUXTECHSHIPMENT.Name: LuxTech Shipment
LUXTECHSHIPMENT.Description: A package containing an important shipment destined for LuxTech.

WEIRDPACKAGE.Name: Weird Package
WEIRDPACKAGE.Description: A suspicious package. Probably best not to look inside.

AEGISIDCARD.Name: Aegis ID Card
AEGISIDCARD.Description: A forged ID card. It will let you pretend you work at Aegis Insurance.

INCRIMINATINGEVIDENCE.Name: Incriminating Evidence
INCRIMINATINGEVIDENCE.Description: A device containing evidence against Aegis Insurance.

DIGITSLIP.Name: Digit Slip
DIGITSLIP.Description: A slip of paper with one digit of the code for the lock to Rafael's gym door.

SIGILLEFTHALF.Name: Sigil Left Half
SIGILLEFTHALF.Description: The left half of the sigil of an ancient order of knights.

SIGILRIGHTHALF.Name: Sigil Right Half
SIGILRIGHTHALF.Description: The right half of the sigil of an ancient order of knights.

CARNATIONSIGIL.Name: Carnation Sigil
CARNATIONSIGIL.Description: An ancient sigil of the Carnation Knights. You feel it pulling you towards another place.

CONDENSEDLIGHT.Name: Condensed Light
CONDENSEDLIGHT.Description: A strange ball of light. You should gather these for a friend.

CHAMBER1KEY.Name: Chamber 1 Key
CHAMBER1KEY.Description: The key to the first chamber containing a powerful avatar.

CHAMBER2KEY.Name: Chamber 2 Key
CHAMBER2KEY.Description: The key to the second chamber containing a powerful avatar.

CHAMBER3KEY.Name: Chamber 3 Key
CHAMBER3KEY.Description: The key to the third chamber containing a powerful avatar.

CHAMBER4KEY.Name: Chamber 4 Key
CHAMBER4KEY.Description: The key to the fourth chamber containing a powerful avatar.

CHAMBER5KEY.Name: Chamber 5 Key
CHAMBER5KEY.Description: The key to the fifth chamber containing a powerful avatar.

CHAMBER6KEY.Name: Chamber 6 Key
CHAMBER6KEY.Description: The key to the sixth chamber containing a powerful avatar.

CHAMBER7KEY.Name: Chamber 7 Key
CHAMBER7KEY.Description: The key to the seventh chamber containing a powerful avatar.

CHAMBER8KEY.Name: Chamber 8 Key
CHAMBER8KEY.Description: The key to the eighth chamber containing a powerful avatar.

UBCONTAINMENTKEY.Name: UB Containment Key
UBCONTAINMENTKEY.Description: A key which unlocks the Ultra Beast Containment Room at Novo College.

FACTORYPASS.Name: Factory Pass
FACTORYPASS.Description: A pass that grants you access through the locked door in Victoire's factory.

RUINEDTOWERKEY.Name: Ruined Tower Key
RUINEDTOWERKEY.Description: A key which unlocks the ruined tower on the Sandstone Estuary coastline.

LATENTSEED.Name: Latent Seed
LATENTSEED.Description: A simple tree seed. It hums with the potential for great change.

ALLOYEDLUMP.Name: Alloyed Lump
ALLOYEDLUMP.Description: Misshapen, unusual metal. Useless without a way to sharpen it.

ALLOYEDBLADE.Name: Alloyed Blade
ALLOYEDBLADE.Description: A fragile blade of unusual metal. Sharp enough to cut alloyed overgrowth.

ALLOYEDWIRE.Name: Alloyed Wire
ALLOYEDWIRE.Description: A thin, nearly invisible strand of unusual metal.

SPACETIMESHARD.Name: Space-time Shard
SPACETIMESHARD.Description: A sliver of the fragment of the universe. Highly unstable.

OLDUSBDRIVE.Name: Old USB Drive
OLDUSBDRIVE.Description: A USB containing data from a Team Chasm's early days.

GILDEDAPRICORN.Name: Gilded Apricorn
GILDEDAPRICORN.Description: A gleaming golden fruit. Someone skilled may be able to craft it into a unique Poké Ball.

RAGGEDJOURNAL.Name: Ragged Journal
RAGGEDJOURNAL.Description: A damaged traveler's journal. If you find its scattered pages, you can put them back in place.

VIPCARD.Name: VIP Card
VIPCARD.Description: A glamorous steel card. While holding it, all vendors cost 10% less and Pokécenter Marts have extra items.

OMINOUSEGG.Name: Ominous Egg
OMINOUSEGG.Description: A vessel for negative emotions. To earn its rewards, perfect trainers and make them flee from you.

SMARTPHONE.Name: Smart Phone
SMARTPHONE.Description: A smart phone. Use it to take selfies.

VSRECORDER.Name: VS Recorder
VSRECORDER.Description: A hi-tech battle recording device. Use it to manage and replay past battles.

PRIMALBEAD.Name: Primal Bead
PRIMALBEAD.Description: A drop of ancient clay. Use it to summon a Pokemon from a resonating totem.

PRIMALCLAY.Name: Primal Clay
PRIMALCLAY.Description: A lump of ancient clay. Allows you to summon any number of Pokemon from resonating totems.

CHOICECROWN.Name: Choice Crown
CHOICECROWN.Description: Held item which ups Attacking stats and Speed by 50%, but allows the use of only one move.

ZENITHBAND.Name: Zenith Band
ZENITHBAND.Description: Held item which doubles Attack, but allows the use of only one move.

ZENITHSPECS.Name: Zenith Specs
ZENITHSPECS.Description: Held item which doubles Sp. Atk, but allows the use of only one move.

ZENITHSCARF.Name: Zenith Scarf
ZENITHSCARF.Description: Held item which doubles Speed, but allows the use of only one move.

CLARITYSASH.Name: Clarity Sash
CLARITYSASH.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will endure one potential KO attack, leaving 1 HP.

ALLPURPOSEVEST.Name: All-Purpose Vest
ALLPURPOSEVEST.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder's defenses are raised 50% but it can't use status moves.

STRIKECORSET.Name: Strike Corset
STRIKECORSET.Description: The holder's Defense is raised 50%, and it harms those who use special attacks against it for 1/6th HP.

ASSAULTCORSET.Name: Assault Corset
ASSAULTCORSET.Description: The holder's Sp. Def is raised 50%, and it harms those who use physical attacks against it for 1/6th HP.

JAGGEDHELMET.Name: Jagged Helmet
JAGGEDHELMET.Description: Damages attackers for 1/3rd of their HP when they hit the holder with physical attacks.

LUSTROUSJACKET.Name: Lustrous Radio
LUSTROUSJACKET.Description: Damages attackers for 1/3rd of their HP when they hit the holder with special attacks.

SITREONBERRY.Name: Sitreon Berry
SITREONBERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon, it heals its HP by 50% at half health.

ROSELIFEAST.Name: Roseli Feast
ROSELIFEAST.Description: Halves the damage from one supereffective Fairy-type attack. Holder heals 1/16th HP each turn.

OCCAFEAST.Name: Occa Feast
OCCAFEAST.Description: Halves the damage from one supereffective Fire-type attack. Holder heals 1/16th HP each turn.

RINDOFEAST.Name: Rindo Feast
RINDOFEAST.Description: Halves the damage from one supereffective Ground-type attack. Holder heals 1/16th HP each turn.

LUNUSBERRY.Name: Lunus Berry
LUNUSBERRY.Description: Held to recover from a status problem once per battle. Then, all of the holder's stats are raised by two stages.

ZALAKABERRY.Name: Zalaka Berry
ZALAKABERRY.Description: If held by a Pokémon which goes below 50% health, it maximizes its Speed stat.

LUCENTGEM.Name: Lucent Gem
LUCENTGEM.Description: A brilliant gem. Boosts the power of an attacking move by 50% once per battle.

NORMALRING.Name: Normal Ring
NORMALRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Normal move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

FIRERING.Name: Fire Ring
FIRERING.Description: Boosts the power of a Fire move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

WATERRING.Name: Water Ring
WATERRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Water move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

GRASSRING.Name: Grass Ring
GRASSRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Grass move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

ELECTRICRING.Name: Electric Ring
ELECTRICRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Electric move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

ICERING.Name: Ice Ring
ICERING.Description: Boosts the power of a Ice move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

FIGHTINGRING.Name: Fighting Ring
FIGHTINGRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Fighting move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

POISONRING.Name: Poison Ring
POISONRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Poison move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

GROUNDRING.Name: Ground Ring
GROUNDRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Ground move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

FLYINGRING.Name: Flying Ring
FLYINGRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Flying move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

PSYCHICRING.Name: Psychic Ring
PSYCHICRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Psychic move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

BUGRING.Name: Bug Ring
BUGRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Bug move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

ROCKRING.Name: Rock Ring
ROCKRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Rock move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

GHOSTRING.Name: Ghost Ring
GHOSTRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Ghost move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

DARKRING.Name: Dark Ring
DARKRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Dark move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

DRAGONRING.Name: Dragon Ring
DRAGONRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Dragon move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

STEELRING.Name: Steel Ring
STEELRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Steel move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

FAIRYRING.Name: Fairy Ring
FAIRYRING.Description: Boosts the power of a Fairy move by 50% once per battle. Holder heals 1/16th HP each round.

WHITEBOUGH.Name: White Bough
WHITEBOUGH.Description: A held item. Restores any lowered stats, then heals the holder by 50% HP.

TERRAINSEALANT.Name: Terrain Sealant
TERRAINSEALANT.Description: While held, terrains set by the holder do not expire.

LEADBALLOON.Name: Lead Balloon
LEADBALLOON.Description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder floats in the air, making Ground attacks miss.

SPELLBELL.Name: Spell Bell
SPELLBELL.Description: The holder's HP is restored a little every time it inflicts damage. Boosts Ghost-type moves by 20%.

BIGREDBUTTON.Name: Big Red Button
BIGREDBUTTON.Description: When the holder is struck by a foe, it switches out, leaving a layer of spikes around the foe.

HEATSASH.Name: Heat Sash
HEATSASH.Description: The user summons sunshine for 50% longer. The holder will endure one potential KO.

DAMPSASH.Name: Damp Sash
DAMPSASH.Description: The user summons rain for 50% longer. The holder will endure one potential KO.

SMOOTHSASH.Name: Smooth Sash
