ADRENALASH.Name: Adrenalash
ADRENALASH.Description: The user forms their excitement into a lash with a 20% chance of raising the user's Sp. Atk.

ARTOFWAR.Name: Art of War
ARTOFWAR.Description: Enables random critical hits for the user, doubles its critical hit chance, and raises its Attack and Defense by two steps.

AURAFLUX.Name: Aura Flux
AURAFLUX.Description: The user contorts the target's chi with an energy pulse, damaging it and lowering its Sp. Def.

AURAPULSE.Name: Aura Pulse
AURAPULSE.Description: Aura deep within the user's body is spurred to pulse outward. Can't miss and skips protections.

AURASTORM.Name: Aura Storm
AURASTORM.Description: This Pokémon charges up for a turn, then releases a powerful beam of aura. This does more damage the less HP the user has.

BAR.Name: Bar
BAR.Description: The target is barred by rules which prevent it from using off-type moves for three more turns.

BEARHUG.Name: Bear Hug
BEARHUG.Description: The user hugs the target intensely, trapping and binding it for three turns.

BREAKDANCE.Name: Breakdance
BREAKDANCE.Description: The user improvises a dance, raising its two weakest stats by three steps.

BUILTDIFFERENT.Name: Built Different
BUILTDIFFERENT.Description: The user flexes its rocky skin, raising its Attack and Defense by two steps and gaining the Rock-type.

BULWARK.Name: Bulwark
BULWARK.Description: The user and its allies take 50% less attack damage this turn. Always fails if used in succession.

BURSTHAYMAKER.Name: Burst Haymaker
BURSTHAYMAKER.Description: The user risks an explosive arcing full bodied punch against the target.

CAPOEIRA.Name: Capoeira
CAPOEIRA.Description: Combining dance and martial art, the user strikes the target and raises its Speed by two steps.

COLUMNARPIN.Name: Columnar Pin
COLUMNARPIN.Description: Pins the target with building materials. The target becomes barred.

CONCUSS.Name: Concuss
CONCUSS.Description: The user fires a small shockwave. This has a 30% chance to numb the target.

DEEPBREATHING.Name: Deep Breathing
DEEPBREATHING.Description: Enables random critical hits for the user, quadruples its critical hit chance, and raises its Speed by two steps.

DETACHMENT.Name: Detachment
DETACHMENT.Description: The user attacks freed from earthly attachments. Doubles in damage if the user has no item when the move starts.

DISCOURAGE.Name: Discourage
DISCOURAGE.Description: The user forces the target to switch out, to be replaced at random. Always goes last.

DROPKICK.Name: Drop Kick
DROPKICK.Description: The user drops onto the target with a kick, dealing 25% recoil to self.

FIGHTFOREVER.Name: Fight Forever
FIGHTFOREVER.Description: The user endures attacks with 1 HP. If so, raises its Attack by two steps. Fails if used in succession.

FOXTROTFINALE.Name: Foxtrot Finale
FOXTROTFINALE.Description: The user raises all of their stats by two steps. Fails unless a foe fainted last turn.

FRONTKICK.Name: Front Kick
FRONTKICK.Description: The user strikes the target with a basic frontal kicking technique.

NERVEBLOCK.Name: Nerve Block
NERVEBLOCK.Description: The user strikes the target's pressure points with precise punches, numbing it.

RIGHTEOUSKICK.Name: Righteous Kick
RIGHTEOUSKICK.Description: A kick that can also eliminate trapping and hazards afflicting your side. Also raises user's Speed.

SCUFFLE.Name: Scuffle
SCUFFLE.Description: The user grabs the target, slamming both of them into the ground. The user takes 20% recoil.

SECRETTECHNIQUE.Name: Secret Technique
SECRETTECHNIQUE.Description: The user attacks with a burst of inner energy. Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by four steps.

SLEEPWALKSTRIKE.Name: Sleepwalk Strike
SLEEPWALKSTRIKE.Description: The user mimics Kung Fu techniques while sleeping. This move can only be used while asleep.

SMASH.Name: Smash
SMASH.Description: The user attacks with a strong punch. It has a 20% chance to lower Defense.

STANDTOGETHER.Name: Stand Together
STANDTOGETHER.Description: The user holds fast with its teammates, raise its Defense by three steps, and its allies' by one.

THREEFOLDVOLLEY.Name: Threefold Volley
THREEFOLDVOLLEY.Description: The user shoots three arrows made of Aura with extreme precision. Can random critical hit.

VALORBOLT.Name: Valor Bolt
VALORBOLT.Description: The user manifests a bolt of pure courage. This has a 20% chance of raising the user's Sp. Atk.

WHIPTRANCE.Name: Whip Trance
WHIPTRANCE.Description: The user relentlessly rampages with its whip-like hands for two turns. Each hit will always be a critical hit.

WHIRLWINDKICK.Name: Whirlwind Kick
WHIRLWINDKICK.Description: The user kicks while rotating at high speed, dashing across the battlefield to deal damage to all nearby battlers.

AIRSTRIKE.Name: Air Strike
AIRSTRIKE.Description: A reckless rushing attack from the air. The user also takes 25% recoil.

ATMOSPHERICBURST.Name: Atmospheric Burst
ATMOSPHERICBURST.Description: The user compresses air around the target to impossible density. If the move is super- or hyper-effective, damage is increased by 30%.

BIRDSEYEVIEW.Name: Bird's-Eye View
BIRDSEYEVIEW.Description: The user takes an aerial look at the field. This raises its Sp. Atk, Defense, and Accuracy by two steps.

BLUSTER.Name: Bluster
BLUSTER.Description: The user fires a stormy gust at the target. This also raises the user's Sp. Atk by two steps.

BOREALWIND.Name: Boreal Wind
BOREALWIND.Description: The user whips up a cold north wind to attack the target. It has a 30% chance to frostbite.

CLASSICALPHYSICS.Name: Classical Physics
CLASSICALPHYSICS.Description: An apple falls from high up to strike the foe. Always goes first. Deals double damage in intense Gravity.

COLDFRONT.Name: Cold Front
COLDFRONT.Description: The user propels a gale-force wind at the target. It has a 10% chance to frostbite.

CYCLONE.Name: Cyclone
CYCLONE.Description: Winds from all directions arrive together in a flurry to rip about the target.

DIVININGTALON.Name: Divining Talon
DIVININGTALON.Description: The opponent is shredded by talons. This attack always results in a critical hit, but applies jinx to the user.

DRAFT.Name: Draft
DRAFT.Description: The user sends a chilly wind towards the target. This has a 10% chance to frostbite.

ECHOLOCATE.Name: Echolocate
ECHOLOCATE.Description: A high pitched screech lowers all nearby foes' Defense, Sp. Def, and Evasion by three steps. Can't miss and skips protections.

FURYPECKS.Name: Fury Pecks
FURYPECKS.Description: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak that multi-hits two to five times.

HEAVENLYGALE.Name: Heavenly Gale
HEAVENLYGALE.Description: The user attacks with a divine wind to punish the target. Super effective versus Dark-types.

HOP.Name: Hop
HOP.Description: The user hops high up to land on the target's head. It has a 10% chance to numb.

HUNTDOWN.Name: Hunt Down
HUNTDOWN.Description: The user chases the target and strikes it from above. It does more damage the faster the user is.

JETSTREAM.Name: Jet Stream
JETSTREAM.Description: The user whips up a lingering tailwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for six turns.

MACHFLIGHT.Name: Mach Flight
MACHFLIGHT.Description: The user takes off at sonic speeds, raising its Speed by four steps and gaining the Flying type.

MACHPULSE.Name: Mach Pulse
MACHPULSE.Description: The user launches a pulse in the form of a shock wave. It has a 20% chance to raise Speed.

PLUMMET.Name: Plummet
PLUMMET.Description: The user falls from up high, crushing the target beneath. This move does 30% more damage if the user is asleep.

POUNCE.Name: Pounce
POUNCE.Description: The user quickly jumps high up, then falls onto the target. It has a 10% chance to numb.

PRESSURESHOCK.Name: Pressure Shock
PRESSURESHOCK.Description: The user quickly increases the air pressure to damage the target. This attack always goes before any other move.

SILVERGALE.Name: Silver Gale
SILVERGALE.Description: Clears hazards on the opponent's side of the field, moves hazards on the user's side to the opponent's, then forces the targets to switch.

SKYFALL.Name: Sky Fall
SKYFALL.Description: Attacks all near foes while clearing weather. This move fails in the absence of a weather.

SONICSHRIEK.Name: Sonic Shriek
SONICSHRIEK.Description: The user swoops into battle with a piercing shriek, flinching the target. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.

SPOTTING.Name: Spotting
SPOTTING.Description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power and Accuracy of its next attack by 50%.

SQUALLDART.Name: Squall Dart
SQUALLDART.Description: The user strikes the target with a dart of air. It has a 40% chance to flinch the target.

STRAFE.Name: Strafe
STRAFE.Description: The user slashes the target while dashing skillfully past it.

THRUSTPULSE.Name: Thrust Pulse
THRUSTPULSE.Description: The user shoots out a pulse of driving energy. Building up more power, it raises the user's Speed.

WINDTUNNEL.Name: Wind Tunnel
WINDTUNNEL.Description: Wind rapidly spins the target in place to multi-hit two to five times.

WINGCRASH.Name: Wing Crash
WINGCRASH.Description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings. The user also takes 20% recoil.

ACIDBALL.Name: Acid Ball
ACIDBALL.Description: The user lobs harsh acid at the target. It has a 20% chance to lower Sp. Def.

ACIDBATH.Name: Acid Bath
ACIDBATH.Description: The user and target bathe in acid. The user loses half its current HP.

ACIDBREACH.Name: Acid Breach
ACIDBREACH.Description: The user lashes the target with its corroded tail. This hits Steel-types for neutral damage and lowers Defense.

BATTERYACID.Name: Battery Acid
BATTERYACID.Description: The user sprays the target with a corrosive chemical solution. It has a 30% chance to numb.

BLIGHT.Name: Blight
BLIGHT.Description: The user infects the target with a touch and also destroys any Herbs it's holding.

CLUMPUP.Name: Clump Up
CLUMPUP.Description: The user launches a ball of trash to roll over all foes. The targets' held Berry or Gem stick to the ball and become unusable.

DISSOLUTION.Name: Dissolution
DISSOLUTION.Description: The user partially dissolves, raising its Sp. Def by five steps.

EXSANGUINATE.Name: Exsanguinate
EXSANGUINATE.Description: The user steals blood. If the target is knocked out, this raises the user's Attack by five steps.

GREYMIST.Name: Grey Mist
GREYMIST.Description: A Grey Mist covers the battlefield. For five turns, stats are reset at the end of each turn.

GRIMEGRAPPLE.Name: Grime Grapple
GRIMEGRAPPLE.Description: The user attacks while slathered in grime. This poisons the user.

MIASMA.Name: Miasma
MIASMA.Description: The user envelops the target in a foul wind. It has a 30% chance to poison.

NASTYNIP.Name: Nasty Nip
NASTYNIP.Description: The user stabs the opponent with a toxin-infused limb. It has a 10% chance to poison.

POISONDART.Name: Poison Dart
POISONDART.Description: The user shoots the target with a dart made of poison. This move always goes first.

POISONSPIKES.Name: Poison Spikes
POISONSPIKES.Description: The user lays a hazard layer of poison spikes on the foe's side. One layer hurts switched in foes, two layers poisons.

RETREATINGSTING.Name: Retreating Sting
RETREATINGSTING.Description: The user jabs the target with its stinger while retreating. This poisons the target and switches the user out.

SLIMEBALL.Name: Slimeball
SLIMEBALL.Description: The user attacks with sticky slime, rendering the target's item unusable.

SLUDGYSLUG.Name: Sludgy Slug
SLUDGYSLUG.Description: The user punches the target while holding a wad of slime. It has a 30% chance to poison.

SPASMICSTING.Name: Spasmic Sting
SPASMICSTING.Description: The user uses venom that turns the target's body against it. Super effective versus Fighting-types.

STINGINGJEALOUSY.Name: Stinging Jealousy
STINGINGJEALOUSY.Description: Attacks with energy from jealousy. All opposing Pokémon with stat boosts get poisoned.

STINKCLOUD.Name: Stink Cloud
STINKCLOUD.Description: The user gives off a terrible stench towards the target. It has a 30% chance to dizzy.

STINKCOVER.Name: Stink Cover
STINKCOVER.Description: The target is forced to switch out by a stinky cloud, then the user also switches. Always goes last.

TOXICCRUNCH.Name: Toxic Crunch
TOXICCRUNCH.Description: The user bites the target with toxic fangs with a 30% chance to poison.

TOXICTASTE.Name: Toxic Taste
TOXICTASTE.Description: The user chomps with venomous teeth. The user's HP is restored by 33% of the damage dealt.

TRASHTREASURE.Name: Trash Treasure
TRASHTREASURE.Description: The target is given a Black Sludge, replacing their item if any.

VENOMGUARD.Name: Venom Guard
VENOMGUARD.Description: Halves attack damage taken this turn. Poisons any attackers. Fails if used successively.

VENOMORTAR.Name: Venomortar
VENOMORTAR.Description: The user blasts a bundle of venom at the target, poisoning it.

VIPERSHOCK.Name: Vipershock
VIPERSHOCK.Description: The user finishes off its prey. Power is tripled against poisoned targets.

CRUSHINGCHASM.Name: Crushing Chasm
CRUSHINGCHASM.Description: The user opens a rift beneath the target, trapping and binding it for three turns.

DEVOURINGDUST.Name: Devouring Dust
DEVOURINGDUST.Description: The target is consumed by a desert storm, trapping and binding it for three turns.

DUSTDEVIL.Name: Dust Devil
DUSTDEVIL.Description: The user whips up a hot desert twister to attack the target. It has a 30% chance to burn.

DUSTSTORM.Name: Dust Storm
DUSTSTORM.Description: The user whips up dirt at supersonic speeds, damaging everything around it.

EARTHSPLITTER.Name: Earthsplitter
EARTHSPLITTER.Description: The user cracks the earth under the target with a massive strike. This lowers the user's Attack by four steps.

ERODE.Name: Erode
ERODE.Description: Attacks by blasting dirt and debris at the target. This move always goes first in sandstorm.

EXTREMEEFFORT.Name: Extreme Effort
EXTREMEEFFORT.Description: The user uses all their might to attack their opponent, forcing the user to use Rest on their next turn.

GROUNDING.Name: Grounding
GROUNDING.Description: The user stabilizes its stance. This raises its Attack, Sp. Def, and Accuracy by two steps.

LEYLINEBURST.Name: Leyline Burst
LEYLINEBURST.Description: Energy is sent through a conduit, erupting under the target. This move is also Psychic-type.

MUDSLIDE.Name: Mud Slide
MUDSLIDE.Description: The user propels itself forward with a wave of mud which also slams into the target. The user's Speed is raised.

MUDSLING.Name: Mud Sling
MUDSLING.Description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud. It has a 20% chance to lower the target's Speed.

PARADISIACA.Name: Paradisiaca
PARADISIACA.Description: The user shapes primal clay to heal a nearby ally for their max HP. This can overheal. The user is exhausted on the next turn.

PITFALL.Name: Pitfall
PITFALL.Description: The user opens a pit beneath the target, trapping and binding it for three turns.

PLOW.Name: Plow
PLOW.Description: The user churns the ground underneath the target, entangling them in plant matter. It has a 30% chance to leech.

PULVERIZERCHORD.Name: Pulverizer Chord
PULVERIZERCHORD.Description: The user hits a pitch that turns earth and stone to dust, damaging its foes.

ROTARYHEADBUTT.Name: Rotary Headbutt
ROTARYHEADBUTT.Description: The user burrows, charging and becoming hidden, then attacks three times on the second turn.

RUMBLE.Name: Rumble
RUMBLE.Description: The user causes the earth to rumble, striking every Pokémon around it and underground.

SANDBLASTING.Name: Sandblasting
SANDBLASTING.Description: The user blasts the target with highly pressurized sand. Can random critical hit.

SANDTOSS.Name: Sand Toss
SANDTOSS.Description: The user tosses hot desert sand on the target. It has a 10% chance to burn.

SEISMICWAVE.Name: Seismic Wave
SEISMICWAVE.Description: The user attacks with a tectonic vibration. It also breaks any screens protecting the target's side.

SHEDSPINES.Name: Shed Spines
SHEDSPINES.Description: By sacrificing 33% of its max HP, the user lays two hazard layers of Spikes at the foe's feet.

SIROCCO.Name: Sirocco
SIROCCO.Description: Hits the target with a sandy wind, then summons sandstorm for eight turns.

STABILIZE.Name: Stabilize
STABILIZE.Description: The user slathers mud around to heal itself by half of its max HP. This extends any active screens by one turn.

STAMPDOWN.Name: Stamp Down
STAMPDOWN.Description: The user attacks by flattening the target into the ground. This resets the target's positive stat changes.

TAILSLAM.Name: Tail Slam
TAILSLAM.Description: The user slams the earth with its tail, creating a shockwave to damage the target. It has a 40% chance to lower Attack.

TRAMPLE.Name: Trample
TRAMPLE.Description: The user tramples the target. It has a 20% chance to lower the target's Speed.

TREADON.Name: Tread On
TREADON.Description: The user attacks the opposing Pokémon by trampling it. It has a 20% chance to lower Speed.

VENT.Name: Vent
VENT.Description: Stress cracks form underneath the target, blasting them with volcanic ash. It has a 40% chance to lower Sp. Def.

ADAMANTINEPRESS.Name: Adamantine Press
ADAMANTINEPRESS.Description: The user slams the target with their rock-hard body.

BEDROCKBREAKER.Name: Bedrock Breaker
BEDROCKBREAKER.Description: The user smashes its rock-hard head into the target. The user also takes 33% recoil.

BLUNTFORCE.Name: Blunt Force
BLUNTFORCE.Description: The user bludgeons the target's arms and legs with a large rock. This has a 50% chance to fracture it.

CRANIALGUARD.Name: Cranial Guard
CRANIALGUARD.Description: Protects the user from damage this turn. The user will counter with Granite Head if attacked.

CRYSTALGLEAM.Name: Crystal Gleam
CRYSTALGLEAM.Description: The user attacks with the bright glint of crystals.

DIAMONDBOLT.Name: Diamond Bolt
DIAMONDBOLT.Description: The user shoots a spike of diamond to strike the target. Can random critical hit.

DIAMONDFORCE.Name: Diamond Force
DIAMONDFORCE.Description: The user calls up spikes of diamond. Can random critical hit.

EMBRITTLE.Name: Embrittle
EMBRITTLE.Description: The user weakens the target's bones, making them fracture. They deal 33% less damage.

GRANITEHEAD.Name: Granite Head
GRANITEHEAD.Description: The user rushes into the target with its stony body. The user also takes 25% recoil.

GRINDSTONE.Name: Grind Stone
GRINDSTONE.Description: The user scratches the target with rough rocks. If in sandstorm, the target's Defense is lowered by three steps.

HARDPLACE.Name: Hard Place
HARDPLACE.Description: The user slams the target into a nearby hard object. Increases in power the higher the Defense of any ally.

HEADBANG.Name: Headbang
HEADBANG.Description: The user slams the target with blunt force, taking 20% recoil.

ICEBREAKER.Name: Icebreaker
ICEBREAKER.Description: The user sweeps away hazards afflicting your side while lunging forward. User also takes 33% recoil.

INVITESANDSTORM.Name: Invite Sandstorm
INVITESANDSTORM.Description: The user numbs the target, then welcomes in sandstorm for eight turns.

LUNASUCRE.Name: Luna Sucre
LUNASUCRE.Description: The target's item is spelled away with Lunar Magic. Additionally, the target is given an EXP Candy M.

MEGALITHRITE.Name: Megalith Rite
MEGALITHRITE.Description: The user calls all rocks to join it, summoning sandstorm for five turns and laying a hazard of levitating stones around the target.

MONOLITHDROP.Name: Monolith Drop
MONOLITHDROP.Description: The user drops a single piece of solid bedrock on the target, fracturing them.

OMNISHELTER.Name: Omnishelter
OMNISHELTER.Description: Protects the user and its allies from spread moves this turn and foes' moves get redirected to the user. Fails if used in succession.

PETRIFY.Name: Petrify
PETRIFY.Description: The user afflicts the target by turning their skin into stone. This has a 30% chance to fracture it.

PLANETCRACKER.Name: Planetcracker
PLANETCRACKER.Description: The user slams itself into the target with absurd force, taking 50% recoil.

ROCKALANCHE.Name: Rockalanche
ROCKALANCHE.Description: Large boulders are hurled at the foes to inflict damage. This has a 30% chance to fracture it.

ROCKAPULT.Name: Rockapult
ROCKAPULT.Description: The user throws a large rock at the target. If it misses, the user's Accuracy is raised.

ROCKDRIVE.Name: Rock Drive
ROCKDRIVE.Description: The user hits a rock in a precise way to launch it at the target.

ROCKOUT.Name: Rock Out
ROCKOUT.Description: The user dances wildly while churning rocks towards the target. This raises the user's Attack by two steps.

ROLLINGBOULDER.Name: Rolling Boulder
ROLLINGBOULDER.Description: If this move misses, the target is forced to switch out. Always goes last.

SHATTEREDLIGHT.Name: Shattered Light
SHATTEREDLIGHT.Description: The target is struck from all angles by light like gemstones. Deals double damage if the user has used a gem this battle.

SHATTERSHOT.Name: Shatter Shot
SHATTERSHOT.Description: The user grinds stone into shrapnel and sprays it at the target. This has a 50% chance to fracture it.

SHIELDINGBASH.Name: Shielding Bash
SHIELDINGBASH.Description: The user headbutts the target while maintaining a defensive aura. Sets Sanctuary for five turns.

SIEGEBREAKER.Name: Siege Breaker
SIEGEBREAKER.Description: The user slams the target with a rocky blade. Destroys screens, Substitutes, and protections on the target.

SINGINGSTONE.Name: Singing Stone
SINGINGSTONE.Description: The user thrums ominously, lowering the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.

SLINGSHOT.Name: Sling Shot
SLINGSHOT.Description: The user carefully lobs a small stone at high speed.

STARFALL.Name: Star Fall
STARFALL.Description: A star falls on the target. Witnessing this lucky star also enables random critical hits and doubles the user's critical hit chance.

STORMSHARDS.Name: Stormshards
STORMSHARDS.Description: The user attacks with shards from their rocky mane. For the next three turns, the Pokémon in the targeted slot loses 1/8th of their max HP.

TERRAFORM.Name: Terraform
TERRAFORM.Description: Churns nearby rocks, dealing damage to nearby Pokémon and removing hazards from both sides.

WAVEOFJADE.Name: Wave of Jade
WAVEOFJADE.Description: The user emits a wave of green light to strike near foes. Deals double damage to those slower than the user.

AGONIZE.Name: Agonize
AGONIZE.Description: The user injects the target with an extremely painful bio-chemical. It has a 10% chance to poison.

ALLERGY.Name: Allergy
ALLERGY.Description: The user makes the target have an allergic reaction. This lowers their Speed by three steps.

BIOFLASH.Name: Bio Flash
BIOFLASH.Description: The user shoots out a quick flash of bioluminescence to damage the target. This move always goes first.

BURROWBLITZ.Name: Burrow Blitz
BURROWBLITZ.Description: An army of insects, working as one, strike at the target from below. Super effective versus Ground-types.

CARAPACECRUSH.Name: Carapace Crush
CARAPACECRUSH.Description: The user crushes the target with a hardened carapace. It has a 30% chance to lower the target's Defense.

CLACKACLACK.Name: Clackaclack
CLACKACLACK.Description: The user attacks with a horrible clattering noise. It has a 20% chance to lower Sp. Def.

CREEPOUT.Name: Creep Out
CREEPOUT.Description: The user preys on the target's fear of insects, giving it a weakness to the Bug type.

DECOMPOSE.Name: Decompose
DECOMPOSE.Description: A swarm of insects is sent to gnaw at the target. It also breaks any screens protecting the target's side.

DRONING.Name: Droning
DRONING.Description: The user vibrates its wings to make a damaging sound wave. It has a 40% chance to lower Sp. Def.

ENVENOM.Name: Envenom
ENVENOM.Description: Venom is introduced into the target with fangs or spines, poisoning it.

FEEDON.Name: Feed On
FEEDON.Description: The user consumes a bit of the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by 50% the damage dealt.

GUIDINGAROMA.Name: Guiding Aroma
GUIDINGAROMA.Description: The user emits an aroma that raises the target's three weakest stats.

IRRITATE.Name: Irritate
IRRITATE.Description: The user applies a painful chemical to the target with a smack. It has a 10% chance to poison.

LIFEDRAIN.Name: Life Drain
LIFEDRAIN.Description: The user stabs the target with a sharp spike to drain its life force. The user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt. This can overheal.

LIGHTSHOW.Name: Light Show
LIGHTSHOW.Description: The user attacks with small beams of light. It has a 40% chance to flinch the target.

LUMINACHAIN.Name: Lumina Chain
LUMINACHAIN.Description: The user emits rapid bursts of light and rampages for two turns.

LUMINBURST.Name: Lumin Burst
LUMINBURST.Description: The user attacks with a blinding flash of bioluminscence. It has a 40% chance to flinch the target.

LURINGLIGHT.Name: Luring Light
LURINGLIGHT.Description: All foes have their Attack and Sp. Atk lowered. All foes' moves get redirected to the user this turn.

MANYNEEDLE.Name: Manyneedle
MANYNEEDLE.Description: The foe is stabbed once by each of the user's stingers.

NATURALPROTECTION.Name: Natural Protection
NATURALPROTECTION.Description: The user makes a plea for survival, halving the damage their side takes from non-attack sources for ten turns.

PATIENTBLADE.Name: Patient Blade
PATIENTBLADE.Description: The user prepares its weapons. This raises the user's Attack by six steps but lowers Speed by six steps.

RAKE.Name: Rake
RAKE.Description: The user rakes the target with sharp claws.

ROLLINGARSENAL.Name: Rolling Arsenal
ROLLINGARSENAL.Description: The user bites, claws, and stings the target while rolling. It has a 20% chance each to poison, waterlog, or leech.

SCALESCATTER.Name: Scale Scatter
SCALESCATTER.Description: The target is plastered with irritating scales, damaging it and changing its type to Bug.

SCALESTORM.Name: Scale Storm
SCALESTORM.Description: The user sheds a huge volley of scales at the target. Lands without fail. This lowers the user's Sp. Def and Speed.

SCRITCHYSCRITCH.Name: Scritchy-Scritch
SCRITCHYSCRITCH.Description: The user scratches the target with a flurry of claws, talons, etc.

SEDATINGDUST.Name: Sedating Dust
SEDATINGDUST.Description: If the user is faster than the target, puts the target to sleep, then minimizes the user's Speed.

SKEWER.Name: Skewer
SKEWER.Description: The user stabs through the target using tremendous force. This lowers the user's Attack by four steps.

SMUSH.Name: Smush
SMUSH.Description: Avenging bugs everywhere, the user crushes the target. It has a 20% chance to lower their Defense.

STINGINGJAB.Name: Stinging Jab
STINGINGJAB.Description: The user stabs the target, injecting a painful chemical. It has a 30% chance to poison.

STUNNINGCURL.Name: Stunning Curl
STUNNINGCURL.Description: Halves attack damage taken this turn. Numbs any attackers. Fails if used successively.

SUCKBLOOD.Name: Suck Blood
SUCKBLOOD.Description: The user sucks the target's life. The user's HP is restored by 50% the damage dealt.

SWARMBURST.Name: Swarm Burst
SWARMBURST.Description: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

SWARMORDER.Name: Swarm Order
SWARMORDER.Description: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Skips and destroys protections.

TERRORSWARM.Name: Terror Swarm
TERRORSWARM.Description: The user summons bugs to terrorize the target, trapping and binding it for three turns.

TUNEUP.Name: Tune Up
TUNEUP.Description: The user amps itself up for performance, raising its Sp. Atk and Speed by two steps.

ARCOFHOPE.Name: Arc of Hope
ARCOFHOPE.Description: Two turns after this move is used, the target's HP is restored by three quarters the user's max HP.

ASTRALSHIFT.Name: Astral Shift
ASTRALSHIFT.Description: The user goes into another plane and displaces the target's soul. This move does 30% more damage if the user is asleep.

BINDFATE.Name: Bind Fate
BINDFATE.Description: Disables the target's last used move for four turns, then lowers a relevant stat on them by four steps.

COLDSHOULDER.Name: Cold Shoulder
COLDSHOULDER.Description: The user attacks with bitter emotion. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by two steps if in hail.

CRITICALERROR.Name: Critical Error
CRITICALERROR.Description: The user causes a glitch in reality. This attack always results in a critical hit.

CURSEDOATH.Name: Cursed Oath
CURSEDOATH.Description: The user loses 25% of their max HP to curse the target, damaging their HP by 25% each turn.

DEADEND.Name: Dead End
DEADEND.Description: If the target's HP is half or less, this attack will hit with double the power.

DEATHKNELL.Name: Death Knell
DEATHKNELL.Description: The user makes a dreadful bell noise, harming all near battlers with visions of impending doom.

DEATHMARK.Name: Death Mark
DEATHMARK.Description: The target becomes trapped, and takes 50% more damage from all attacks.

DIRGE.Name: Dirge
DIRGE.Description: The user sings with deathly sounds to harm the target. It has a 20% chance to lower Sp. Def.

DISTURB.Name: Disturb
DISTURB.Description: The target is subjected to a violent and frightening prank. It has a 10% chance to numb.

DOLLSTITCH.Name: Doll Stitch
DOLLSTITCH.Description: The user forces itself or the target to spend 25% HP to make a Substitute by turning it into a doll.

DRIFTOFF.Name: Drift Off
DRIFTOFF.Description: The user soothes the target, lowering its Speed by four steps. If in hail, they also become drowsy.

FROMBEYOND.Name: From Beyond
FROMBEYOND.Description: The user channels its fallen allies to strike the target. This attack has 20 more power per fainted party member.

GEMSEAL.Name: Gem Seal
GEMSEAL.Description: Disables the target's last used move for five turns, and cuts 5 PP from it.

GHOSTLYGRASP.Name: Ghostly Grasp
GHOSTLYGRASP.Description: Spectral hands reach from the ground to trip the target. The heavier the target, the greater the damage.

GHOSTLYTALE.Name: Ghostly Tale
GHOSTLYTALE.Description: The user foretells a terrifying danger. Two turns later, the targeted spot is mortally frightened.

MACHINATE.Name: Machinate
MACHINATE.Description: Changes type based on machine haunted. 30% chance of extra effect based on machine haunted.

MADPURGE.Name: Mad Purge
MADPURGE.Description: The user cleanses the target's impurities with spiritual energy. Super effective versus Poison-types.

MALEFACTION.Name: Malefaction
MALEFACTION.Description: The user switches out using a cruel illusion. Always goes last.

PHANTOMGATE.Name: Phantom Gate
PHANTOMGATE.Description: The user opens its soul to unleash massive energy. This lowers the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by two steps.

PHARAOHSCURSE.Name: Pharaoh's Curse
PHARAOHSCURSE.Description: The target begins transforming into gold. They lose 1/8th HP every turn, scattering ten times as many coins as health lost.

POSSESSION.Name: Possession
POSSESSION.Description: The user makes the target hit itself by possessing its body. This move does 50% more damage if the target is asleep.

SEANCE.Name: Seance
SEANCE.Description: The user summons apparitions that dance around hypnotically before they multi-hit two to five times.

SHADOWBOXING.Name: Shadow Boxing
SHADOWBOXING.Description: The user practices its punches against ghostly illusions, raising its Attack, Speed, and Accuracy.

SHIVER.Name: Shiver
SHIVER.Description: The user drains heat from the air around the target, afflicting it with frostbite.

SIXFEETUNDER.Name: Six Feet Under
SIXFEETUNDER.Description: The user buries the target with somber force. Then, this move is disabled.

SOULDRAIN.Name: Soul Drain
SOULDRAIN.Description: The user drains the target's soul. The user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt. This can overheal.

SPECTRALTONGUE.Name: Spectral Tongue
SPECTRALTONGUE.Description: The user licks the target, numbing them, or cursing them if they're already numbed.

SPITEFULCHANT.Name: Spiteful Chant
SPITEFULCHANT.Description: The user unleashes its grudge, damaging the target and cutting 4 PP from the move last used by it.

STITCHUP.Name: Stitch Up
STITCHUP.Description: The user heals itself by 66% of its max HP. Then, this move is disabled.

SUFFOCATE.Name: Suffocate
SUFFOCATE.Description: The user suffocates the target by sucking the air from their lungs. Can random critical hit.

SUNDERFATE.Name: Sunder Fate
SUNDERFATE.Description: The user snips the target's connection to life in order to curse them, damaging their HP by 25% each turn.

THINAIR.Name: Thin Air
THINAIR.Description: The user thins the air around the target, depriving them of oxygen. Can random critical hit.

TONGUETWISTER.Name: Tongue Twister
TONGUETWISTER.Description: The target is pestered by a giant tongue. This has a 50% chance to numb it.

UMBRAGE.Name: Umbrage
UMBRAGE.Description: The user shoots the target with darkness formed from anger. It has a 40% chance to lower Sp. Def.

VIMRIPPER.Name: Vim Ripper
VIMRIPPER.Description: The user rips into the target's soul, dealing damage through their Sp. Def rather than their Defense.

WAILINGBLOW.Name: Wailing Blow
WAILINGBLOW.Description: The user attacks while wailing. It has a 40% chance to flinch the target.

WRAITHWRATH.Name: Wraith Wrath
WRAITHWRATH.Description: The user channels the anger of wronged spirits, going on a rampage for two turns.

ALLFORONE.Name: All For One
ALLFORONE.Description: The user slashes with gusto, inspiring its allies to follow up by using Slash on the target.

BULLETCHARGE.Name: Bullet Charge
BULLETCHARGE.Description: The user uses gunpowder to rocket at its foe. It has a 30% chance to raise its Speed.

CAVALRYCHARGE.Name: Cavalry Charge
CAVALRYCHARGE.Description: A reckless maneuver that forces the user to switch out if it misses. Always goes first.

EVERHONE.Name: Everhone
EVERHONE.Description: Inflicts physical or special damage, whichever deals more. Then, raises Attack or Sp. Atk, whichever wasn't used.

FARADAYCAGE.Name: Faraday Cage
FARADAYCAGE.Description: Conductive materials ensnare the target, trapping and binding it for three turns.

FEATHERLOCKVOLLEY.Name: Featherlock Volley
FEATHERLOCKVOLLEY.Description: The user launches piercing feathers three times, lowering the foe's Defense. Then, this move is disabled.

FEATHERWARD.Name: Feather Ward
FEATHERWARD.Description: The user lays a levitating hazard of sharp feathers around the foe. It deals Steel-typed 1/8th HP damage.

FLECHETTES.Name: Flechettes
FLECHETTES.Description: The user dislodges a blast of thin projectiles. This attack always results in a critical hit, but applies fracture to the user.

FRAGMENTATION.Name: Fragmentation
FRAGMENTATION.Description: The user uses explosive force to shoot shards of its own body at the target. The user loses 1/8th of its max HP.

HAIRFLIP.Name: Hair Flip
HAIRFLIP.Description: The user reflects a burst of light off its curls. Blinds a Pokémon entering the battle.

HELMBUTT.Name: Helmbutt
HELMBUTT.Description: The user headbutts the target with a metal head. It has a 40% chance to flinch the target.

IMPALINGSPIKE.Name: Impaling Spike
IMPALINGSPIKE.Description: A large spike is shot at the target. If this causes the target to faint, a hazard layer of Spikes is set on the ground beneath them.

IRONARROW.Name: Iron Arrow
IRONARROW.Description: The target is pierced with a sharp iron arrow. Can random critical hit.

JAVELIN.Name: Javelin
JAVELIN.Description: The target is pierced with a pointed metal javelin. Can random critical hit.

LUSTER.Name: Luster
LUSTER.Description: The user attacks with reflected light. It has a 20% chance to lower Sp. Def.

MAGNETIZE.Name: Magnetize
MAGNETIZE.Description: The user strikes the target while magnetizing it, trapping and binding it for three turns.

MIRRORSHIELD.Name: Mirror Shield
MIRRORSHIELD.Description: Protects the user from attacks. Special attackers take 1/8th HP damage.

PLUNDER.Name: Plunder
PLUNDER.Description: The user attacks the target with a sword. If the target faints, scatters many coins.

POLARIZEDROOM.Name: Polarized Room
POLARIZEDROOM.Description: The user creates a high quality area for six turns in which super-effective deals 25% more, and not very effective deals 25% less.

POWDERBOMB.Name: Powder Bomb
POWDERBOMB.Description: The user creates an explosion from powdered metal, inflicting damage to all nearby battlers.

POWERHAMMER.Name: Power Hammer
POWERHAMMER.Description: The user strikes with a full-force hammer blow.

RAILCANNON.Name: Rail Cannon
RAILCANNON.Description: The user shoots a massive metal object at the target. The user is exhausted on the next turn.

REFURBISH.Name: Refurbish
REFURBISH.Description: The user economizes half of its weight, healing itself based on the weight lost.

ROCKETPUNCH.Name: Rocket Punch
ROCKETPUNCH.Description: The user launches a fist with extreme force. This attack is popular with children.

SHARDSURGE.Name: Shard Surge
SHARDSURGE.Description: The user lines up shards before attacking. If hit by a foe's special move, lays a hazard layer of Spikes at their feet.

SHATTERVISE.Name: Shatter Vise
SHATTERVISE.Description: The user crushes the target in its metallic vises, breaking any screens protecting the target's side.

SHINESHOT.Name: Shine Shot
SHINESHOT.Description: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It has a 40% chance to lower Sp. Def.

SHININGSHELL.Name: Shining Shell
SHININGSHELL.Description: Protects the user from damage this turn. It also lowers the Sp. Atk of special attackers by two steps.

SHOTPUT.Name: Shotput
SHOTPUT.Description: The user hurls a metal ball at the target.

SHRAPNEL.Name: Shrapnel
SHRAPNEL.Description: The user shoots shards of its own body at the target. The user loses 1/8th of its max HP.

SHREDSHOT.Name: Shred Shot
SHREDSHOT.Description: The user shreds off bits of its own body to launch at the target. The user loses 1/8th of its max HP.

SLAG.Name: Slag
SLAG.Description: The user sprays mining waste at the target. It has a 30% chance to poison.

SLAY.Name: Slay
SLAY.Description: The user slashes at the target with a steel blade. Super effective versus Dragon-types.

TAKESHELTER.Name: Take Shelter
TAKESHELTER.Description: The user heals itself by half of their max HP. This extends the current weather by one turn.

VANGUARD.Name: Vanguard
VANGUARD.Description: The user enters a protective stance, raising its Sp. Atk and Defense by two steps.

VOLLEY.Name: Volley
VOLLEY.Description: Hits once for each party Pokémon. Deals more damage based on their Sp. Atk.

VOLLEYSTANCE.Name: Volley Stance
VOLLEYSTANCE.Description: The user prepares its dual cannons. Until switch out, each special attack hits twice.

WEIGHANCHOR.Name: Weigh Anchor
WEIGHANCHOR.Description: The user drags the target into the water with a heavy anchor. They become waterlogged.

WELD.Name: Weld
WELD.Description: Welds heavy steel onto the target, giving it the Steel type and lowering its Speed by four steps.

ABSOLUTERADIANCE.Name: Absolute Radiance
ABSOLUTERADIANCE.Description: Charges by summoning sunshine for five turns, then overwhelms the foe with fiery light on the second turn.

BLAZINGSPEED.Name: Blazing Speed
BLAZINGSPEED.Description: The user rushes the target at blazing-fast speed. This attack always goes before any other move.

BROIL.Name: Broil
BROIL.Description: The user attacks by sending a wave of hot air towards the target. It has a 30% chance to burn.

CLEANSINGFLAMES.Name: Cleansing Flames
CLEANSINGFLAMES.Description: Guaranteed to critical hit if the target has stat step changes. The target is cleansed, reseting their stat changes.

CRIMSONSTORM.Name: Crimson Storm
CRIMSONSTORM.Description: The foe is engulfed in a firestorm, trapping and binding it for three turns.

DRYHEAT.Name: Dry Heat
DRYHEAT.Description: The target is dried out and loses Water-type. Then, it bursts into flame from the heat.

EVERNALFLUX.Name: Evernal Flux
EVERNALFLUX.Description: The user emits great amounts of heat, burning the target and adding the Fire-type to it.

FIREWORKS.Name: Fireworks
FIREWORKS.Description: The user fires off explosive rounds in a beautiful display that multi-hit two to five times.

FLAMEFIST.Name: Flame Fist
FLAMEFIST.Description: The target is punched with a tremendous fiery force. This move can't be used twice in a row.

FLAMESPIKES.Name: Flame Spikes
FLAMESPIKES.Description: The user lays a hazard layer of burning spikes on the foe's side. One layer hurts switched in foes, two layers burns.

FLARE.Name: Flare
FLARE.Description: The user flashes with a burst of intensely bright flame. Can random critical hit.

FLAREUP.Name: Flare Up
FLAREUP.Description: The user targets the opponents soft spots with a fiery strike. Its power doubles if the target is burned.

FLAREWITCH.Name: Flare Witch
FLAREWITCH.Description: Raises Sp. Atk by three steps. Until switch out, the user's attacks spread to hit all nearby foes.

GOLDENREBIRTH.Name: Golden Rebirth
GOLDENREBIRTH.Description: The user creates a golden pyre that revives a fainted Pokémon at half HP. That Pokémon switches in and its stats are boosted.

HEARTHFIREHULA.Name: Hearthfire Hula
HEARTHFIREHULA.Description: The user dances with great heat. Pokémon hit by this are cured of frostbite. Deals 50% less damage to allies.

HOLDFIRE.Name: Hold Fire
HOLDFIRE.Description: The user pauses to plan its ranged attacks. This raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Accuracy by two steps.

HOTSHOT.Name: Hot Shot
HOTSHOT.Description: The user shoots the target with a small bolt of fire. This move always goes first.

IGNITE.Name: Ignite
IGNITE.Description: The user sets the target on fire, inflicting a burn.

IMPURITYBLAZE.Name: Impurity Blaze
IMPURITYBLAZE.Description: If the target has a non-volatile status condition, this deals double damage and heals every battler's non-volatile status condition.

INFERNOIMPACT.Name: Inferno Impact
INFERNOIMPACT.Description: The user cloaks itself in a fierce blaze and attacks. It has a 20% chance to raise Speed.

INVITESUNSHINE.Name: Invite Sunshine
INVITESUNSHINE.Description: The user burns the target, then welcomes in sunshine for eight turns.

KINDLE.Name: Kindle
KINDLE.Description: The user warms up its body and attacks the target. It has a 10% chance to burn.

LIFTOFF.Name: Liftoff
LIFTOFF.Description: The user launches up high, charging and becoming hidden, then explodes down on the second turn, taking 25% recoil.

LIKEWILDFIRE.Name: Like Wildfire
LIKEWILDFIRE.Description: The user roars with the force of a volcano, raising the Attack of itself by three steps and allies' by one.

PARHELIONHUNT.Name: Parhelion Hunt
PARHELIONHUNT.Description: The user attacks with fire that can be seen in multiple places, then summons sunshine for eight turns.

PROMINENCE.Name: Prominence
PROMINENCE.Description: A lance of fire pierces the target from above, lowering their Sp. Atk. Can random critical hit, and does so twice as often.

PROPELLANT.Name: Propellant
PROPELLANT.Description: The user explodes itself into the target. The target is harmed, but also their Speed is raised.

REDHOTRETREAT.Name: Red-Hot Retreat
REDHOTRETREAT.Description: Halves attack damage taken this turn. Burns any attackers. Fails if used successively.

SEARINGCRUNCH.Name: Searing Crunch
SEARINGCRUNCH.Description: The user chomps down with burning fangs. It has a 20% chance to burn and a 20% chance to lower Defense by two steps.

SHIMMERINGHEAT.Name: Shimmering Heat
SHIMMERINGHEAT.Description: The user attacks with heat, creating an obscuring wall of haze. The user takes 33% less damage this turn.

SMOLDERRAVE.Name: Smolder Rave
SMOLDERRAVE.Description: Cloaked in flames, the user dances wildly, raising its Sp. Atk by two steps.

SPRAYANDPRAY.Name: Spray and Pray
SPRAYANDPRAY.Description: The user sends up to two barrages of fire, each hitting two to five times. If two barrages were sent, the user is exhausted on the next turn.

SUNSHINE.Name: Sunshine
SUNSHINE.Description: Summons sunshine for six turns, boosting Fire-type attacks and hindering most others.

TEPHRACANNON.Name: Tephra Cannon
TEPHRACANNON.Description: The user launches volcanic debris, dealing damage and setting a hazard layer of burning spikes around the target.

UPINFLAMES.Name: Up In Flames
UPINFLAMES.Description: The user surrounds the target with fire which also destroys any clothing items it's holding.

VAINGLORYFLAMES.Name: Vainglory Flames
VAINGLORYFLAMES.Description: A distinguished attack that motivates nearby allies to follow, letting them act immediately after.

WHITEFLAME.Name: White Flame
WHITEFLAME.Description: The user launches a concentrated ball of searing, bright white flame. Can random critical hit.

WILDFIREMELT.Name: Wildfire Melt
WILDFIREMELT.Description: The user creates a storm using its flaming body, damaging everything around it and melting away hazards from both sides.

AQUASHOCK.Name: Aqua Shock
AQUASHOCK.Description: The user rapidly changes water pressure, creating a pulsing shockwave. The user loses 1/8th of its max HP.

AQUATICCRUNCH.Name: Aquatic Crunch
AQUATICCRUNCH.Description: The user bites with watery fangs. It has a 20% chance to waterlog and a 20% chance to lower Defense by two steps.

ARCHEANDELUGE.Name: Archean Deluge
ARCHEANDELUGE.Description: Charges by summoning rainstorm for five turns, then overwhelms the foe with water on the second turn.

ASCRYSTAL.Name: As Crystal
ASCRYSTAL.Description: The user shoots purified water, also healing the non-volatile status conditions of all the party Pokémon.

BREACH.Name: Breach
BREACH.Description: The user jumps out of the water to attack. Has a 20% chance to lower Defense.

BUBBLEBARRAGE.Name: Bubble Barrage
BUBBLEBARRAGE.Description: The user creates numerous bubbles to explode against the target. Multi-hits two to five times.

BUBBLEBARRIER.Name: Bubble Barrier
BUBBLEBARRIER.Description: The user creates a bubble to shield their ally. The next time they're hit, 50% of the move damage is instead dealt back as recoil.

BUBBLEBLASTER.Name: Bubble Blaster
BUBBLEBLASTER.Description: A blast of bubbles is shot at the target. It has a 20% chance to lower the target's Speed.

CAVITATION.Name: Cavitation
CAVITATION.Description: A water vacuum is induced and rapidly collapsed, generating an intense pulsing water blast. The user loses 1/8th of its max HP.

DRAGBENEATH.Name: Drag Beneath
DRAGBENEATH.Description: The user pulls the target under the waves with crushing force. This has a 10% chance to waterlog.

EBBFLOW.Name: Ebb & Flow
EBBFLOW.Description: The user douses the target, healing itself by 33% of its max HP in the process.

ERODINGFOAM.Name: Eroding Foam
ERODINGFOAM.Description: The user spews alkaline bubbles that melt the target, lowering their Defense by three steps.

FLOODGATE.Name: Floodgate
FLOODGATE.Description: Halves attack damage taken this turn. Waterlogs any attackers. Fails if used successively.

FLOUNDER.Name: Flounder
FLOUNDER.Description: The user struggles in the water, splashing it onto the target. They become waterlogged.

FLOWSTATE.Name: Flow State
FLOWSTATE.Description: The user gains an instinctual knowledge of battle, raising its Attack and Sp. Def by two steps.

FUGUFRENZY.Name: Fugu Frenzy
FUGUFRENZY.Description: The user crashes into the target with its quills. It leaves the target poisoned.

GEYSER.Name: Geyser
GEYSER.Description: The user propels a geyser of water at the target. This lowers the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by two steps.

GULPINGDIVE.Name: Gulping Dive
GULPINGDIVE.Description: The user dives down with its beak wide open. Transforms into Gulping- or Gorging form, depending on HP.

HARBORBREAKER.Name: Harbor Breaker
HARBORBREAKER.Description: The user crashes into the target like a tsunami. The user also takes 33% recoil.

HYDROFANG.Name: Hydro Fang
HYDROFANG.Description: The user bites with watery fangs. It has a 20% chance to waterlog and a 20% chance to lower Defense by two steps.

IMMERSE.Name: Immerse
IMMERSE.Description: The target is immersed in water. This has a 30% chance to waterlog.

INVITERAINSTORM.Name: Invite Rainstorm
INVITERAINSTORM.Description: The user waterlogs the target, then welcomes in rainstorm for eight turns.

MENDINGSPRING.Name: Mending Spring
MENDINGSPRING.Description: The user opens a spring to blast the target, also forming an Aqua Ring around themselves, healing 10% HP per turn.

PRESSUREBURST.Name: Pressure Burst
PRESSUREBURST.Description: Attacks with pressurized water. Deals 50% more damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

RAINSTORM.Name: Rainstorm
RAINSTORM.Description: Summons rainstorm for six turns, boosting Water-type attacks and hindering most others.

RAMMINGSPEED.Name: Ramming Speed
RAMMINGSPEED.Description: The user rams its sharp face right into the target. This lowers the user's Speed by three steps.

RIPTIDE.Name: Rip Tide
RIPTIDE.Description: The user crashes into the target on a ripping current. This waterlogs the target.

RIPTURN.Name: Rip Turn
RIPTURN.Description: The user rips the target, lowering their Defense by two steps. After attacking, the user switches out.

RISINGTIDE.Name: Rising Tide
RISINGTIDE.Description: Strikes the target with harbor waters, then summons rainstorm for eight turns.

RIVERREST.Name: River Rest
RIVERREST.Description: The user rests in a riverbed, restoring its HP by half of max, and forming an Aqua Ring around themselves, healing 10% HP per turn.

SEABORNESACRAMENT.Name: Seaborne Sacrament
SEABORNESACRAMENT.Description: The user communes with all the world's water, waterlogging the target and forming an Aqua Ring around themselves, healing 10% HP per turn.

SILTSURGE.Name: Silt Surge
SILTSURGE.Description: The user attacks with a wave of murky water, which hits all near foes and lowers their Speed by two steps.

SLAMSHUT.Name: Slam Shut
SLAMSHUT.Description: The target is crushed in the user's shell, mouth, or claws, trapping and binding it for three turns.

SPATTERINGRAM.Name: Spattering Ram
SPATTERINGRAM.Description: The user rams the target while splashing up a lot of water. This has a 30% chance to waterlog.

STICKYSPINES.Name: Sticky Spines
STICKYSPINES.Description: The target gets covered in sticky spines, waterlogging it and losing 1/8th of their current HP.

TIDEPULL.Name: Tide Pull
TIDEPULL.Description: The user wields tidal power to grab at the target. This has a 10% chance to waterlog.

TORRENTSCYTHE.Name: Torrent Scythe
TORRENTSCYTHE.Description: The user uses a jet of water like a sword and attacks by slashing. Can random critical hit.

WAKEFULTIDE.Name: Wakeful Tide
WAKEFULTIDE.Description: The user wakes to unleash devastating tides. Can only be used while asleep, and wakes the user up.

WATERLOG.Name: Waterlog
WATERLOG.Description: The target is doused with water in order to waterlog it.

WAVEBREAK.Name: Wavebreak
WAVEBREAK.Description: The user crashes into the target with the force of a large wave. This has a 40% chance to lower Defense.

WETLANDWALTZ.Name: Wetland Waltz
WETLANDWALTZ.Description: The user attacks the target using graceful fluid movements, also forming an Aqua Ring around themselves, healing 10% HP per turn.

WHALESONG.Name: Whale Song
WHALESONG.Description: The user's song heals the non-volatile status conditions of all party Pokémon, and forms an Aqua Ring around itself, healing 10% HP per turn.

WHELM.Name: Whelm
WHELM.Description: The target is inundated with a wave of seaweater. This has a 30% chance to waterlog.

WIPEOUT.Name: Wipeout
WIPEOUT.Description: The user rides a wave, then crashes into the target. It has a 40% chance to flinch the target.

ANESTHETIZE.Name: Anesthetize
ANESTHETIZE.Description: The user applies anesthetic substances, numbing the target.

AUTUMNBLAST.Name: Autumn Blast
AUTUMNBLAST.Description: The user uses wind to blast its leaves at the target. This lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by two steps.

BLADESOFGRASS.Name: Blades of Grass
BLADESOFGRASS.Description: The user gracefully slashes the target three times. The next time this move is used, it will hit one extra time.

BLOSSOM.Name: Blossom
BLOSSOM.Description: Flowers blooms with intensity, damaging the target and raising the user's Sp. Atk by two steps.

BREATHELIFE.Name: Breathe Life
BREATHELIFE.Description: Revives a fainted Grass-type party member to full HP. Only one use per battle.

CAMOUFLAGE.Name: Camouflage
CAMOUFLAGE.Description: The user fades into the foliage, charging and becoming hidden, then strikes from stealth on the second turn.

COCODROP.Name: Coco Drop
COCODROP.Description: The user drops some heads from high up. The taller the user compared to the target, the greater the damage.

CREEPINGSTRIKE.Name: Creeping Strike
CREEPINGSTRIKE.Description: If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.

CRUELWHIPBLADE.Name: Cruel Whipblade
CRUELWHIPBLADE.Description: The user flicks its thorns, dealing damage and setting a hazard layer of poison spikes around the target.

ESSENCEARROW.Name: Essence Arrow
ESSENCEARROW.Description: The user fires a bolt of life energy at the target. It has a 20% chance to raise user's Sp. Atk.

FLASHSEED.Name: Flash Seed
FLASHSEED.Description: The target is disoriented by an explosive seed. It has a 30% chance to dizzy.

HEADTHROW.Name: Head Throw
HEADTHROW.Description: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike three times in a row.

HOLLYCHARM.Name: Holly Charm
HOLLYCHARM.Description: The user attacks the target with the power of a warding charm. Super effective versus Ghost-types.

KICKDRUM.Name: Kick Drum
KICKDRUM.Description: The user keeps time for the team while attacking. Raises user's and allies' Speed and Accuracy. Counts as a Sound and Kick move.

MASQUERBLADE.Name: Masquerblade
MASQUERBLADE.Description: The user sheathes its blade. If hit by a foe's special move, it unsheathes it quickly, slashing all near foes.

MISTLETOE.Name: Mistletoe
MISTLETOE.Description: The user uses their feet to pierce the foe. This has a 10% chance of leeching the target.

MULCHMEAL.Name: Mulch Meal
MULCHMEAL.Description: The user eats decaying leaves, restoring its HP by 50% and raising its Speed.

MYSTERYSEED.Name: Mystery Seed
MYSTERYSEED.Description: The target eats a strange seed. They become numbed if faster than the user, or leeched if slower.

ODDBLOOM.Name: Odd Bloom
ODDBLOOM.Description: Creates an odd flower to throw and damage a foe. Odd Room is created for five turns.

PETALTEMPEST.Name: Petal Tempest
PETALTEMPEST.Description: The user stirs up a violent petal tempest and attacks everything around it.

POISONIVY.Name: Poison Ivy
POISONIVY.Description: The target is irritated by allergenic plants, poisoning it.

PUFFBALL.Name: Puffball
PUFFBALL.Description: The user bursts a ball of sleep-inducing powder. It fails unless the targeted slot hit the user this turn.

RAZINGVINES.Name: Razing Vines
RAZINGVINES.Description: Attacks all near foes while destroying rooms. This move fails in the absence of a room.

ROOTDRIVER.Name: Root Driver
ROOTDRIVER.Description: The user kicks into the target like roots into earth. This has a 30% chance of leeching.

ROOTSHELTER.Name: Root Shelter
ROOTSHELTER.Description: Halves attack damage taken this turn. Leeches any attackers. Fails if used successively.

ROOTSOFEVIL.Name: Roots of Evil
ROOTSOFEVIL.Description: Lays roots that heal the user by absorbing 1/8th HP from foes each turn. The user becomes trapped.

SAPPINGJAW.Name: Sapping Jaw
SAPPINGJAW.Description: Saps an enemy lured into its jaws. If they hit the user this turn, the user's HP is restored by 66% the damage dealt.

SAPPINGJEALOUSY.Name: Sapping Jealousy
SAPPINGJEALOUSY.Description: Attacks with energy from jealousy. All opposing Pokémon with stat boosts get leeched.

SAPPINGSEED.Name: Sapping Seed
SAPPINGSEED.Description: A parasitic seed leeches the target and lowers both its Attack and Sp. Atk.

SHARINGSMILES.Name: Sharing Smiles
SHARINGSMILES.Description: The user and the target each share their highest stat step with the other.

SINISTERSPINES.Name: Sinister Spines
SINISTERSPINES.Description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

SOLARGLIDE.Name: Solar Glide
SOLARGLIDE.Description: Attacks by gliding on the ground. This move always goes first in sunshine.

SYMBIOSIS.Name: Symbiosis
SYMBIOSIS.Description: The user calms itself and its teammates, raise its Sp. Def by three steps, and its allies' by one.

TERADRAIN.Name: Tera Drain
TERADRAIN.Description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by 75% of the damage dealt.

THORNRATTLE.Name: Thorn Rattle
THORNRATTLE.Description: The user makes a scary sound by shaking, forcing the target to switch out. Always goes last.

VINETRAP.Name: Vine Trap
VINETRAP.Description: The user wraps the target in its vines, trapping and binding it for three turns.

WHIPKICK.Name: Whip Kick
WHIPKICK.Description: The user whips their legs into the target like a plant. This has a 10% chance of leeching.

ADVANCINGVOLTAGE.Name: Advancing Voltage
ADVANCINGVOLTAGE.Description: Guaranteed to critical hit if the target has no stat step changes. The target is surged forward, raising all its stats.

AMPUP.Name: Amp Up
AMPUP.Description: The user assists an ally's next move, boosting its power by 50% and letting it move right after the user.

ARCLAMP.Name: Arc Lamp
ARCLAMP.Description: A flare of electricity creates a bright light, damaging all nearby battlers.

BADENDING.Name: Bad Ending
BADENDING.Description: For the rest of the round, the target's healing is reversed. Always goes first.

BEAMSTRUGGLE.Name: Beam Struggle
BEAMSTRUGGLE.Description: The user and the target pit their energy against one another. The damage is based on the target's Sp. Atk rather than their Sp. Def.

CAPACITYBURST.Name: Capacity Burst
CAPACITYBURST.Description: The user surges with electricity. If it deals less than 50% of the target's max health, the user takes the difference as recoil.

CURRENTCRASH.Name: Current Crash
CURRENTCRASH.Description: The user wraps their body in electricity and crashes into the target. The user also takes 20% recoil.

DEFIBRILLATE.Name: Defibrillate
DEFIBRILLATE.Description: Revives a fainted party member to 1 HP. Only one use per battle.

DIELECTRICBREAKDOWN.Name: Dielectric Breakdown
DIELECTRICBREAKDOWN.Description: The user breaks down all insulation to send a barrage of electricity to rampage for two turns.

ELECTROCUTE.Name: Electrocute
ELECTROCUTE.Description: The user forces electricity between opposite points on the target's body. Super effective versus Steel-types.

ELECTROSLASH.Name: Electroslash
ELECTROSLASH.Description: The user harnesses a blade of lightning and slices at the target. Can random critical hit.

FLUXFIST.Name: Flux Fist
FLUXFIST.Description: The target is punched with a tremendous electric force. This move can't be used twice in a row.

FROMTHEBLUE.Name: From the Blue
FROMTHEBLUE.Description: The user lets out an electric roar, raising the user's Speed by four steps.

FULGURCLAW.Name: Fulgur Claw
FULGURCLAW.Description: The user slashes all opposing Pokémon with tendrils of electricity, lowering their Attack by two steps.

GUTCHECK.Name: Gut Check
GUTCHECK.Description: The user attacks with courage. Sets a Spikes hazard layer if Full. If Hangry, deals double damage and is Dark-type.

HEALTHYCHEER.Name: Healthy Cheer
HEALTHYCHEER.Description: The user dances to heal an ally by half of their max HP. They're cured of any non-volatile status conditions.

ILLICIUMIMPULSE.Name: Illicium Impulse
ILLICIUMIMPULSE.Description: Cloaking itself in light energy, the user shocks the target, raising the user's Sp. Def by two steps.

INERTIASHOCK.Name: Inertia Shock
INERTIASHOCK.Description: Deals 50% more damage if faster than the target. This lowers the user's Speed.

JOKEJOLT.Name: Joke Jolt
JOKEJOLT.Description: The target is pranked by an electric jolt. They are taunted and unable to use status moves for three turns.

JOLT.Name: Jolt
JOLT.Description: The user strikes the enemy while coated with electricity. It has a 10% chance to numb.

LASERBEAM.Name: Laser Beam
LASERBEAM.Description: Electricity is generated to beam intense light directly at the target. This has a 30% chance to numb.

LIGHTNINGDANCE.Name: Lightning Dance
LIGHTNINGDANCE.Description: The user dances with the speed of lightning, raising its Sp. Atk by two steps and Speed by one.

LIGHTNINGSLAM.Name: Lightning Slam
LIGHTNINGSLAM.Description: The user slams down into the target with electricity. It has a 10% chance to numb.

LIVEWIRE.Name: Live Wire
LIVEWIRE.Description: The user lays a hazard around the foe. It deals Electric-typed 1/12th HP damage, or double that in rainstorm.

LUCKYCHEER.Name: Lucky Cheer
LUCKYCHEER.Description: The user dances to encourage its ally. Their attacks this turn will be critical hits.

MAGNETICCOIL.Name: Magnetic Coil
MAGNETICCOIL.Description: The user coils its body to generate an electric field, levitating for five turns and raising its Attack and Sp. Def by two steps.

MEGAWATTSHOCK.Name: Megawatt Shock
MEGAWATTSHOCK.Description: A megawatt of electricity surges through the target. It has a 30% chance to numb.

METAFORM.Name: Metaform
METAFORM.Description: The user finds the highest base power move among your able party members, and uses it.

NUMB.Name: Numb
NUMB.Description: A weak electric jolt is launched to numb the target.

PHOTONEDGE.Name: Photon Edge
PHOTONEDGE.Description: The user slices with claws of light that have a 50% chance to numb. Can random critical hit. Counts as a Light and Slice move.

POLARCHARGE.Name: Polar Charge
POLARCHARGE.Description: Sends a pulse to flip the polarity of those nearby to damage a foe. Polarized Room is created for five turns.

QUARANTINE.Name: Quarantine
QUARANTINE.Description: Puts the target into a quarantine, trapping and disabling the move it last used for three turns.

RAPIDHERTZ.Name: Rapid Hertz
RAPIDHERTZ.Description: The target is struck with an electric current and multi-hit two to five times.

REPULSIONFIELD.Name: Repulsion Field
REPULSIONFIELD.Description: This move creates a directional magnetic field which reduces damage from attacks with 100 or more base power for five turns.

SHORTCIRCUIT.Name: Short Circuit
SHORTCIRCUIT.Description: Turns the foe's power against it, dealing damage using the target's Sp. Atk stat.

SPLITTHESKY.Name: Split the Sky
SPLITTHESKY.Description: An electrified cloud zaps the target, lowering their Speed. It has a 50% chance to flinch the target.

STORMDRIVE.Name: Storm Drive
STORMDRIVE.Description: The user charges, then attacks on the second turn. Charges instantly in rainstorm.

STUNNINGDISPLAY.Name: Stunning Display
STUNNINGDISPLAY.Description: The user erupts with powerful yellow light to damage and numb the target.

SURGESNARE.Name: Surge Snare
SURGESNARE.Description: The user creates an electric fueled cage, trapping and binding it for three turns.

THUNDERBELLY.Name: Thunder Belly
THUNDERBELLY.Description: The user takes an entire grid of power into its belly to slam the target. The user takes 100% recoil.

VOLTCRUNCH.Name: Volt Crunch
VOLTCRUNCH.Description: The user chomps down with high-voltage fangs. It has a 20% chance to numb and a 20% chance to lower Defense by two steps.

VOLTSEEKERS.Name: Volt Seekers
VOLTSEEKERS.Description: Launches many homing bolts. Deals 50% more damage unless it's the first turn the target is in battle.

WALLOFSOUND.Name: Wall of Sound
WALLOFSOUND.Description: The user rocks out by using each Sound-based move they know. Only one use per battle.

ABERRANTMOTE.Name: Aberrant Mote
ABERRANTMOTE.Description: The user fires a dimensional mote, lowering the target's Sp. Def.

ANATMAN.Name: Anatman
ANATMAN.Description: The user meditates, raising both its Attack and Sp. Atk by four steps.

BLINDSIDE.Name: Blind Side
BLINDSIDE.Description: The user skillfully attacks around the enemy's guard. Can't miss and skips protections.

BRAINFREEZE.Name: Brain Freeze
BRAINFREEZE.Description: The user slows the target's mind with a psychically infused blow. This has a 30% chance to frostbite.

CENSOR.Name: Censor
CENSOR.Description: Splits off a section of the target's psyche. Disables their last used move for five turns.

CORECOLLAPSE.Name: Core Collapse
CORECOLLAPSE.Description: Astral energy explodes around the target. This move always goes first. The user also takes 50% recoil.

DEMONSKISS.Name: Demon's Kiss
DEMONSKISS.Description: By sacrificing half its max HP, the user makes the target fall asleep.

DREAMABSORB.Name: Dream Absorb
DREAMABSORB.Description: The user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt. Power doubles if the foe is asleep.

ECLIPSE.Name: Eclipse
ECLIPSE.Description: Summons eclipse for six turns, boosting Psychic-type attacks and heralding the total eclipse.

ESPERDIVE.Name: Esper Dive
ESPERDIVE.Description: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This boosts the user's Speed by two steps.

EXPLOIT.Name: Exploit
EXPLOIT.Description: The user psychically exploits weak points in the target's mind. Can random critical hit, and does so twice as often.

GENOTHEOSIS.Name: Genotheosis
GENOTHEOSIS.Description: The user psychically modifies its own genes, transforming into either Overmatter form or Overmind form.

HUNDREDHANDCLAP.Name: Hundred-Hand Clap
HUNDREDHANDCLAP.Description: The user claps with the power of a hundred hands, psionically striking all nearby battlers.

HYPNOTHERAPY.Name: Hypnotherapy
HYPNOTHERAPY.Description: The user swings its pendulum to cure a statused target, but make them fall into a deep sleep.

INVITEECLIPSE.Name: Invite Eclipse
INVITEECLIPSE.Description: The user dizzies the target, then welcomes in eclipse for eight turns.

KICKSTART.Name: Kickstart
KICKSTART.Description: The user encourages the target to attack right after the user. Always goes first.

KINETICGRIP.Name: Kinetic Grip
KINETICGRIP.Description: The user conjures a giant fist to crush the target, trapping and binding it for three turns.

MAGEHAND.Name: Mage Hand
MAGEHAND.Description: The user grabs the target with a conjured hand, trapping and binding it for three turns.

MEMORYREMOVAL.Name: Memory Removal
MEMORYREMOVAL.Description: The user psychically alters the target's brain to forget. This move disables the target's last move for five turns.

MINDLINK.Name: Mind Link
MINDLINK.Description: The user syncs its mind with its teammates, raising its Sp. Atk by three steps, and its allies' by one.

MINDWAVES.Name: Mind Waves
MINDWAVES.Description: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It has a 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def.

MITOSIS.Name: Mitosis
MITOSIS.Description: The user spends 50% HP to create a Substitute. If successful, the user's Speed is raised by four steps.

NEURALPULSE.Name: Neural Pulse
NEURALPULSE.Description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It has a 20% chance to lower Sp. Def.

ODDROOM.Name: Odd Room
ODDROOM.Description: The user creates an odd area for six turns in which Pokémon's offensive and defensive stats are swapped.

OMNISCIENTBLOW.Name: Omniscient Blow
OMNISCIENTBLOW.Description: The user perfectly predicts the target's future location, then strikes. Lands without fail. This lowers the user's Defense and Speed.

ONEIROMANCY.Name: Oneiromancy
ONEIROMANCY.Description: This move raises all the user's stats by two steps. Can only be used while asleep.

OUTWIT.Name: Outwit
OUTWIT.Description: The user attacks with an overpowering, superior intellect. Super effective versus Normal-types.

PACIFY.Name: Pacify
PACIFY.Description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make a dizzy target fall into a deep sleep.

PATTERNRELEASE.Name: Pattern Release
PATTERNRELEASE.Description: Unveiling its ears, the released psychic power causes the user to rampage and multi-hit two to five times for two turns.

PENUMBRA.Name: Penumbra
PENUMBRA.Description: Psychic energy assaults the foe and darkens the sky, summoning eclipse for eight turns.

PIERCINGDOUBT.Name: Piercing Doubt
PIERCINGDOUBT.Description: Pierces the mind of the target, inflicting doubt in their abilities, guaranteeing a critical hit on foes with boosted stats.

PSYCHESWITCH.Name: Psyche Switch
PSYCHESWITCH.Description: After making its attack to the target's psyche, the user teleports back to switch places with a party Pokémon.

PSYCHICOVERLOAD.Name: Psychic Overload
PSYCHICOVERLOAD.Description: The user overloads its mind to rampage for two turns.

PSYCHOSCISSION.Name: Psychoscission
PSYCHOSCISSION.Description: The user cuts using scissor-like blades of psychic energy. Can random critical hit.

PSYPIERCE.Name: Psypierce
PSYPIERCE.Description: The user manifests a piercing bolt of psychic energy. It has a 40% chance to lower Sp. Def.

PULSAR.Name: Pulsar
PULSAR.Description: The user sends waves of cosmic energy to overwhelm the target's senses. Multi-hits two to five times.

QUASARCRUSH.Name: Quasar Crush
QUASARCRUSH.Description: Charges with astral power and boosts its Attack by two steps on one turn, then attacks on the second turn.

REMBURST.Name: REM Burst
REMBURST.Description: The user forces its dreams to manifest, attacking the opponent. This move can only be used while asleep.

REVERBWARD.Name: Reverb Ward
REVERBWARD.Description: Protects the user from damage this turn. It also lowers the Sp. Def of special attackers by four steps.

RHYTHMICRITUAL.Name: Rhythmic Ritual
RHYTHMICRITUAL.Description: The user does an arcane dance to summon a Pearl Of Wisdom to hold. The Pearl boosts all stats by 20% and can be flung for huge damage.

SCRUTINIZE.Name: Scrutinize
SCRUTINIZE.Description: The target is scrutinized, damaging their psyche. Can random critical hit.

SELECTIVEMEMORY.Name: Selective Memory
SELECTIVEMEMORY.Description: The user peruses its kingly stores of knowledge, selecting three random non-Psychic attacks. You choose which one it uses.

STARDANCE.Name: Star Dance
STARDANCE.Description: The user dazzles the target with celestial visions that lowers its Sp. Atk by five steps.

SYNAPTICUNLOCK.Name: Synaptic Unlock
SYNAPTICUNLOCK.Description: The user connects to the target's brainwaves to stabilize its mind, curing its dizziness, and granting it its other legal ability.

TOTALCONTROL.Name: Total Control
TOTALCONTROL.Description: The user takes control of the target's mind to unleash an attack on it. Can random critical hit.

TRICKSTERSDOMAIN.Name: Trickster's Domain
TRICKSTERSDOMAIN.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns. Only usable by Hoopa.

TUTELAGE.Name: Tutelage
TUTELAGE.Description: The user imparts knowledge on its ally Pokémon, raising their Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by two steps.

ABSOLUTEZERO.Name: Absolute Zero
ABSOLUTEZERO.Description: The user chills all near foes so severely that their speed becomes zero.

AURORAFLASH.Name: Aurora Flash
AURORAFLASH.Description: An aurora borealis flashes brightly at the target, lowering their Attack. Always goes first.

CHILL.Name: Chill
CHILL.Description: The user lowers the target's body temperature, afflicting it with frostbite.

COLDEMBRACE.Name: Cold Embrace
COLDEMBRACE.Description: The user grabs the target in a chilly embrace. It has a 10% chance to frostbite.

COLDSNAP.Name: Cold Snap
COLDSNAP.Description: The user readies an attack with memories of ancient cold before attacking. If hit by a foe's special move, frostbite the attacker.

CRYOSLEEP.Name: Cryo Sleep
CRYOSLEEP.Description: The target is put to sleep via a deep freeze. The user is exhausted on the next turn.

DIAMONDDUST.Name: Diamond Dust
DIAMONDDUST.Description: The user covers the field with an fog of ice crystals, summoning hail and creating Grey Mist for five turns.

FRIGIDFLURRY.Name: Frigid Flurry
FRIGIDFLURRY.Description: The user summons a wind that drains vitality from all nearby foes. This has a 20% chance to frostbite them.

FRIGIDJEALOUSY.Name: Frigid Jealousy
FRIGIDJEALOUSY.Description: Attacks with energy from jealousy. All opposing Pokémon with stat boosts get frostbitten.

FROSTBARB.Name: Frost Barb
FROSTBARB.Description: The user jabs the target with a sharp icicle. It has a 40% chance to lower Defense.

FROSTFIST.Name: Frost Fist
FROSTFIST.Description: The target is punched with a tremendous icy force. This move can't be used twice in a row.

FROSTOVER.Name: Frost Over
FROSTOVER.Description: The target is overwhelmed by cold energy. It has a 30% chance to frostbite.

FROSTSPIKES.Name: Frost Spikes
FROSTSPIKES.Description: The user lays a hazard layer of frozen spikes on the foe's side. One layer hurts switched in foes, two layers frostbites.

GLACIALCRUNCH.Name: Glacial Crunch
GLACIALCRUNCH.Description: The user chomps down with icy cold fangs. It has a 20% chance to frostbite and a 20% chance to lower Defense by two steps.

GLACIALRAM.Name: Glacial Ram
GLACIALRAM.Description: Rams the target with frigid force. This has a 10% chance to frostbite.

HALTINGCOLD.Name: Halting Cold
HALTINGCOLD.Description: The user attacks the target with a frontal cold wind. It lowers the target's Speed by three steps.

HIBERNALFLUX.Name: Hibernal Flux
HIBERNALFLUX.Description: The user absorbs the target's heat, frostbiting it and adding the Ice-type to it.

HYPERFROST.Name: Hyperfrost
HYPERFROST.Description: The user freezes the target in place, dealing damage and minimizing their Speed and Evasion.

HYPOTHERMIATE.Name: Hypothermiate
HYPOTHERMIATE.Description: For the rest of the round, the target's healing is reversed.

ICEBERGBASH.Name: Iceberg Bash
ICEBERGBASH.Description: The user picks up an iceberg and slams it into the target. This lowers the user's Attack by four steps.

ICECALIBUR.Name: Icecalibur
ICECALIBUR.Description: The user slashes the target with ice like a sword. It has a 20% chance to lower Defense.

ICENINEWALL.Name: Ice-Nine Wall
ICENINEWALL.Description: Halves attack damage taken this turn. Frostbites any attackers. Fails if used successively.

ICEPICK.Name: Ice Pick
ICEPICK.Description: The user targets the target's coldest spots. Its power doubles if the target is frostbitten.

ICICLEPIN.Name: Icicle Pin
ICICLEPIN.Description: The user pins the target down with icy spikes, applying frostbite and trapping it.

ICYINJECTION.Name: Icy Injection
ICYINJECTION.Description: Injects supercold liquid into the target, damaging them and halving all future healing.

INURE.Name: Inure
INURE.Description: The user inures themselves to a harsh environment, shedding their type weaknesses.

INVITEHAIL.Name: Invite Hail
INVITEHAIL.Description: The user frostbites the target, then welcomes in hail for eight turns.

LOOMINGWINTER.Name: Looming Winter
LOOMINGWINTER.Description: The user foretells imminent winter. Two turns later, extreme cold attacks the targeted spot.

PACKAGE.Name: Package
PACKAGE.Description: The user throws an exploding package at enemies, or one filled with healing treats at allies.

SHEDCOAT.Name: Shed Coat
SHEDCOAT.Description: The user sheds excess covering. This raises the user's Sp. Atk and Speed by three steps, but lowers Sp. Def by two steps.

SHIVERDANCE.Name: Shiver Dance
SHIVERDANCE.Description: The user raises their Attack and Defense by two steps, and Speed by one step.

SHIVERSQUIRM.Name: Shiver Squirm
SHIVERSQUIRM.Description: The user flips, flaps, fumbles, then flounders. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

SNOWBALL.Name: Snowball
SNOWBALL.Description: The user rolls into the target while covered in snow.

SNOWSPILL.Name: Snow Spill
SNOWSPILL.Description: The user makes the target to trip into a huge pile of snow, damaging them and summoning hail for eight turns.

SNOWYSORROWS.Name: Snowy Sorrows
SNOWYSORROWS.Description: The user incants a snowy hex, dealing damage and setting a hazard layer of frozen spikes around the target.

SUBLIMATE.Name: Sublimate
SUBLIMATE.Description: To inflict massive damage, the user uses up its Ice-typing. This move can't be used if the user is not an Ice type.

SUPERCOOL.Name: Supercool
SUPERCOOL.Description: The user saps all the target's heat with a frigid touch, frostbiting it.

THERMALDRAIN.Name: Thermal Drain
THERMALDRAIN.Description: Drains the heat from the target. The user's HP is restored by 50% the damage dealt.

WINTEROPS.Name: Winter Ops
WINTEROPS.Description: Hits once for each party Pokémon. Deals more damage based on their Attack.

APEXPREDATION.Name: Apex Predation
APEXPREDATION.Description: The user bites a vulnerable spot from above. Super effective versus Flying-types.

ARCHMYTH.Name: Archmyth
ARCHMYTH.Description: Invokes the aspects of many dragons, striking with a physical move and a special move.

AXETOGRIND.Name: Axe to Grind
AXETOGRIND.Description: The user attacks fueled by ire. Deals double damage if it's a critical hit.

BITTERBILE.Name: Bitter Bile
BITTERBILE.Description: The user spits digestive juices at the target, destroying their held item.

CALAMITOUSSLASH.Name: Calamitous Slash
CALAMITOUSSLASH.Description: The user slashes the foe while menacing. During eclipse, the target also becomes burned.

CARNAGE.Name: Carnage
CARNAGE.Description: The user rips and tears its way across the battlefield, damaging all near Pokémon and taking 50% recoil.

CHOWDOWN.Name: Chow Down
CHOWDOWN.Description: The user bites to drain the target's energy. The user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt.

CLASH.Name: Clash
CLASH.Description: The user harnesses primal instincts to strike at the target. This has a 20% chance to lower the higher of the target's Attack or Sp. Atk.

CRUELTY.Name: Cruelty
CRUELTY.Description: The user crushes the target with evil intent. This deals double damage if the target has a non-volatile status condition.

DEMANDINGGAZE.Name: Demanding Gaze
DEMANDINGGAZE.Description: Eyes pulsing with rainbow energy damage the target and force it to hand over its held item. Items stolen from wild Pokémon are stored.

DEVOUR.Name: Devour
DEVOUR.Description: The user bites to drain the target's energy.  The user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt.

DIAMETRICBREATH.Name: Diametric Breath
DIAMETRICBREATH.Description: Exhales magical fumes with a 30% chance to burn or frostbite the target depending on their stats.

DRAGOMASTWAVES.Name: Dragomast Waves
DRAGOMASTWAVES.Description: Sends hindering waves of energy forward, lowering hit foes' Evasion by four steps.

DRAGONRIDE.Name: Dragon Ride
DRAGONRIDE.Description: Doubles target ally's Attack and Speed. However, if the user faints, so too does that ally.

DREAD.Name: Dread
DREAD.Description: The user inspires a sudden dread in the target, damaging it. This move always goes first.

DREEPYBARRAGE.Name: Dreepy Barrage
DREEPYBARRAGE.Description: The user launches four Dreepies, which spread out equally to hit near foes. But, they avoid targets they can't hit.

FROSTFIREBLAST.Name: Frostfire Blast
FROSTFIREBLAST.Description: The user charges, then attacks on the second turn. This burns or frostbites the target depending on their stats.

GNAW.Name: Gnaw
GNAW.Description: The user bites to drain the target's energy. The user's HP is restored by 50% of the damage dealt.

GUTTURALROAR.Name: Guttural Roar
GUTTURALROAR.Description: The user shakes the target with a deep, rumbling roar. This attack does physical damage.

HELIOPAUSE.Name: Heliopause
HELIOPAUSE.Description: Protects the user from attacks. If an eclipse is active, extends it by one turn. Fails if used in succession.

HISS.Name: Hiss
HISS.Description: The target is harmed by a malevolent sound. This has a 20% chance to lower the higher of the target's Attack or Sp. Atk.

HYDRASTRIKE.Name: Hydra Strike
HYDRASTRIKE.Description: The user strikes from swampy ground like a serpent. It has a 30% chance to waterlog.

JETSPEED.Name: Jet Speed
JETSPEED.Description: The user flies high up into the air at supersonic speed, charging and becoming hidden. It greatly increases in power the faster the user is.
