LOOMOVER.Name: Loom Over
LOOMOVER.Description: The user looms over the target with awful menace, lowering their highest stat by four steps.

OCCULTATION.Name: Occultation
OCCULTATION.Description: Attacks all foes with dormant draconic energy. Power increases by 50% in eclipse.

REDUCINGSYRUP.Name: Reducing Syrup
REDUCINGSYRUP.Description: The user sprays the target with a shrinking liquid. For the next three turns, the target's highest stat will be lowered by two steps.

SACREDLOTS.Name: Sacred Lots
SACREDLOTS.Description: The user makes an offering, then multi-hits two to five times. Scatters coins for each hit.

SCOUR.Name: Scour
SCOUR.Description: The user whips up a tornado to tear at the target. It has a 40% chance to flinch the target.

SLUMBERINGROAR.Name: Slumbering Roar
SLUMBERINGROAR.Description: The user lets out a thunderous noise while sleeping. This move can only be used while asleep.

TRANSCENDENTENERGY.Name: Transcendent Energy
TRANSCENDENTENERGY.Description: The user charges up insane amounts of energy the first turn, then transforms on the second turn.

TRIPLETHREAT.Name: Triple Threat
TRIPLETHREAT.Description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. It has a 20% chance each to numb, burn, or frostbite.

TYRANTSFIT.Name: Tyrant's Fit
TYRANTSFIT.Description: The user throws a royal fit to rampage for two turns. Raises Speed if a target is knocked out by this move.

WINGSPANECLIPSE.Name: Wingspan Eclipse
WINGSPANECLIPSE.Description: The Pokémon blots out the sky, summoning eclipse for eight turns and lowering each opponent's Attack by two steps.

WYRMWOUNDING.Name: Wyrmwounding
WYRMWOUNDING.Description: The user roots itself, then strikes at the target with serpentine strength. This has a 30% chance to leech.

ABYSSALMIST.Name: Abyssal Mist
ABYSSALMIST.Description: Darkness rolls over the field, damaging all other Pokémon and setting Grey Mist for five turns.

BACKHAND.Name: Backhand
BACKHAND.Description: The user insults the target using a compliment. Their Attack and Sp. Atk are raised by three steps, but they hurt themselves in confusion.

BADBLOOD.Name: Bad Blood
BADBLOOD.Description: The user maximizes its Sp. Atk in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

BLACKHOLE.Name: Black Hole
BLACKHOLE.Description: Bites a hole in reality, creating a black hole to damage all near foes. Gravity is intensified for five turns.

BLACKOUT.Name: Blackout
BLACKOUT.Description: The user removes the energy and light around the target. Super effective versus Electric-types.

BROWBEAT.Name: Browbeat
BROWBEAT.Description: This attack deals 50% more damage if the target has any raised or lowered stat steps.

CALLOFTHEVOID.Name: Call of the Void
CALLOFTHEVOID.Description: The user sacrifices their ally to cover all near foes in total darkness, making them drowsy. Fails if the user has no ally.

CALTROPARTS.Name: Caltrop Arts
CALTROPARTS.Description: Deftly sets a hazard layer of damaging Spikes around the foe, then switches out.

CHECKMATE.Name: Checkmate
CHECKMATE.Description: If the target is the last able member of their party, this attack's power is doubled.

CULL.Name: Cull
CULL.Description: The user tries to pick off a weak target. After damage, if the target is below 25% HP, they instantly faint.

DARKALLURE.Name: Dark Allure
DARKALLURE.Description: The user burrows into the target's subconscious with emotional manipulation. It has a 10% chance to leech.

DISARMINGSHOT.Name: Disarming Shot
DISARMINGSHOT.Description: The user disarms the target's blade. The target cannot use slice-based moves for two turns.

DROWN.Name: Drown
DROWN.Description: The target is forced underwater for a brief time, waterlogging it.

DUNK.Name: Dunk
DUNK.Description: The user pushes the target violently into water. This has a 10% chance to waterlog.

FINALIZE.Name: Finalize
FINALIZE.Description: When the user knocks out a target with this move, this raises the user's Sp. Atk by five steps.

GLEEFULGRASP.Name: Gleeful Grasp
GLEEFULGRASP.Description: The user indulges its love of battle by striking a foe. Both of the user's Attack and Sp. Atk are raised.

GLOAT.Name: Gloat
GLOAT.Description: The user raises all of their stats by two steps. Fails unless a foe is below half health.

GRIMVISIONS.Name: Grim Visions
GRIMVISIONS.Description: The user attacks with dark illusions. This also lowers the target's Defense by two steps.

HARSHVIBES.Name: Harsh Vibes
HARSHVIBES.Description: The target is attacked with a pulse of negative feelings. It has a 40% chance to flinch the target.

HATEFULHAYMAKER.Name: Hateful Haymaker
HATEFULHAYMAKER.Description: A punch that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

HEARTSTOPPER.Name: Heartstopper
HEARTSTOPPER.Description: For the rest of the round, the healing of all damaged Pokémon is reversed.

INCISION.Name: Incision
INCISION.Description: The user prepares a precise cut. Always a critical hit. This lowers the user's Speed.

KEELHAUL.Name: Keelhaul
KEELHAUL.Description: The target is dragged viciously through water. This has a 30% chance to waterlog.

LURK.Name: Lurk
LURK.Description: The user hides stealthily, charging and becoming hidden, then strikes on the second turn.

MASSDESTRUCTION.Name: Mass Destruction
MASSDESTRUCTION.Description: The user emits a wave of anxious feelings which overwhelms all nearby Pokémon, taking 50% recoil.

MIDNIGHTHUNT.Name: Midnight Hunt
MIDNIGHTHUNT.Description: Summons moonglow for eight turns and raises the user's Attack by two steps.

MINDSAP.Name: Mind Sap
MINDSAP.Description: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk, then heals itself by the target's Sp. Atk.

MOUTHFUL.Name: Mouthful
MOUTHFUL.Description: The user chomps hard, cutting the target's HP by 50%, and the user's HP is restored by 50% of that.

NIGHTCHILL.Name: Night Chill
NIGHTCHILL.Description: Damages the target's life force directly. During moonglow, the target also becomes frostbitten.

NIGHTFELLING.Name: Nightfelling
NIGHTFELLING.Description: The user tries to surprise-attack the target. Cannot miss in moonglow. Can random critical hit.

PILFER.Name: Pilfer
PILFER.Description: The user attacks and steals the foe's held item. It can't steal if the user holds an item.

PLANTDOUBT.Name: Plant Doubt
PLANTDOUBT.Description: The user entangles the target's mind with dark thoughts, leeching it.

PROFANE.Name: Profane
PROFANE.Description: The user invades deep into the target's mind, leeching it.

ROYALTRIBUTE.Name: Royal Tribute
ROYALTRIBUTE.Description: The user demands tribute from the target. Scatters coins. Damage and coins are doubled if the target has a non-volatile status condition.

SCAM.Name: Scam
SCAM.Description: The user steals the target's stat boosts, and then attacks. Goes last.

SCARRINGSWING.Name: Scarring Swing
SCARRINGSWING.Description: The user slashes all around them, creating deep scars on all nearby foes. This lowers each target's Attack.

SCHEME.Name: Scheme
SCHEME.Description: The user schemes to raise its Attack and Sp. Atk by two steps. During moonglow, also raises Speed by two steps.

SEVER.Name: Sever
SEVER.Description: The user hacks at the target with great violence. Can random critical hit.

SHAREDSPOILS.Name: Shared Spoils
SHAREDSPOILS.Description: The user attacks and steals the foe's held item simultaneously. You then choose a party member to hold it.

SPIKYBURST.Name: Spiky Burst
SPIKYBURST.Description: Explodes, dealing an extra 30 base power to all nearby for each Spikes hazard layer underneath them. The user faints.

STALKING.Name: Stalking
STALKING.Description: The user darkly follows the target before striking. Inflicts double damage on a target that is switching out.

STAREDOWN.Name: Stare Down
STAREDOWN.Description: Stares harshly, dealing double damage if they hurt the user this turn. Only usable on the first turn.

SWEETSELENE.Name: Sweet Selene
SWEETSELENE.Description: The user heals itself by half of its max HP, or 66% in moonglow.

TEASE.Name: Tease
TEASE.Description: The user bullies the target, causing mental damage. This has a 30% chance to leech.

TOSSNTURN.Name: Toss n' Turn
TOSSNTURN.Description: The user swings aggressively while suffering from nightmares. This move can only be used while asleep.

VERMINCLOUD.Name: Vermin Cloud
VERMINCLOUD.Description: The user transforms into a cloud of vermin, charging and becoming hidden. On the second turn it ambushes the target.

WETWORK.Name: Wet Work
WETWORK.Description: The user submerges the target in water, then bludgeons them repeatedly. This has a 10% chance to waterlog.

BALEFULBOP.Name: Baleful Bop
BALEFULBOP.Description: The user sings with reckless abandon, annoying the target. There's a 30% chance they become dizzy.

BASHANDBORROW.Name: Bash and Borrow
BASHANDBORROW.Description: The user smacks the target and steals its item while it is stunned. Items stolen from wild Pokémon are stored.

BEDTIME.Name: Bed Time
BEDTIME.Description: The target is lulled to sleep. Can only be used during a Full Moon.

BUCKETDROP.Name: Bucket Drop
BUCKETDROP.Description: The target is pranked with a huge bucket of water. This has a 30% chance to waterlog it.

CHARITY.Name: Charity
CHARITY.Description: The target is hit with a generous donation. Consumes up to 1000 scattered coins. Base power is boosted by 10 for every 100 consumed.

CORALOVERGROWTH.Name: Coral Overgrowth
CORALOVERGROWTH.Description: Healing coral forms on the foe's side. For the next four turns, attacks on foes heal the user for 33% of the damage dealt. This can overheal.

CRUELKISS.Name: Cruel Kiss
CRUELKISS.Description: Leeches the target by kissing them with its thin mouth.

DREAMDANCE.Name: Dream Dance
DREAMDANCE.Description: The user dances in tune with a dreamlike energy, raising their Sp. Atk by four steps.

DREAMSCAPE.Name: Dreamscape
DREAMSCAPE.Description: The user goes to sleep and enters a dreamscape. This sets Sanctuary on the user's side for eight turns.

EAGERTICKLING.Name: Eager Tickling
EAGERTICKLING.Description: The user tickles the target excessively, damaging it. This has a 20% chance to lower Attack.

EMOTIONALDELUGE.Name: Emotional Deluge
EMOTIONALDELUGE.Description: The target's mind is overloaded with emotion. Applies Torment to the target.

ENCHANTEDARROW.Name: Enchanted Arrow
ENCHANTEDARROW.Description: The user shoots a magical arrow which seeks out the target's weak points. Can random critical hit.

ENCHANTINGSONG.Name: Enchanting Song
ENCHANTINGSONG.Description: An enchanting outcry. Can't miss and skips protections.

FLEETINGFOOTWORK.Name: Fleeting Footwork
FLEETINGFOOTWORK.Description: The user dances vigorously, raising all its stats by three steps. The user’s stat steps are reset two turns later.

FLORALGRAMARYE.Name: Floral Gramarye
FLORALGRAMARYE.Description: A patch of medicinal flowers sprouts across the battlefield. This heals every Pokémon for 1/8th HP each turn for five turns.

FROLIC.Name: Frolic
FROLIC.Description: The user plays with the target with unnecessary force. It has a 50% chance to lower Attack.

GEASGALE.Name: Geas Gale
GEASGALE.Description: The target is punished by a barrage of fae wind. This has a 30% chance of jinxing them.

GEMFORGEDOATH.Name: Gemforged Oath
GEMFORGEDOATH.Description: The user draws the Crystal Caliburn, which empowers light and slice moves by 50% and transforms the holder into Royal form.

GLAMOURFLASH.Name: Glamour Flash
GLAMOURFLASH.Description: The user flashes colorful light to damage the target. This move always goes first.

GLITTERBOMB.Name: Glitter Bomb
GLITTERBOMB.Description: The user chucks a party favor which explodes in the target's face.

HEARTRHYTHM.Name: Heart Rhythm
HEARTRHYTHM.Description: Makes everyone's hearts beat together. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

HONEYSLATHER.Name: Honey Slather
HONEYSLATHER.Description: The user uses honey to fully restore its HP. However, this lures swarming insects, trapping and binding the user for three turns.

HUMBLE.Name: Humble
HUMBLE.Description: The user attempts to humble the target, guaranteeing a critical hit on foes with boosted stats.

ILLWISHES.Name: Ill Wishes
ILLWISHES.Description: The user hopes for bad luck, jinxing the target. Attacks against them crit and pierce protection.

INFINITEFORCE.Name: Infinite Force
INFINITEFORCE.Description: The user wields an exaggerated power to strike the target. This lowers the user's Attack by four steps.

INNOCENTMASQUE.Name: Innocent Masque
INNOCENTMASQUE.Description: The target is taunted by a deceptive look. It can't use status moves this or next turn. This move always goes first.

INVITEMOONGLOW.Name: Invite Moonglow
INVITEMOONGLOW.Description: The user leeches the target, then welcomes in moonglow for eight turns.

MANYBLESSINGS.Name: Many Blessings
MANYBLESSINGS.Description: Enables random critical hits for the user, doubles its critical hit chance, and raises its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by two steps.

MISADVENTURE.Name: Misadventure
MISADVENTURE.Description: The user causes an accident, damaging the target. This has a 30% chance of jinxing them.

MISHAP.Name: Mishap
MISHAP.Description: The user causes the target to trip and fall. This has a 50% chance of jinxing them.

MISTBURST.Name: Mist Burst
MISTBURST.Description: Attacks nearby foes with a misty explosion. The user loses half its current HP.

MISTYMIRAGE.Name: Misty Mirage
MISTYMIRAGE.Description: The user disappears in a cloud of mist, charging and becoming hidden. On the next turn, the target becomes jinxed and frostbitten.

MOONGLOW.Name: Moonglow
MOONGLOW.Description: Summons moonglow for six turns, boosting Fairy-type attacks and heralding the Full Moon.

MORNINGSTAR.Name: Morningstar
MORNINGSTAR.Description: The user invokes forbidden celestial powers to smite the target.

PIXIEPUNCH.Name: Pixie Punch
PIXIEPUNCH.Description: The user throws a tricky punch. Can't miss and skips protections.

PLAYBITE.Name: Play Bite
PLAYBITE.Description: The user bites with playful abandon. This deals double damage on the user's first turn out.

PUZZLEROOM.Name: Puzzle Room
PUZZLEROOM.Description: The user creates a puzzling area for six turns in which Pokémon's unmodified Attack and Sp. Atk are swapped.

RIDDLEMETHIS.Name: Riddle Me This
RIDDLEMETHIS.Description: The user captivates the target with something puzzling, then strikes. Super effective versus Psychic-types.

STROKEOFMIDNIGHT.Name: Stroke of Midnight
STROKEOFMIDNIGHT.Description: The user foretells a terrible fate. Two turns later, the targeted spot is damaged by fated disaster.

SUGARBALL.Name: Sugar Ball
SUGARBALL.Description: The user spins sugar into a ball launched at the target. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

SYLPHSPELL.Name: Sylph Spell
SYLPHSPELL.Description: A spirited wind blesses the user, raising its Sp. Atk, Speed, and Accuracy.

TANTRUM.Name: Tantrum
TANTRUM.Description: The user goes on a wild tantrum, going on a rampage for two turns.

TITFORTAT.Name: Tit for Tat
TITFORTAT.Description: The user swaps the target's held item with its own. It also switches its unmodified Speed with the target's Speed.

TRUENAME.Name: True Name
TRUENAME.Description: The user uses fae magic to invoke the target's true name, jinxing them.

WARDPRESS.Name: Ward Press
WARDPRESS.Description: The user attacks with its wards, dealing damage based on the user's Sp. Def stat.

WAXINGLIGHT.Name: Waxing Light
WAXINGLIGHT.Description: Strikes the target with lunar light, then summons moonglow for eight turns.

WAYWARDWIND.Name: Wayward Wind
WAYWARDWIND.Description: A mischevious wind whips around to attack the target. This has a 50% chance of jinxing them.

DISCOVEREDPOWER.Name: Discovered Power
DISCOVEREDPOWER.Description: The user ponders ancient wisdom, selecting three random status moves. You choose which one it uses.

MUTATE.Name: Mutate
MUTATE.Description: The user mutates its genetic code, transforming into any of its 3 other forms. Only useable as Deoxys Normal.

FIGHTINGCHANCE.Name: Fighting Chance
FIGHTINGCHANCE.Description: The user makes a risky, difficult attack. If it misses, the user's Accuracy is raised.

HIDDENSTRIKE.Name: Hidden Strike
HIDDENSTRIKE.Description: The user hides, charging and becoming hidden, then strikes the target on the second turn.

LONGSHOT.Name: Long Shot
LONGSHOT.Description: The user makes a foolhardy, roundabout attack. It misses much of the time.

MULTISTRIKE.Name: Multi-Strike
MULTISTRIKE.Description: The target is multi-hit two to five times.

PLANAHEAD.Name: Plan Ahead
PLANAHEAD.Description: The user foretells an attack. Two turns later, the targeted spot is struck by a well-planned attack.

RUNAMUCK.Name: Run Amuck
RUNAMUCK.Description: The user attacks with simple determination and rampages for two turns.

EMPOWEREDSLASH.Name: Empowered Slash
EMPOWEREDSLASH.Description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades, always critting.

PRIMEVALDAZZLE.Name: Primeval Dazzle
PRIMEVALDAZZLE.Description: The user gleams with light. This lowers each foe's Sp. Atk by two steps and raises its own Sp. Atk by two steps.

PRIMEVALENDURE.Name: Primeval Endure
PRIMEVALENDURE.Description: The user prepares to defend itself. It'll survive the next three hits which would faint it.

PRIMEVALGROWL.Name: Primeval Growl
PRIMEVALGROWL.Description: The user growls fiercely. This lowers each foe's Attack by two steps and raises its own Attack by two steps.

PRIMEVALROLEPLAY.Name: Primeval Role Play
PRIMEVALROLEPLAY.Description: The user copies and gains the first ability of each foe.

PRIMEVALWORKUP.Name: Primeval Work Up
PRIMEVALWORKUP.Description: The user is roused, giving it the ability to use an extra move each turn.

PRIMEVALYAWN.Name: Primeval Yawn
PRIMEVALYAWN.Description: The user yawns, making all near foes drowsy. They'll fall asleep at the end of the next turn.

EMPOWEREDBRICKBREAK.Name: Empowered Brick Break
EMPOWEREDBRICKBREAK.Description: The user attacks with a swift chop, destroying barriers. This lowers the target's Defense by five steps.

PRIMEVALBULKUP.Name: Primeval Bulk Up
PRIMEVALBULKUP.Description: The user raises its Attack and Defense by two steps, gains a lot of weight. User becomes Fighting-type.

PRIMEVALDEEPBREATHING.Name: Primeval Deep Breathing
PRIMEVALDEEPBREATHING.Description: The user raises its Speed by two steps and quadruples its critical hit chance. User becomes Fighting-type.

PRIMEVALDETECT.Name: Primeval Detect
PRIMEVALDETECT.Description: The user takes 50% less attack damage for 3 turns. User becomes Fighting-type.

PRIMEVALSTANDTOGETHER.Name: Primeval Stand Together
PRIMEVALSTANDTOGETHER.Description: The user summons an allied Tyrogue. This raises its Defense by three steps, and its allies' by one. User becomes Fighting-type.

EMPOWEREDBRAVEBIRD.Name: Empowered Brave Bird
EMPOWEREDBRAVEBIRD.Description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes 33% recoil.

PRIMEVALTAILWIND.Name: Primeval Tailwind
PRIMEVALTAILWIND.Description: The user sets a powerful tailwind for 6 turns, which also increases move damage by 30%. User becomes Flying-type.

PRIMEVALWHIRLWIND.Name: Primeval Whirlwind
PRIMEVALWHIRLWIND.Description: All near foes are forced to switch out. User becomes Flying-type.

STRATOSPHERESCREAM.Name: Stratosphere Scream
STRATOSPHERESCREAM.Description: A move that only the avatar of Rayquaza can use. All enemies struck lose their flinch immunity.

EMPOWEREDCROSSPOISON.Name: Empowered Cross Poison
EMPOWEREDCROSSPOISON.Description: The user slashes all near foes with with poisonous blades or edges. Will be critical against poisoned targets.

EMPOWEREDSLUDGEWAVE.Name: Empowered Sludge Wave
EMPOWEREDSLUDGEWAVE.Description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave, poisoning everyone struck.

PRIMEVALCOIL.Name: Primeval Coil
PRIMEVALCOIL.Description: The user raises its Attack, Defense, and Accuracy by two steps. This summons an allied Ekans. User becomes Poison-type.

PRIMEVALGREYMIST.Name: Primeval Grey Mist
PRIMEVALGREYMIST.Description: The user sets Grey Mist for 8 turns and gives themselves a Black Sludge. User becomes Poison-type.

PRIMEVALPOISONGAS.Name: Primeval Poison Gas
PRIMEVALPOISONGAS.Description: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed at all nearby foes, poisoning them. User becomes Poison-type.

PRIMEVALPOISONSPIKES.Name: Primeval Poison Spikes
PRIMEVALPOISONSPIKES.Description: The user lays two hazard layers of poison spikes on the foe's side. User becomes Poison-type.

EMPOWEREDEARTHQUAKE.Name: Empowered Earthquake
EMPOWEREDEARTHQUAKE.Description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it and underground.

PRIMEVALGRAVITY.Name: Primeval Gravity
PRIMEVALGRAVITY.Description: The user intensifies Gravity for five turns and damages all enemies for 1/4th of their max HP. User becomes Ground-type.

PRIMEVALSHOREUP.Name: Primeval Shore Up
PRIMEVALSHOREUP.Description: The user restores 1/8th of its HP. Raises its offensive-, but lowers defensive stats at the end of each turn. User becomes Ground-type.

PRIMEVALSPIKES.Name: Primeval Spikes
PRIMEVALSPIKES.Description: The user lays three hazard layers of Spikes on the foe's side. User becomes Ground-type.

WARPINGCORE.Name: Warping Core
WARPINGCORE.Description: A move that only the avatar of Groudon can use. Gravity is intensified for the rest of the battle.

EMPOWEREDANCIENTPOWER.Name: Empowered Ancient Power
EMPOWEREDANCIENTPOWER.Description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power which raises all its stats.

EMPOWEREDPOWERGEM.Name: Empowered Power Gem
EMPOWEREDPOWERGEM.Description: The user attacks with a sparkling gem-like ray, dizzying the target.

EMPOWEREDROCKTOMB.Name: Empowered Rock Tomb
EMPOWEREDROCKTOMB.Description: Boulders are hurled at all near enemies, preventing their movement. This lowers their Speed by four steps.

PRIMEVALROCKPOLISH.Name: Primeval Rock Polish
PRIMEVALROCKPOLISH.Description: The user raises its Speed by six steps and gains a Rock Gem. User becomes Rock-type.

PRIMEVALSANDSTORM.Name: Primeval Sandstorm
PRIMEVALSANDSTORM.Description: The user summons sandstorm for six turns. This raises its Defense and Sp. Def. User becomes Rock-type.

PRIMEVALHEALORDER.Name: Primeval Heal Order
PRIMEVALHEALORDER.Description: The user restores 1/8th of its HP and summons an allied Combee. User becomes Bug-type.

PRIMEVALQUIVERDANCE.Name: Primeval Quiver Dance
PRIMEVALQUIVERDANCE.Description: The user raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed by two steps. User becomes Bug-type.

PRIMEVALSTRINGSHOT.Name: Primeval String Shot
PRIMEVALSTRINGSHOT.Description: Nearby foes are bound with silk. This lowers their Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed by two steps. User becomes Bug-type.

PRIMEVALCURSEDOATH.Name: Primeval Cursed Oath
PRIMEVALCURSEDOATH.Description: The user applies a damaging curse to all nearby foes. User becomes Ghost-type.

PRIMEVALDESTINYBOND.Name: Primeval Destiny Bond
PRIMEVALDESTINYBOND.Description: Attackers against the user suffer recoil for the rest of the battle. User becomes Ghost-type.

EMPOWEREDBULLETPUNCH.Name: Empowered Bullet Punch
EMPOWEREDBULLETPUNCH.Description: The user strikes the target with three punches like bullets. This move always goes first.

EMPOWEREDMETALCLAW.Name: Empowered Metal Claw
EMPOWEREDMETALCLAW.Description: The target is raked with steel claws twice. This raises the user's Attack after each hit.

EMPOWEREDMETEORMASH.Name: Empowered Meteor Mash
EMPOWEREDMETEORMASH.Description: The target is obliterated by a meteoric strike. This raises the user's Attack by two steps.

PRIMEVALIRONDEFENSE.Name: Primeval Iron Defense
PRIMEVALIRONDEFENSE.Description: The user raises its Defense by four steps and gains the ability Filter. User becomes Steel-type.

PRIMEVALLASERFOCUS.Name: Primeval Laser Focus
PRIMEVALLASERFOCUS.Description: The user focuses intently, making every future attack critical. User becomes Steel-type.

PRIMEVALMIRRORSHIELD.Name: Primeval Mirror Shield
PRIMEVALMIRRORSHIELD.Description: The user raises its Sp. Def by two steps and gains the ability Feedback. User becomes Steel-type.

PRIMEVALPOLARIZEDROOM.Name: Primeval Polarized Room
PRIMEVALPOLARIZEDROOM.Description: The user creates a Polarized Room for six turns. This raises its Defense and Sp. Def. User becomes Steel-type.

PRIMEVALSWORDSDANCE.Name: Primeval Swords Dance
PRIMEVALSWORDSDANCE.Description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This raises the user's Attack by four steps. User becomes Steel-type.

EMPOWEREDFLAREBLITZ.Name: Empowered Flare Blitz
EMPOWEREDFLAREBLITZ.Description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe, burning it. The user also takes 33% recoil.

EMPOWEREDMYSTICALFIRE.Name: Empowered Mystical Fire
EMPOWEREDMYSTICALFIRE.Description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk by six steps.

PRIMEVALFLAMESPIKES.Name: Primeval Flame Spikes
PRIMEVALFLAMESPIKES.Description: The user lays two hazard layers of burning spikes on the foe's side. User becomes Fire-type.

PRIMEVALIGNITE.Name: Primeval Ignite
PRIMEVALIGNITE.Description: The user inflicts burns on all nearby foes. User becomes Fire-type.

PRIMEVALSUNSHINE.Name: Primeval Sunshine
PRIMEVALSUNSHINE.Description: The user summons sunshine for six turns. This raises its Attack and Sp. Atk. User becomes Fire-type.

EMPOWEREDBUBBLEBEAM.Name: Empowered Bubble Beam
EMPOWEREDBUBBLEBEAM.Description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at all nearby foes. This lowers their Speed by three steps.

EMPOWEREDSURF.Name: Empowered Surf
EMPOWEREDSURF.Description: It swamps the area with a giant wave, hitting every battler nearby and underwater.

PRIMEVALFLOWSTATE.Name: Primeval Flow State
PRIMEVALFLOWSTATE.Description: The user enters a state of total focus, prevents stat steps from being lowered, raises Attack and Sp. Def, and becomes Water-type.

PRIMEVALRAINSTORM.Name: Primeval Rainstorm
PRIMEVALRAINSTORM.Description: The user summons rainstorm for six turns and surrounds itself with Aqua Ring. User becomes Water-type.

PRIMEVALWATERLOG.Name: Primeval Waterlog
PRIMEVALWATERLOG.Description: The user inflicts waterlog on all nearby foes. User becomes Water-type.

SEVENSEASEDICT.Name: Seven Seas Edict
SEVENSEASEDICT.Description: A move that only the avatar of Kyogre can use. The user commands a Luvdisc avatar and a Remoraid avatar to join it.

EMPOWEREDBULLETSEED.Name: Empowered Bullet Seed
EMPOWEREDBULLETSEED.Description: The user forcefully shoots six seeds in rapid succession, spread among nearby enemies.

EMPOWEREDGIGADRAIN.Name: Empowered Giga Drain
EMPOWEREDGIGADRAIN.Description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by all the damage taken by the target.

EMPOWEREDSOLARBEAM.Name: Empowered Solar Beam
EMPOWEREDSOLARBEAM.Description: The user charges by gathering light, then blasts all near foes on the second turn.

PRIMEVALAROMATHERAPY.Name: Primeval Aromatherapy
PRIMEVALAROMATHERAPY.Description: The user heals all non-volatile status conditions on their side, gains the ability Stability, heals itself for 25% HP and becomes Grass-type.

PRIMEVALLEECHSEED.Name: Primeval Leech Seed
PRIMEVALLEECHSEED.Description: The user inflicts leech on all nearby foes. User becomes Grass-type.

PRIMEVALSPIKYSHIELD.Name: Primeval Spiky Shield
PRIMEVALSPIKYSHIELD.Description: The user raises its Defense by two steps and gains the ability Iron Barbs. User becomes Grass-type.

PRIMEVALSPORE.Name: Primeval Spore
PRIMEVALSPORE.Description: The user scatters bursts of spores to induce sleep on all foes. User becomes Grass-type.

PRIMEVALSYMBIOSIS.Name: Primeval Symbiosis
PRIMEVALSYMBIOSIS.Description: The user summons an allied Gossifleur. This raises its Sp. Def by three steps, and its allies' by one. User becomes Grass-type.

EMPOWEREDTHUNDERBOLT.Name: Empowered Thunderbolt
EMPOWEREDTHUNDERBOLT.Description: A powerful electric blast is let loose on the target, numbing it.

PRIMEVALLIGHTNINGDANCE.Name: Primeval Lightning Dance
PRIMEVALLIGHTNINGDANCE.Description: The user raises its Sp. Atk and Speed by two steps. User becomes Electric-type.

PRIMEVALNUMB.Name: Primeval Numb
PRIMEVALNUMB.Description: The user inflicts numb on all nearby foes. User becomes Electric-type.

EMPOWEREDFUTURESIGHT.Name: Empowered Future Sight
EMPOWEREDFUTURESIGHT.Description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

PRIMEVALAMNESIA.Name: Primeval Amnesia
PRIMEVALAMNESIA.Description: The user raises its Sp. Def by four steps and gains the ability Unaware. User becomes Psychic-type.

PRIMEVALCALMMIND.Name: Primeval Calm Mind
PRIMEVALCALMMIND.Description: The user raises its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by two steps and maximizes its Accuracy. User becomes Psychic-type.

PRIMEVALECLIPSE.Name: Primeval Eclipse
PRIMEVALECLIPSE.Description: The user summons eclipse for six turns. This raises its Attack and Sp. Atk. User becomes Psychic-type.

PRIMEVALMAGICCOAT.Name: Primeval Magic Coat
PRIMEVALMAGICCOAT.Description: Bounces back status moves for the next three turns. User becomes Psychic-type.

PRIMEVALMINDLINK.Name: Primeval Mind Link
PRIMEVALMINDLINK.Description: The user summons an allied Abra. This raises its Sp. Atk by three steps, and its allies' by one. User becomes Psychic-type.

PRIMEVALODDROOM.Name: Primeval Odd Room
PRIMEVALODDROOM.Description: The user creates an Odd Room for six turns. This raises its Speed. User becomes Psychic-type.

PRIMEVALPACIFY.Name: Primeval Pacify
PRIMEVALPACIFY.Description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make all nearby statused foes fall into a deep sleep. User becomes Psychic-type.

EMPOWEREDICEBEAM.Name: Empowered Ice Beam
EMPOWEREDICEBEAM.Description: The target is struck with an absolute zero beam of energy, frostbiting it.

PRIMEVALCHILL.Name: Primeval Chill
PRIMEVALCHILL.Description: The user inflicts frostbite on all nearby foes. User becomes an Ice-type.

PRIMEVALFROSTSPIKES.Name: Primeval Frost Spikes
PRIMEVALFROSTSPIKES.Description: The user lays two hazard layers of frozen spikes on the foe's side. User becomes Ice-type.

PRIMEVALHAIL.Name: Primeval Hail
PRIMEVALHAIL.Description: The user summons hail for six turns. This lowers every foe's Speed by two steps. User becomes Ice-type.

PRIMEVALSHIVERDANCE.Name: Primeval Shiver Dance
PRIMEVALSHIVERDANCE.Description: The user raises its Attack, Defense, and Speed by two steps. User becomes Ice-type.

EMPOWEREDCRUELTY.Name: Empowered Cruelty
EMPOWEREDCRUELTY.Description: The user crushes all near foes with evil intent. This deals double damage to targets with a non-volatile status condition.

EMPOWEREDDRAGONBREATH.Name: Empowered Dragon Breath
EMPOWEREDDRAGONBREATH.Description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage and numbs the target.

IDEALWORLD.Name: Ideal World
IDEALWORLD.Description: A move that only the avatar of Zekrom can use. All battlers gain Steel-type and have their stat changes reset.

PRIMEVALDRAGONDANCE.Name: Primeval Dragon Dance
PRIMEVALDRAGONDANCE.Description: The user raises its Attack and Speed by two steps. User becomes Dragon-type.

PRIMEVALLOOMOVER.Name: Primeval Loom Over
PRIMEVALLOOMOVER.Description: The user lowers each near foe's highest stat by four steps. User becomes Dragon-type.

TRUEGLORY.Name: True Glory
TRUEGLORY.Description: A move that only the avatar of Reshiram can use. All battlers have all of their stats raised by two steps.

PRIMEVALHOWL.Name: Primeval Howl
PRIMEVALHOWL.Description: The user summons an allied Poochyena. This raises its Attack by three steps, and its allies' by one. User becomes Dark-type.

PRIMEVALTORMENT.Name: Primeval Torment
PRIMEVALTORMENT.Description: The user torments all near foes, preventing them from repeating moves. User becomes Dark-type.

EMPOWEREDMOONBLAST.Name: Empowered Moonblast
EMPOWEREDMOONBLAST.Description: The user blasts all nearby foes with the moon's full power, lowering their Sp. Atk by three steps.

PRIMEVALDREAMDANCE.Name: Primeval Dream Dance
PRIMEVALDREAMDANCE.Description: The user raises its Sp. Atk by four steps. User becomes Fairy-type.

PRIMEVALMOONGLOW.Name: Primeval Moonglow
PRIMEVALMOONGLOW.Description: The user summons moonglow for six turns. This raises the Defense and Sp. Def of all allies. User becomes Fairy-type.

PRIMEVALPUZZLEROOM.Name: Primeval Puzzle Room
PRIMEVALPUZZLEROOM.Description: The user creates a Puzzle Room for six turns. This raises its Attack and Sp. Atk. User becomes Fairy-type.

ANIMATED.Name: Animated
ANIMATED.Description: "Your team members take one third less damage from sources that aren't attacks."

ARTILLERY.Name: Artillery
ARTILLERY.Description: "Your team members deal 20% more move damage after their first turn."

ASSASSIN.Name: Assassin
ASSASSIN.Description: "Your team deals 20% more move damage on their first turn out."

BUSHWHACKER.Name: Bushwhacker
BUSHWHACKER.Description: "Your team's 'Not Very Effective' or 'Barely Effective' moves deal 50% more damage."

CARETAKER.Name: Caretaker
CARETAKER.Description: "Your team members heal for 1/10th HP when swapping out. Your Aid Kit heals for 25% more."

CHARMER.Name: Charmer
CHARMER.Description: "Your team takes 20% less move damage on the turns they enter."

DECEIVER.Name: Deceiver
DECEIVER.Description: "Your team deals 15% more move damage with attacks that don't share a type with their species."

ESOTERIC.Name: Esoteric
ESOTERIC.Description: "Whenever a member of your team uses a status move, they'll deal 25% more move damage next turn."

FORTUNE.Name: Fortune
FORTUNE.Description: "Your team members' moves have a +30% chance to activate their additional effects."

INDUSTRIOUS.Name: Industrious
INDUSTRIOUS.Description: "You gain 10% more money and coins in battles. If you have more than $100,000, your team gets a boost to Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, and Sp. Def (before modifiers). This bonus scales with the level cap and is currently {b1}."

LOYAL.Name: Loyal
LOYAL.Description: "Your team members gain 10% more EXP in battles. They also get a small boost to Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, and Sp. Def (before modifiers). This bonus scales with the level cap and is currently {b}."

NOBLE.Name: Noble
NOBLE.Description: "Your team members take 15% less move damage if they're using a status move this turn."

RADIANT.Name: Radiant
RADIANT.Description: "Your team has 30% increased Sp. Def. Foes can't lower your team's Sp. Def."

SCAVENGER.Name: Scavenger
SCAVENGER.Description: "Your team members' berries heal them for 50% more (multiplicative) and their gem-boosted attacks deal 25% more damage (multiplicative)."

SCOURGE.Name: Scourge
SCOURGE.Description: "Your able party members and battlers heal for 1/10th HP whenever a foe faints."

SCRAPPER.Name: Scrapper
SCRAPPER.Description: "Your team has 30% increased Defense. Foes can't lower your team's Defense."

SERENE.Name: Serene
SERENE.Description: "Effects placed by your Pokémon last 50% longer (rounded down)."

TACTICIAN.Name: Tactician
TACTICIAN.Description: "Your Pokémon deal 15% more damage to targets that haven’t moved yet this turn. Your priority attacks and priority status moves have doubled PP."

TYRANNICAL.Name: Tyrannical
TYRANNICAL.Description: "Ignore the first time each battle that one of your team members would flinch or get a non-volatile status condition."

WARRIOR.Name: Warrior
WARRIOR.Description: "Your team members take 15% less move damage if they choose an attack this turn."

BULBASAUR.Name: Bulbasaur
BULBASAUR.Pokedex: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

IVYSAUR.Name: Ivysaur
IVYSAUR.Pokedex: To support its weight, Ivysaur's legs and trunk grow thick and strong. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, it's a sign that the bud will bloom soon.

VENUSAUR.Name: Venusaur
VENUSAUR.Pokedex: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

CHARMANDER.Name: Charmander
CHARMANDER.Pokedex: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

CHARMELEON.Name: Charmeleon
CHARMELEON.Pokedex: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

CHARIZARD.Name: Charizard
CHARIZARD.Pokedex: If Charizard becomes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a whitish-blue color.

SQUIRTLE.Name: Squirtle
SQUIRTLE.Pokedex: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling Squirtle to swim at high speeds.

WARTORTLE.Name: Wartortle
WARTORTLE.Pokedex: Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon's toughness in battle.

BLASTOISE.Name: Blastoise
BLASTOISE.Pokedex: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

CATERPIE.Name: Caterpie
CATERPIE.Pokedex: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.

METAPOD.Name: Metapod
METAPOD.Pokedex: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

BUTTERFREE.Name: Butterfree
BUTTERFREE.Pokedex: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.

PAPELLUMEN.Name: Papellumen
PAPELLUMEN.Pokedex: Evolutionary power has supercharged its wings and their toxic scales, which turn to pure energy at the slightest provocation.

WEEDLE.Name: Weedle
WEEDLE.Pokedex: Predators not warned off by its brightly-colored body are jabbed with the toxic barb on its head.

KAKUNA.Name: Kakuna
KAKUNA.Pokedex: It remains virtually immobile while it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it busily prepares for evolution. This is evident from how hot its shell becomes.

BEEDRILL.Name: Beedrill
BEEDRILL.Pokedex: It prefers hit-and-run attacks using its powerful poison stingers, trying to evade blows to its fragile body.

WORNET.Name: Wornet
WORNET.Pokedex: Its final evolution has sent its killer instinct into overdrive. It obeys its trainer unfailingly, but will grow impatient without a good fight.

PIDGEY.Name: Pidgey
PIDGEY.Pokedex: It has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It can unerringly return home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.

PIDGEOTTO.Name: Pidgeotto
PIDGEOTTO.Pokedex: This Pokémon flies around, patrolling its large territory. If its living space is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.

PIDGEOT.Name: Pidgeot
PIDGEOT.Pokedex: It spreads its gorgeous wings wide to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach 2.

RATTATA.Name: Rattata
RATTATA.Pokedex: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

RATICATE.Name: Raticate
RATICATE.Pokedex: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

ARATTATA.Name: A. Rattata
ARATTATA.Pokedex: It shows no interest in anything that isn't fresh. If you take it shopping with you, it will help you pick out ingredients.

ARATICATE.Name: A. Raticate
ARATICATE.Pokedex: It makes its Rattata underlings gather food for it, dining solely on the most nutritious and delicious fare.

SPEAROW.Name: Spearow
SPEAROW.Pokedex: Farmers whose fields are troubled by bug Pokémon appreciate Spearow for its vigorous appetite and look after it.

FEAROW.Name: Fearow
FEAROW.Pokedex: Its long neck and elongated beak are ideal for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves this extended and skinny beak to pluck prey.

EKANS.Name: Ekans
EKANS.Pokedex: Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare.

ARBOK.Name: Arbok
ARBOK.Pokedex: Transfixing prey with the face-like pattern on its belly, it binds and poisons the frightened victim.

PICHU.Name: Pichu
PICHU.Pokedex: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

PIKACHU.Name: Pikachu
PIKACHU.Pokedex: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

RAICHU.Name: Raichu
RAICHU.Pokedex: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.

GIGACHU.Name: Gigachu
GIGACHU.Pokedex: Rarely, a Pikachu grows to incredible size instead of evolving into Raichu. It can power settlements so long as it's fed properly.

ARAICHU.Name: A. Raichu
ARAICHU.Pokedex: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

SANDSHREW.Name: Sandshrew
SANDSHREW.Pokedex: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, this Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.

SANDSLASH.Name: Sandslash
SANDSLASH.Pokedex: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.

ASANDSHREW.Name: A. Sandshrew
ASANDSHREW.Pokedex: Life on mountains covered with deep snow has granted this Pokémon a body of ice that's as hard as steel.

ASANDSLASH.Name: A. Sandslash
ASANDSLASH.Pokedex: It lives in snowy mountains on southern islands. When a blizzard rolls in, this Pokémon hunkers down in the snow to avoid getting blown away.

NIDORANfE.Name: Nidoran-F
NIDORANfE.Pokedex: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.

NIDORINA.Name: Nidorina
NIDORINA.Pokedex: When Nidorina are with friends or family, they keep their barbs tucked away to prevent hurting each other. It becomes nervous if separated from the others.

NIDOQUEEN.Name: Nidoqueen
NIDOQUEEN.Pokedex: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

NIDORANmA.Name: Nidoran-M
NIDORANmA.Pokedex: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

NIDORINO.Name: Nidorino
NIDORINO.Pokedex: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

NIDOKING.Name: Nidoking
NIDOKING.Pokedex: When it goes on a rampage, it's impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it's lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.

CLEFFA.Name: Cleffa
CLEFFA.Pokedex: Many appear when the night skies are filled with shooting stars. They disappear with sunrise.

CLEFAIRY.Name: Clefairy
CLEFAIRY.Pokedex: On every night of a full moon they come out to play. When dawn arrives, they return to their quiet mountain retreats and sleep nestled up against each other.

CLEFABLE.Name: Clefable
CLEFABLE.Pokedex: A Clefable uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.

VULPIX.Name: Vulpix
VULPIX.Pokedex: From its mouth spew flames that seem to resemble the spirits of the deceased. Some people mistakenly think this fire is a ghost.

NINETALES.Name: Ninetales
NINETALES.Pokedex: Legend has it that this mystical Pokémon was formed when nine saints coalesced into one.

AVULPIX.Name: A. Vulpix
AVULPIX.Pokedex: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

ANINETALES.Name: A. Ninetales
ANINETALES.Pokedex: It lives on mountains perpetually covered in snow and is revered as a deity incarnate. It appears draped in a blizzard.

MVULPIX.Name: M. Vulpix
MVULPIX.Pokedex: It constantly demands treats and gifts from its Trainer. An expensive and fashionable hoard is necessary for evolution.

MNINETALES.Name: M. Ninetales
MNINETALES.Pokedex: The gifts it received have become a tail of golden light. It weaponizes pure avaricious energy in battle, gaining in power as it is pampered.

IGGLYBUFF.Name: Igglybuff
IGGLYBUFF.Pokedex: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

JIGGLYPUFF.Name: Jigglypuff
JIGGLYPUFF.Pokedex: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

WIGGLYTUFF.Name: Wigglytuff
WIGGLYTUFF.Pokedex: The surfaces of its saucerlike eyes are always covered with a thin layer of tears. If any dust gets in this Pokémon's eyes, it is quickly washed away.

ZUBAT.Name: Zubat
ZUBAT.Pokedex: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

GOLBAT.Name: Golbat
GOLBAT.Pokedex: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.

CROBAT.Name: Crobat
CROBAT.Pokedex: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

ODDISH.Name: Oddish
ODDISH.Pokedex: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

GLOOM.Name: Gloom
GLOOM.Pokedex: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.

VILEPLUME.Name: Vileplume
VILEPLUME.Pokedex: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

BELLOSSOM.Name: Bellossom
BELLOSSOM.Pokedex: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

PARAS.Name: Paras
PARAS.Pokedex: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

PARASECT.Name: Parasect
PARASECT.Pokedex: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

VENONAT.Name: Venonat
VENONAT.Pokedex: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

VENOMOTH.Name: Venomoth
VENOMOTH.Pokedex: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

DIGLETT.Name: Diglett
DIGLETT.Pokedex: Around their crops, farmers plant trees that Diglett like to eat as a way of getting Diglett to plow the fields for them.

DUGTRIO.Name: Dugtrio
DUGTRIO.Pokedex: Dugtrio's heads are sleek and smooth and incredibly hard. It can dig through any soil with its headbutts.

ADIGLETT.Name: A. Diglett
ADIGLETT.Pokedex: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

ADUGTRIO.Name: A. Dugtrio
ADUGTRIO.Pokedex: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

MEOWTH.Name: Meowth
MEOWTH.Pokedex: It loves coins, so if you give it one, you can make friends with Meowth easily. But it's fickle, so you can't count on that friendship lasting.

PERSIAN.Name: Persian
PERSIAN.Pokedex: Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.

NIBELONG.Name: Nibelong
NIBELONG.Pokedex: Scientists are divided as to whether its incredible length inspired internet memes, or whether seeing memes caused a Meowth to undergo unprecedented evolution.

AMEOWTH.Name: A. Meowth
AMEOWTH.Pokedex: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

APERSIAN.Name: A. Persian
APERSIAN.Pokedex: Its round face is a symbol of wealth. Persian that have bigger, plumper faces are considered more beautiful.

GMEOWTH.Name: G. Meowth
GMEOWTH.Pokedex: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

PERRSERKER.Name: Perrserker
PERRSERKER.Pokedex: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

PSYDUCK.Name: Psyduck
PSYDUCK.Pokedex: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

GOLDUCK.Name: Golduck
GOLDUCK.Pokedex: It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use telekinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.

MANKEY.Name: Mankey
MANKEY.Pokedex: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

PRIMEAPE.Name: Primeape
PRIMEAPE.Pokedex: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

ANNIHILAPE.Name: Annihilape
ANNIHILAPE.Pokedex: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

GROWLITHE.Name: Growlithe
GROWLITHE.Pokedex: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

ARCANINE.Name: Arcanine
ARCANINE.Pokedex: Legends tell of it fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country. Those hearing its bark feel compelled to grovel before it.

HGROWLITHE.Name: H. Growlithe
HGROWLITHE.Pokedex: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

HARCANINE.Name: H. Arcanine
HARCANINE.Pokedex: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

POLIWAG.Name: Poliwag
POLIWAG.Pokedex: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

POLIWHIRL.Name: Poliwhirl
POLIWHIRL.Pokedex: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.

POLIWRATH.Name: Poliwrath
POLIWRATH.Pokedex: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

POLITOED.Name: Politoed
POLITOED.Pokedex: If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

ABRA.Name: Abra
ABRA.Pokedex: It can read others' minds and will teleport away when danger approaches. You must clear your mind if you want to catch it.

KADABRA.Name: Kadabra
KADABRA.Pokedex: It stares at a silver spoon to amplify its psychic powers before it lets loose. Apparently, gold spoons are no good.

ALAKAZAM.Name: Alakazam
ALAKAZAM.Pokedex: Alakazam's brain continually grows, making its head far too heavy to support with its neck. This Pokémon holds its head up using its psychokinetic power instead.

MACHOP.Name: Machop
MACHOP.Pokedex: Machop exercises by hefting around a Graveler as if it were a barbell. There are some Machop that travel the world in a quest to master all kinds of martial arts.

MACHOKE.Name: Machoke
MACHOKE.Pokedex: Machoke works out every day even as it helps with tough labor. On its days off, this Pokémon heads to the fields and mountains to exercise and train.

MACHAMP.Name: Machamp
MACHAMP.Pokedex: It can lift heavy loads with the greatest of ease. It can even heft dump trucks. But its clumsy fingers prevent it from doing any precision work.

BELLSPROUT.Name: Bellsprout
BELLSPROUT.Pokedex: Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack. From its mouth, this Pokémon spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.

WEEPINBELL.Name: Weepinbell
WEEPINBELL.Pokedex: If its prey is bigger than its mouth, it slices up the victim with sharp leaves, then eats every morsel.

VICTREEBEL.Name: Victreebel
VICTREEBEL.Pokedex: It attracts prey with aromatic honey, then melts them in its mouth. Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more alluring.

TENTACOOL.Name: Tentacool
TENTACOOL.Pokedex: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.

TENTACRUEL.Name: Tentacruel
TENTACRUEL.Pokedex: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it's a warning sign.

GEODUDE.Name: Geodude
GEODUDE.Pokedex: The longer it lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away. However, this Pokémon's heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.

GRAVELER.Name: Graveler
GRAVELER.Pokedex: This Pokémon will climb a mountain from the base to the summit, crunchingly feasting on rocks all the while. Upon reaching the peak, it rolls back down to the bottom.

GOLEM.Name: Golem
GOLEM.Pokedex: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

AGEODUDE.Name: A. Geodude
AGEODUDE.Pokedex: Geodude compete against each other with headbutts. The iron sand on their heads will stick to whichever one has stronger magnetism.

AGRAVELER.Name: A. Graveler
AGRAVELER.Pokedex: They eat rocks and often get into a scrap over them. The shock of Graveler smashing together causes a flash of light and a booming noise.

AGOLEM.Name: A. Golem
AGOLEM.Pokedex: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

PONYTA.Name: Ponyta
PONYTA.Pokedex: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.

RAPIDASH.Name: Rapidash
RAPIDASH.Pokedex: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

GPONYTA.Name: G. Ponyta
GPONYTA.Pokedex: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

GRAPIDASH.Name: G. Rapidash
GRAPIDASH.Pokedex: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

SLOWPOKE.Name: Slowpoke
SLOWPOKE.Pokedex: Slowpoke uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in rivers. However, it often forgets what it's doing and spends entire days just loafing at water's edge.

SLOWBRO.Name: Slowbro
SLOWBRO.Pokedex: A metamorphosed Shellder has latched onto Slowbro's tail. The tail can't be used for fishing anymore, forcing Slowbro to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.

SLOWKING.Name: Slowking
SLOWKING.Pokedex: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

GSLOWPOKE.Name: G. Slowpoke
GSLOWPOKE.Pokedex: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

GSLOWBRO.Name: G. Slowbro
GSLOWBRO.Pokedex: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

GSLOWKING.Name: G. Slowking
GSLOWKING.Pokedex: Slowking can solve any problem present to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

MAGNEMITE.Name: Magnemite
MAGNEMITE.Pokedex: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

MAGNETON.Name: Magneton
MAGNETON.Pokedex: When rain clouds form, many Magneton gather in high places to wait for lightning to strike.

MAGNEZONE.Name: Magnezone
MAGNEZONE.Pokedex: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

FARFETCHD.Name: Farfetch'd
FARFETCHD.Pokedex: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

GFARFETCHD.Name: G. Farfetch'd
GFARFETCHD.Pokedex: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Farfetch'd that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

SIRFETCHD.Name: Sirfetch'd
SIRFETCHD.Pokedex: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

DODUO.Name: Doduo
DODUO.Pokedex: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

DODRIO.Name: Dodrio
DODRIO.Pokedex: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

SEEL.Name: Seel
SEEL.Pokedex: Seel hunts in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it breaks through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

DEWGONG.Name: Dewgong
DEWGONG.Pokedex: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

GRIMER.Name: Grimer
GRIMER.Pokedex: Its main source of food is the slimy industrial waste of factories. This Pokémon's numbers have been decreasing in recent years.

MUK.Name: Muk
MUK.Pokedex: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.

AGRIMER.Name: A. Grimer
AGRIMER.Pokedex: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

AMUK.Name: A. Muk
AMUK.Pokedex: The garbage it eats causes continuous chemical changes in its body, which produce its exceedingly vivid coloration.

SHELLDER.Name: Shellder
SHELLDER.Pokedex: This Pokémon's tongue is always hanging out. It uses its tongue with great dexterity to dig up sand from the seabed in its search for food.

CLOYSTER.Name: Cloyster
CLOYSTER.Pokedex: Cloyster swims by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. It shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.

GASTLY.Name: Gastly
GASTLY.Pokedex: When exposed to a strong wind, a Gastly's gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

HAUNTER.Name: Haunter
HAUNTER.Pokedex: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it's best not to go out walking around.

GENGAR.Name: Gengar
GENGAR.Pokedex: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.

ONIX.Name: Onix
ONIX.Pokedex: Onix has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this Pokémon does not lose direction while it is tunneling.

STEELIX.Name: Steelix
STEELIX.Pokedex: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

TITANIX.Name: Titanix
TITANIX.Pokedex: Its crystalline parts resist all attempts to identify them. Titanix's gravitational abilities make some scientists speculate the crystals are neutron matter.

DROWZEE.Name: Drowzee
DROWZEE.Pokedex: A Pokémon that nourishes itself by eating dreams, it is thought to share common ancestry with Munna and Musharna.

HYPNO.Name: Hypno
HYPNO.Pokedex: While it is an extremely dangerous Pokémon, people who are in need of a good, sound sleep call it their savior.

KRABBY.Name: Krabby
KRABBY.Pokedex: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

KINGLER.Name: Kingler
KINGLER.Pokedex: Kingler has an enormous, oversized claw, which it waves in the air to communicate with others. However, because the claw is so heavy, it quickly tires.

KLAWSAR.Name: Klawsar
KLAWSAR.Pokedex: Its claw has become so large that if it finds itself unable to clamp its opponent, it will just smack them with the blunt side.

VOLTORB.Name: Voltorb
VOLTORB.Pokedex: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

ELECTRODE.Name: Electrode
ELECTRODE.Pokedex: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

HVOLTORB.Name: H. Voltorb
HVOLTORB.Pokedex: When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

HELECTRODE.Name: H. Electrode
HELECTRODE.Pokedex: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn.

EXEGGCUTE.Name: Exeggcute
EXEGGCUTE.Pokedex: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

EXEGGUTOR.Name: Exeggutor
EXEGGUTOR.Pokedex: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.

AEXEGGUTOR.Name: A. Exeggutor
AEXEGGUTOR.Pokedex: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

CUBONE.Name: Cubone
CUBONE.Pokedex: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

MAROWAK.Name: Marowak
MAROWAK.Pokedex: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

AMAROWAK.Name: A. Marowak
AMAROWAK.Pokedex: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

TYROGUE.Name: Tyrogue
TYROGUE.Pokedex: To brush up on its fighting skills, it will challenge anyone. It has a very strong competitive spirit.

HITMONLEE.Name: Hitmonlee
HITMONLEE.Pokedex: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

HITMONCHAN.Name: Hitmonchan
HITMONCHAN.Pokedex: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

HITMONTOP.Name: Hitmontop
HITMONTOP.Pokedex: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you'd like.

LICKITUNG.Name: Lickitung
LICKITUNG.Pokedex: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it's really clean is... questionable.

LICKILICKY.Name: Lickilicky
LICKILICKY.Pokedex: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.

KOFFING.Name: Koffing
KOFFING.Pokedex: Getting up close to a Koffing will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gasses swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.

WEEZING.Name: Weezing
WEEZING.Pokedex: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gasses by diluting them to the highest level.

GWEEZING.Name: G. Weezing
GWEEZING.Pokedex: Long ago, during a time when droves of factories fouled the air with pollution, Weezing changed into this form for some reason.

RHYHORN.Name: Rhyhorn
RHYHORN.Pokedex: It is so dense, while on a run it forgets why it started running in the first place. It apparently remembers sometimes if it demolishes something.

RHYDON.Name: Rhydon
RHYDON.Pokedex: Rhydon has a horn that serves as a drill. This Pokémon occasionally rams into streams of magma, but the armor-like hide prevents it from feeling the heat.

RHYPERIOR.Name: Rhyperior
RHYPERIOR.Pokedex: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

HAPPINY.Name: Happiny
HAPPINY.Pokedex: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It's bothered by how curly its hair looks.

CHANSEY.Name: Chansey
CHANSEY.Pokedex: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

BLISSEY.Name: Blissey
BLISSEY.Pokedex: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

TANGELA.Name: Tangela
TANGELA.Pokedex: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.

TANGROWTH.Name: Tangrowth
TANGROWTH.Pokedex: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

MTANGELA.Name: M. Tangela
MTANGELA.Pokedex: Though it looks like a plant, its green color comes from its jade scales. Looking into its eyes is said to bring three years of bad luck.

MTANGROWTH.Name: M. Tangrowth
MTANGROWTH.Pokedex: While the snakes covering it are hard as granite, its skin is soft. Predators attacking its unprotected limbs have to contend with its powerful digging claws.

KANGASKHAN.Name: Kangaskhan
KANGASKHAN.Pokedex: Although it's carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

TEAMUJIN.Name: Teamujin
TEAMUJIN.Pokedex: Mother and daughter fight alongside each other, delivering blows in quick succession. Their battle bond is unbreakable.

HORSEA.Name: Horsea
HORSEA.Pokedex: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

SEADRA.Name: Seadra
SEADRA.Pokedex: It's the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

KINGDRA.Name: Kingdra
KINGDRA.Pokedex: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life-forms can survive.

GOLDEEN.Name: Goldeen
GOLDEEN.Pokedex: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.

SEAKING.Name: Seaking
SEAKING.Pokedex: Trainers who are crazy for Seaking are divided into horn enthusiasts and fin enthusiasts. The two groups do not get along well.

MGOLDEEN.Name: M. Goldeen
MGOLDEEN.Pokedex: They obsessively count the pebbles in their rivers, becoming irate if the result is an unlucky number.

MSEAKING.Name: M. Seaking
MSEAKING.Pokedex: Fearsome Pokémon lining a river in a grand procession is a sign of a Makyan Seaking. They offer endless blessings in exchange for servitude.

STARYU.Name: Staryu
STARYU.Pokedex: This Pokémon gets nibbled on by Lumineon and others. Thanks to its red core, it regenerates fast, so it's unconcerned by their snack attacks.

STARMIE.Name: Starmie
STARMIE.Pokedex: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

MIMEJR.Name: Mime Jr.
MIMEJR.Pokedex: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

MRMIME.Name: Mr. Mime
MRMIME.Pokedex: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.

GMRMIME.Name: G. Mr. Mime
GMRMIME.Pokedex: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

MRRIME.Name: Mr. Rime
MRRIME.Pokedex: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

SCYTHER.Name: Scyther
SCYTHER.Pokedex: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

SCIZOR.Name: Scizor
SCIZOR.Pokedex: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

REAVOR.Name: Reavor
REAVOR.Pokedex: Only exceptionally aggressive or well-trained Pokémon will willingly engage one in combat. Its ripping pincers threaten to turn foes to shrapnel.

KLEAVOR.Name: Kleavor
KLEAVOR.Pokedex: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone.

SMOOCHUM.Name: Smoochum
SMOOCHUM.Pokedex: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn't really seem to care.

JYNX.Name: Jynx
JYNX.Pokedex: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

ELEKID.Name: Elekid
ELEKID.Pokedex: It's not good at storing electricity yet. This Pokémon sneaks into people's homes, looking for electrical outlets to eat electricity from.

ELECTABUZZ.Name: Electabuzz
ELECTABUZZ.Pokedex: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

ELECTIVIRE.Name: Electivire
ELECTIVIRE.Pokedex: In terms of electrical-energy output, Electivire is one of the best among all Electric Pokémon. It discharges high-voltage currents from its tails.

MAGBY.Name: Magby
MAGBY.Pokedex: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes. At the end of the day, Magby soaks in magma, resting and recovering from the day's fatigue.

MAGMAR.Name: Magmar
MAGMAR.Pokedex: When it breathes deeply, heat mirages form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

MAGMORTAR.Name: Magmortar
MAGMORTAR.Pokedex: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

PINSIR.Name: Pinsir
PINSIR.Pokedex: Although it's tough, it can't handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.

SCARAPACE.Name: Scarapace
SCARAPACE.Pokedex: When the buzz of its wings becomes a roar, it's about to bolt at full speed. It isn't uncommon for its charges to send opponents through buildings.

HERACROSS.Name: Heracross
HERACROSS.Pokedex: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

ATLACROSS.Name: Atlacross
ATLACROSS.Pokedex: They can be seen watching the sky, trying to find a place to stand for when they inevitably attempt to deadlift the world.

TAUROS.Name: Tauros
TAUROS.Pokedex: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it's a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

MILTANK.Name: Miltank
MILTANK.Pokedex: Miltank's milk has been sought after due to its taste and nutrition. The local treat of Castelia City, Casteliacones, is made from fresh Moomoo Milk.

MAGIKARP.Name: Magikarp
MAGIKARP.Pokedex: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many Magikarp deposited there by the flow.

GYARADOS.Name: Gyarados
GYARADOS.Pokedex: Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.

LAPRAS.Name: Lapras
LAPRAS.Pokedex: Once endangered, they are now overabundant. Their mournful songs have died out as the population rebounds.

SAURENAID.Name: Saurenaid
SAURENAID.Pokedex: The musical staff around its body is made of ice particles. The symbols are indecipherable, but some say they've heard Saurenaid speak its own language.

DITTO.Name: Ditto
DITTO.Pokedex: With its astonishing capacity for metamorphosis, it can get along with anything - except for its fellow Ditto.

EEVEE.Name: Eevee
EEVEE.Pokedex: Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives.

VAPOREON.Name: Vaporeon
VAPOREON.Pokedex: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

JOLTEON.Name: Jolteon
JOLTEON.Pokedex: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

FLAREON.Name: Flareon
FLAREON.Pokedex: A dedicated omnivore, Flareon will eat anything - as long as it's been slow-roasted first.

ESPEON.Name: Espeon
ESPEON.Pokedex: Its fur is so sensitive, it can feel minute shifts in the air and predict the weather...and its foes' thoughts.

UMBREON.Name: Umbreon
UMBREON.Pokedex: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it's filled with a mysterious power.

LEAFEON.Name: Leafeon
LEAFEON.Pokedex: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

GLACEON.Name: Glaceon
GLACEON.Pokedex: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

SYLVEON.Name: Sylveon
SYLVEON.Pokedex: Sylveon's ribbon-like feelers emit an aura that erases any sense of hostility, enabling it to stop fights. Its feelers allow it to read their Trainer's feelings.

GIGANTEON.Name: Giganteon
GIGANTEON.Pokedex: Its fluffiness, friendliness, and massive size make it beloved by nearly everyone. Attackers don't know where to begin.

PORYGON.Name: Porygon
PORYGON.Pokedex: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

PORYGON2.Name: Porygon2
PORYGON2.Pokedex: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.

PORYGONZ.Name: Porygon-Z
PORYGONZ.Pokedex: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error...

PORYGONMAV.Name: Porygon-MAV
PORYGONMAV.Pokedex: Rely on LuxTech's literal firewall! Featuring a unique* typing and cutting-edge network threat purgation protocols, this innovative new form has your back.

OMANYTE.Name: Omanyte
OMANYTE.Pokedex: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

OMASTAR.Name: Omastar
OMASTAR.Pokedex: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It's apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.

MOMANYTE.Name: M. Omanyte
MOMANYTE.Pokedex: This Pokémon likes to team up with the strongest Pokémon it can find. Some researchers fear its dormant power.

MOMASTAR.Name: M. Omastar
MOMASTAR.Pokedex: Some people claim this Pokémon ruled over an unnatural subterranean realm long ago. It resembles an enemy from a popular video game.

KABUTO.Name: Kabuto
KABUTO.Pokedex: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

KABUTOPS.Name: Kabutops
KABUTOPS.Pokedex: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

MKABUTO.Name: M. Kabuto
MKABUTO.Pokedex: Its fossils were found in the depths of Makyan caves. However, it is alien to anything from the same time. It resembles a monster from a popular video game.

MKABUTOPS.Name: M. Kabutops
MKABUTOPS.Pokedex: After evolution, this Pokémon began to resemble other extinct Pokémon of their time. They multiply by converting native biomass into more Kabuto.

AERODACTYL.Name: Aerodactyl
AERODACTYL.Pokedex: It flew through the open skies over the ancient continent as if they were its own. When it touched ground, its walk was weak and slow.

PTEROFLYTE.Name: Pteroflyte
PTEROFLYTE.Pokedex: In ancient times, this Pokémon was an apex predator. It has the strength to fly with a Tyrantrum in its claws.

MUNCHLAX.Name: Munchlax
MUNCHLAX.Pokedex: It conceals food under the long fur on its body. It carts around this food stash and swallows it without chewing.

SNORLAX.Name: Snorlax
SNORLAX.Pokedex: Its stomach is said to be incomparably strong. Even Muk's poison is nothing more than a hint of spice on Snorlax's tongue.

DRATINI.Name: Dratini
DRATINI.Pokedex: Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

DRAGONAIR.Name: Dragonair
DRAGONAIR.Pokedex: Dragonair stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter weather conditions in its vicinity via crystals on its neck and tail.

DRAGONITE.Name: Dragonite
DRAGONITE.Pokedex: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

ARTICUNO.Name: Articuno
ARTICUNO.Pokedex: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

GARTICUNO.Name: G. Articuno
GARTICUNO.Pokedex: Its feather-like blades are composed of psychic energy and can shear through thick iron sheets as if they were paper.

ZAPDOS.Name: Zapdos
ZAPDOS.Pokedex: This legendary bird Pokémon is said to appear only when a thundercloud parts into two halves.

GZAPDOS.Name: G. Zapdos
GZAPDOS.Pokedex: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

MOLTRES.Name: Moltres
MOLTRES.Pokedex: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

GMOLTRES.Name: G. Moltres
GMOLTRES.Pokedex: This Pokémon's sinister, flame-like aura will consume the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims become burned-out shadows of themselves.

MEWTWO.Name: Mewtwo
MEWTWO.Pokedex: Created from the DNA of Mew, this Pokémon is a dangerous combination of overwhelming power and a savage heart.

MEW.Name: Mew
MEW.Pokedex: It's very intelligent and can use an incredible variety of moves. Many believe that all other Pokémon are descendants of this one.

CHIKORITA.Name: Chikorita
CHIKORITA.Pokedex: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

BAYLEEF.Name: Bayleef
BAYLEEF.Pokedex: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

MEGANIUM.Name: Meganium
MEGANIUM.Pokedex: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

CYNDAQUIL.Name: Cyndaquil
CYNDAQUIL.Pokedex: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

QUILAVA.Name: Quilava
QUILAVA.Pokedex: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

TYPHLOSION.Name: Typhlosion
TYPHLOSION.Pokedex: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

HTYPHLOSION.Name: H. Typhlosion
HTYPHLOSION.Pokedex: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. Its form had been influenced by the energy of Mt. Coronet.

TOTODILE.Name: Totodile
TOTODILE.Pokedex: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

CROCONAW.Name: Croconaw
CROCONAW.Pokedex: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

FERALIGATR.Name: Feraligatr
FERALIGATR.Pokedex: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

SENTRET.Name: Sentret
SENTRET.Pokedex: This Pokémon is very cautious. It stands on its tail in order to see enemies from far away. If it does then it alert its pack by thumping its tail on the ground.

FURRET.Name: Furret
FURRET.Pokedex: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. It uses tunnels in order to make a quick getaway from foes.

MSENTRET.Name: M. Sentret
MSENTRET.Pokedex: The eye on its stomach enables its psychic powers and never blinks. Dirt and dust are telekinetically repelled.

MFURRET.Name: M. Furret
MFURRET.Pokedex: It burrows at night, leaving only the eye on its stomach exposed. The eye will stare into space while the rest of it sleeps.

HOOTHOOT.Name: Hoothoot
HOOTHOOT.Pokedex: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

NOCTOWL.Name: Noctowl
NOCTOWL.Pokedex: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

MHOOTHOOT.Name: M. Hoothoot
MHOOTHOOT.Pokedex: Its down insulates it against any cold. In winter it will lay dormant beneath snow banks, only to pop out during spring.

MNOCTOWL.Name: M. Noctowl
MNOCTOWL.Pokedex: When its shadow passes over someone, they feel a horrible chill. Some Trainers find it invigorating.

LEDYBA.Name: Ledyba
LEDYBA.Pokedex: It is timid and clusters together with others. The fluid secreted by its feet indicates its location.

LEDIAN.Name: Ledian
LEDIAN.Pokedex: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

SPINARAK.Name: Spinarak
SPINARAK.Pokedex: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

ARIADOS.Name: Ariados
ARIADOS.Pokedex: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

CHINCHOU.Name: Chinchou
CHINCHOU.Pokedex: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

LANTURN.Name: Lanturn
LANTURN.Pokedex: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light. With the prey incapacitated, the Pokémon swallows it in a single gulp.

TOGEPI.Name: Togepi
TOGEPI.Pokedex: Togepi shares its joy with the people who take care of it. It can act maliciously, causing havoc and bad luck to its enemies.

TOGETIC.Name: Togetic
